zh.tag: 去中心化蓝牙+ Nostr 双协议即时通讯
zh.what: Bitchat 是一款去中心化、点对点的即时通讯应用，支持蓝牙 Mesh 网络（离线）和 Nostr 协议（互联网）双传输架构。无需账户、手机号或中央服务器，注重隐私与抗审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 iOS/macOS 原生应用源码，支持蓝牙 Mesh 多跳中继、Nostr 全球中继、地理频道、IRC 风格命令、端到端加密（Noise 协议 + NIP-17）及紧急擦除等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE（CoreBluetooth）和 Nostr 协议栈，集成 Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩、Geohash 地理编码。
zh.hot: 凭借去中心化、无服务器、离线可用等特性，在隐私和抗审查需求高涨的当下迅速走红，24 小时内获 1720 星，总星数达 28722。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 无需手机号或账户，完全匿名通信
离线/灾难场景 —— 蓝牙 Mesh 在无网络环境下仍可通信
抗议或审查环境 —— 去中心化架构难以被封锁
技术爱好者 —— IRC 风格命令和开源代码便于探索

en.tag: Decentralized messaging with Bluetooth mesh & Nostr
en.what: Bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr for internet. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; privacy-first and censorship-resistant.
en.content: Full source code for iOS/macOS native app with Bluetooth mesh multi-hop relay, Nostr global relays, location-based channels, IRC-style commands, end-to-end encryption (Noise + NIP-17), and emergency wipe.
en.stack: Built with Swift, leveraging Bluetooth LE (CoreBluetooth) and Nostr protocol stack, with Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression, and Geohash geocoding.
en.hot: Its decentralized, serverless, offline-capable design resonates with privacy and censorship concerns, gaining 1720 stars in 24h and 28722 total.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — anonymous without phone or account
Offline/disaster scenarios — Bluetooth mesh works without internet
Protests or censorship — decentralized architecture resists blocking
Tech enthusiasts — IRC-style commands and open-source code

zh.tag: 为你和AI代理设计的并行浏览器
zh.what: ego lite 是一款专为人类和 AI 代理并行工作而设计的浏览器。AI 代理可以在独立的空间中运行多个浏览器任务，而你的标签页保持独立，任务完成更快且消耗更少的 token。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS 桌面应用（.dmg 安装包）和 ego-browser 技能包，支持通过 npx 安装技能。提供文档、Discord 社区和 X 账号。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 构建，依赖 macOS 系统，通过 npx 管理技能。
zh.hot: 今日新增 247 颗星，GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名。解决了 AI 浏览器自动化工具与用户争夺标签页的痛点，提供真正的并行体验。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 需要让 AI 代理在浏览器中自主操作，同时保留自己的浏览会话
自动化测试工程师 —— 利用 AI 代理并行执行浏览器测试任务
日常用户 —— 希望 AI 助手在不干扰自己浏览的情况下完成网页任务

en.tag: A browser designed for you and your AI agents to work in parallel
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for humans and AI agents to work in parallel. Agents run multiple browser tasks in their own Spaces while your tabs stay yours, completing tasks faster on fewer tokens.
en.content: The repo includes a macOS desktop app (.dmg installer) and the ego-browser skill package, installable via npx. Also provides docs, Discord community, and X account.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, depends on macOS, skill management via npx.
en.hot: Gained 247 stars today, ranked #5 on GitHub Trending. Solves the pain point of AI browser automation tools fighting for tabs with users, offering true parallel experience.
uses: AI developers — need AI agents to operate browsers autonomously while keeping their own sessions
Automation test engineers — leverage AI agents to run browser tests in parallel
Everyday users — want AI assistants to complete web tasks without interrupting their browsing

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢式协作空间
zh.what: Buzz 是一个自托管的协作平台，让人类和 AI 代理在同一个“房间”里共同工作。它基于 Nostr 协议，所有消息、操作和工作流步骤都作为签名事件记录在日志中，提供统一的身份模型和审计追踪。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Buzz 平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、Nostr 中继实现以及多个 Rust crate。提供了频道、画布、工作流、语音讨论等功能，并支持代理执行仓库操作、代码审查、CI/CD 等任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，基于 Nostr 协议，依赖多个 Rust crate 实现事件日志、身份管理和中继功能。
zh.hot: Buzz 在 GitHub 上一天内获得 3252 颗星，总星数达 4148，因其创新的“人类与代理平等协作”理念和自托管、基于 Nostr 的架构吸引了大量关注。
uses: 团队协作 —— 人类与 AI 代理在同一工作空间中共同管理项目、代码审查和 CI/CD
AI 代理开发 —— 测试和部署具有完整操作权限（如仓库、工作流）的 AI 代理
事件驱动工作流 —— 利用 Nostr 事件日志构建可审计的自动化流程
自托管社区 —— 为需要完全控制数据和身份的组织提供私有协作平台

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and agents collaborate in shared rooms
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on the Nostr protocol, every message, action, and workflow step is a signed event in a single log, providing a unified identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repository contains the full Buzz platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, Nostr relay implementation, and multiple Rust crates. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and enables agents to perform repo operations, code review, CI/CD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, based on the Nostr protocol, leveraging multiple Rust crates for event logging, identity management, and relay functionality.
en.hot: Buzz gained 3252 stars in a single day, reaching 4148 total, due to its innovative concept of equal collaboration between humans and agents, self-hosted nature, and Nostr-based architecture.
uses: Team collaboration — humans and AI agents manage projects, code review, and CI/CD in the same workspace
AI agent development — test and deploy agents with full operational capabilities (repos, workflows, etc.)
Event-driven workflows — build auditable automation using Nostr event logs
Self-hosted communities — provide a private collaboration platform for organizations needing full data and identity control

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 自托管可视化 CMS，一分钟内运行
zh.what: Instatic 是一个现代化的自托管可视化 CMS，集成了可视化编辑器、内容引擎和发布器，全部运行在一个 Bun 服务器上。它生成的页面是干净的语义 HTML 和紧凑 CSS，没有框架运行时或多余的标记。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CMS 源代码，包括可视化编辑器、内容管理、媒体处理、认证、表单、插件系统和发布器。支持 SQLite 或 Postgres 数据库，并提供一键部署到 Railway。
zh.stack: 使用 TypeScript 编写，运行在 Bun 运行时上，数据库支持 SQLite 和 Postgres。
zh.hot: Instatic 因其极简的架构和快速部署而受到关注，今日新增 179 星，总星数达 3939，在 GitHub Trending 日榜 TypeScript 类别中排名第 6。
uses: 希望拥有自托管 CMS 的开发者 —— 无需复杂配置，一分钟内启动
追求简洁 HTML 输出的网站建设者 —— 生成干净的语义页面
需要一体化解决方案的小型团队或个人 —— 集成编辑、内容管理和发布

en.tag: Self-hosted visual CMS, running in 1 minute
en.what: Instatic is a modern self-hosted visual CMS that integrates a visual editor, content engine, and publisher all in one Bun server. It outputs clean semantic HTML and compact CSS with no framework runtime or extra markup.
en.content: The repository contains the full CMS source code, including a visual editor, content management, media handling, authentication, forms, plugin system, and publisher. It supports SQLite or Postgres databases and offers one-click deploy to Railway.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, runs on Bun runtime, supports SQLite and Postgres databases.
en.hot: Instatic gains attention for its minimal architecture and fast deployment, with 179 stars today and 3939 total, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily for TypeScript.
uses: Developers wanting a self-hosted CMS — launch in one minute without complex setup
Website builders seeking clean HTML output — generates semantic pages
Small teams or individuals needing an all-in-one solution — integrated editing, content management, and publishing

zh.tag: 高颜值现代化终端文件管理器
zh.what: superfile 是一款在终端中运行的文件管理器，采用现代化的 TUI 界面，让开发者无需离开命令行即可高效浏览、预览和操作文件。它支持多面板布局、主题定制与插件扩展，致力于在保持终端工作流的同时提供图形化般的交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、安装脚本与构建指南，以及丰富的主题包、插件文档和快捷键配置示例。同时提供了面向 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的跨平台发布与安装说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言构建，采用现代化终端 UI 技术实现跨平台渲染，支持多架构二进制分发与 Homebrew 等包管理器集成。
zh.hot: 凭借精致的多栏 TUI 设计与流畅的交互体验，superfile 在开发者中迅速走红，目前已积累 18.6k Stars，本月新增 1,295 颗，跻身 GitHub Go 语言月榜第 11 位，成为传统终端文件管理器的强力现代替代品。
uses: 终端重度用户与键盘党 —— 追求不离开命令行即可完成复杂文件操作
DevOps 与运维工程师 —— 需要在远程服务器上快速浏览、编辑和管理文件
追求美观的开发者 —— 希望终端工具拥有现代 UI 与丰富主题定制
跨平台工作者 —— 在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 间寻求一致的文件管理体验

en.tag: A fancy, modern terminal file manager with rich TUI
en.what: superfile is a terminal-based file manager that delivers a modern, fancy TUI interface, allowing developers to browse, preview, and manipulate files without leaving the command line. It features multi-panel layouts, customizable themes, and plugin support, blending the efficiency of terminal workflows with a near-GUI interactive experience.
en.content: The repository ships full Go source code, installation scripts, build guides, and a rich collection of themes, plugin docs, and hotkey configuration samples. It also provides cross-platform release notes and installation instructions for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.stack: Built in Go with modern terminal UI libraries for cross-platform rendering, supporting multi-arch binaries and package managers like Homebrew.
en.hot: Thanks to its polished multi-pane TUI design and smooth interactions, superfile has gained strong traction among developers, amassing 18.6k stars with 1,295 added this month and ranking 11th on GitHub's Go monthly trending list as a compelling modern alternative to classic terminal file managers.
uses: Terminal power users and keyboard-driven developers who want to handle complex file operations without leaving the CLI
DevOps and system administrators who need to quickly browse, edit, and manage files on remote servers
Aesthetics-minded developers looking for modern UI, rich themes, and customization in terminal tools
Cross-platform workers seeking a consistent file management experience across macOS, Linux, and Windows

zh.tag: 跨平台 JavaScript 运行时环境
zh.what: Node.js 是一个开源的、跨平台的 JavaScript 运行时环境，允许在服务器端运行 JavaScript 代码。它基于 V8 引擎，采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，适合构建高性能网络应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Node.js 核心源码、构建系统、测试套件、文档及治理文件。提供 Current、LTS 和 Nightly 三种发布类型，支持多平台二进制下载。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript 和 C++，依赖 V8 引擎、libuv、OpenSSL 等底层库。构建系统使用 GYP 和 Makefile。
zh.hot: 作为 JavaScript 生态的基石，Node.js 持续获得广泛关注，今日新增 36 星，总星数超 11.8 万，稳居日榜第 7。
uses: 后端开发者 —— 构建高性能 Web 服务、API 和微服务
全栈开发者 —— 使用同一语言开发前后端
DevOps 工程师 —— 构建命令行工具和自动化脚本
初学者 —— 学习服务器端 JavaScript 编程

en.tag: Cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment
en.what: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that executes JavaScript code server-side. Built on the V8 engine, it uses an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, making it ideal for high-performance network applications.
en.content: The repository contains Node.js core source code, build system, test suite, documentation, and governance files. It offers Current, LTS, and Nightly release types with multi-platform binary downloads.
en.stack: Primary languages are JavaScript and C++, with dependencies on V8 engine, libuv, OpenSSL, etc. Build system uses GYP and Makefile.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of the JavaScript ecosystem, Node.js continues to attract widespread attention, gaining 36 stars today with over 118k total stars, ranking 7th on the daily trending list.
uses: Backend developers — building high-performance web services, APIs, and microservices
Full-stack developers — using the same language for frontend and backend
DevOps engineers — building CLI tools and automation scripts
Beginners — learning server-side JavaScript programming

zh.tag: AI 驱动的数据库客户端与 SQL 工作台
zh.what: Chat2DB 是一个免费的跨平台数据库客户端，集成了 SQL 编辑器、数据库管理和 AI 助手。它支持 30+ 种数据库，允许用户通过自然语言生成、解释和优化 SQL。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面客户端（Windows/macOS/Linux）、Docker 部署脚本、CLI 工具以及插件支持。提供 SQL 编辑、AI 对话、数据导入导出、仪表盘和 ER 图等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，使用 Spring Boot 后端和 Electron 前端。依赖多种数据库驱动（JDBC）和 AI 模型 API（如 OpenAI、本地模型）。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI 辅助 SQL 编写和广泛数据库支持，Chat2DB 在开发者中迅速流行，今日新增 82 星，总星数超 2.6 万，位列 GitHub 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 数据库管理员（DBA）—— 通过 AI 优化查询和管理数据库
数据分析师 —— 使用自然语言生成 SQL 并创建可视化仪表盘
全栈开发者 —— 在单一工具中管理多种数据库并调试 SQL
数据团队 —— 协作编辑 SQL 并共享查询结果

en.tag: AI-powered database client and SQL workspace
en.what: Chat2DB is a free, cross-platform database client that combines a full-featured SQL workspace with an AI assistant. It supports 30+ databases and enables users to generate, explain, and optimize SQL using natural language.
en.content: The repository includes desktop clients for Windows, macOS, and Linux, Docker deployment scripts, a CLI tool, and plugin support. It offers SQL editing, AI chat, data import/export, dashboards, and ER diagrams.
en.stack: Built with Java, using Spring Boot for the backend and Electron for the frontend. Relies on various JDBC drivers and AI model APIs (e.g., OpenAI, local models).
en.hot: With AI-assisted SQL writing and broad database support, Chat2DB has quickly gained popularity among developers, gaining 82 stars today and over 26k total, ranking 16th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Database administrators (DBAs) — optimize queries and manage databases with AI
Data analysts — generate SQL using natural language and create visual dashboards
Full-stack developers — manage multiple databases and debug SQL in one tool
Data teams — collaborate on SQL editing and share query results

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 金融市场的首个开源基础模型
zh.what: Kronos 是一个专为金融市场 K 线序列设计的解码器基础模型。它通过两阶段框架：先用量化器将 OHLCV 数据转为层次化离散 token，再用自回归 Transformer 预训练，统一处理多种量化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、预训练权重、微调脚本、论文及在线演示。提供 Hugging Face 模型和实时 BTC/USD 预测演示。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 和 Transformer 架构，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 和自定义 tokenizer。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源金融基础模型，被 AAAI 2026 接收，上线即获 3.2 万星标，展示强大预测能力。
uses: 量化研究员 —— 用于金融时间序列预测和因子挖掘
交易员 —— 辅助技术分析和策略回测
AI 开发者 —— 研究金融领域的 tokenization 和预训练方法

en.tag: First open-source foundation model for financial markets
en.what: Kronos is a decoder-only foundation model tailored for financial K-line sequences. It uses a two-stage framework: a specialized tokenizer quantizes OHLCV data into hierarchical discrete tokens, then an autoregressive Transformer is pre-trained to handle diverse quantitative tasks.
en.content: Repository includes model code, pretrained weights, fine-tuning scripts, paper, and a live demo. Hugging Face model and real-time BTC/USD forecast demo are available.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch and Transformer architecture, with Hugging Face Transformers and custom tokenizer.
en.hot: As the first open-source financial foundation model, accepted at AAAI 2026, it gained 32K stars upon release, demonstrating strong forecasting capability.
uses: Quantitative researchers — for financial time series forecasting and factor mining
Traders — for technical analysis and strategy backtesting
AI developers — for studying tokenization and pretraining in finance

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.tag: 多AI提供商统一接口库，驱动桌面AI助手
zh.what: aisuite 是一个轻量级 Python 库，为多个生成式 AI 提供商提供统一的聊天补全 API 和代理 API。它支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流模型，并内置工具和工具包系统，可用于构建 AI 代理。该项目还衍生出 OpenWorker，一个基于 aisuite 构建的桌面 AI 助手。
zh.content: 仓库包含 aisuite 核心库（统一 API 层、代理 API、工具包）以及 OpenWorker 的遗留代码。核心库提供简洁的接口，支持通过更改字符串切换提供商，并包含多轮代理循环、MCP 服务器集成等功能。
zh.stack: Python 库，依赖各提供商 SDK（如 openai、anthropic、google-generativeai）以及可选工具包。支持 Ollama 本地运行。
zh.hot: 由 AI 领域知名人物 Andrew Ng 创建，提供极简的多模型统一接口，降低了开发 AI 应用的门槛。15k+ 星标，今日新增 77，热度持续。
uses: AI 开发者：快速集成多种 LLM 提供商，统一 API 调用
代理构建者：利用工具包和 MCP 构建多步骤 AI 代理
桌面用户：通过 OpenWorker 获得本地 AI 助手，执行文件操作、邮件等任务

en.tag: Unified API for multiple LLM providers, powering a desktop AI coworker
en.what: aisuite is a lightweight Python library that provides a unified Chat Completions API and Agents API across multiple generative AI providers. It supports major providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and includes a tool/toolkit system for building AI agents. The project also powers OpenWorker, a desktop AI coworker built on aisuite.
en.content: The repo contains the aisuite core library (unified API layer, Agents API, toolkits) and legacy code for OpenWorker. The core library offers a simple interface to switch providers by changing a string, and includes multi-turn agent loops, MCP server integration, and more.
en.stack: Python library, depends on provider SDKs (e.g., openai, anthropic, google-generativeai) and optional toolkits. Supports local execution via Ollama.
en.hot: Created by renowned AI figure Andrew Ng, it offers a minimal unified interface for multiple models, lowering the barrier to building AI apps. 15k+ stars with 77 new today, maintaining strong momentum.
uses: AI developers: quickly integrate multiple LLM providers with a unified API
Agent builders: leverage toolkits and MCP to build multi-step AI agents
Desktop users: get a local AI coworker via OpenWorker for file operations, email, etc.

zh.tag: 基于蓝牙 Mesh 的加密 P2P 聊天应用
zh.what: Bitchat 是一款无需互联网、无需服务器、无需手机号的去中心化加密聊天应用。它通过蓝牙 Mesh 网络实现点对点通信，并支持基于地理位置的频道。

zh.hot: 今日新增 260 星，总星 6706，因其去中心化、无互联网依赖的隐私聊天理念吸引关注，且跨平台兼容 iOS 版。

离线场景：无网络环境下的本地 Mesh 聊天

en.tag: Encrypted P2P chat app over Bluetooth mesh
en.what: Bitchat is a secure, decentralized, peer-to-peer messaging app that works over Bluetooth mesh networks without internet, servers, or phone numbers. It also supports geohash channels for location-based chats.
en.content: The repo contains the full Android app source code built with Jetpack Compose, featuring Bluetooth mesh communication, end-to-end encryption, channel-based chats, IRC-style commands, and more.
en.stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material Design 3, Bluetooth LE, X25519 + AES-256-GCM encryption.
en.hot: Gained 260 stars today, total 6706, due to its decentralized, internet-free privacy-focused messaging concept and cross-platform compatibility with the iOS version.
uses: Privacy-conscious users: encrypted communication without phone numbers or accounts
Offline scenarios: local mesh chat in no-internet environments
Tech enthusiasts: exploring Bluetooth mesh and P2P communication

zh.tag: 领先的开源自动化服务器，CI/CD 核心工具
zh.what: Jenkins 是一个基于 Java 的开源自动化服务器，用于持续集成和持续交付（CI/CD）。它通过丰富的插件生态支持构建、测试、部署等开发流程的自动化。

DevOps 工程师 —— 搭建 CI/CD 流水线，集成各种工具链
开源项目维护者 —— 利用 Jenkins 实现持续集成，确保代码质量

en.tag: Leading open-source automation server, core CI/CD tool
en.what: Jenkins is a Java-based open-source automation server for continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD). It supports automating build, test, and deployment workflows through a vast plugin ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains Jenkins core source code, documentation, Docker image build scripts, and contribution guidelines. It provides distributions as WAR files, Docker images, native packages, and maintains both Weekly and LTS release lines.
en.stack: Built with Java, uses Maven for build, runs on a Servlet container (e.g., Jetty). Plugins are written in Java or Groovy and loaded dynamically via the plugin manager.

DevOps engineers — set up CI/CD pipelines and integrate various toolchains

需要绕过网络限制的用户 —— 支持多种混淆协议
开发者和运维人员 —— 可定制和扩展 VPN 服务

en.tag: Self-hosted VPN client with one-click server deployment
en.what: Amnezia VPN is an open-source VPN client that enables users to deploy their own VPN server on their server with ease. It supports multiple protocols, traffic obfuscation, and split tunneling.

zh.tag: 开源低延迟语音代理框架，支持全本地模块化VAD-STT-LLM-TTS流水线
zh.what: Hugging Face 推出的开源语音代理框架，通过一条 VAD → STT → LLM → TTS 的模块化流水线，让用户能在本地或混合环境中搭建低延迟语音对话系统。它对外暴露兼容 OpenAI Realtime API 的 WebSocket 接口，任何兼容客户端都能直接接入，且每个环节均可替换为自托管或开源模型。

zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，默认集成 Parakeet TDT（STT）与 Qwen3-TTS（语音合成），LLM 端支持 OpenAI API、HF Inference Providers、vLLM 及 llama.cpp 等任意兼容后端。
zh.hot: 在语音 Agent 爆发期，它以「全模块可替换 + 全本地可运行」直击开发者对隐私与可控性的痛点；本月新增 1,334 Star，总星数 6,149，冲上 Python 月榜第 10，并已实际部署在数千台 Reachy Mini 机器人上。
uses: 希望搭建本地语音助手、避免数据外泄的开发者与初创团队
需要将 LLM 快速接入语音交互、并要求兼容 OpenAI Realtime 协议的硬件/机器人厂商
关注低延迟对话系统、想自定义 VAD/STT/TTS 模块的研究者与工程师

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack
en.what: An open-source voice-agent framework from Hugging Face that chains VAD → STT → LLM → TTS into a low-latency, fully modular pipeline for local or hybrid deployments. It exposes an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API so any compatible client can connect, with every component swappable for self-hosted or open-source models.
en.content: The repo includes a pluggable pipeline engine, an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket server, a ready-to-use CLI, plus scripts and docs supporting multi-language and Pocket TTS.
en.stack: Built in Python, defaulting to Parakeet TDT for STT and Qwen3-TTS for synthesis, with the LLM slot supporting any OpenAI-compatible backend including hosted APIs, HF Inference Providers, vLLM, and llama.cpp.
en.hot: It hits the sweet spot for privacy and control with a fully swappable, fully local stack amid the voice-agent boom; it gained 1,334 stars this month for a total of 6,149, hitting #10 on the Python monthly trending list, and already powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production.

en.content: The repo contains full implementations of 20+ LLMs (e.g., Llama, Falcon, Mistral), scripts for pretraining/finetuning/inference, YAML recipe files, and deployment guides. Each model is implemented in a single file with no abstractions for easy debugging and customization.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch and the Lightning ecosystem, with dependencies on LitGPT library, Flash Attention, FSDP, bitsandbytes (quantization), etc. Supports Python 3.8+, CUDA, and TPU.
en.hot: LitGPT attracts 13K+ stars for its minimalist design and no-abstraction approach to high-performance LLM training and deployment. Its Apache 2.0 license and support for 20+ models make it a go-to for developers and enterprises.
uses: AI researchers and engineers — quickly experiment and finetune state-of-the-art LLMs
Enterprise teams — pretrain or finetune models on proprietary data and deploy to production
Educators and students — learn LLM internals and training pipelines

zh.tag: 用 ChatGPT 账号免费调用 OpenAI API
zh.what: 一个开源工具，允许用户通过自己的 ChatGPT 账号免费使用 OpenAI 的 API，无需付费订阅。它提供开发代理、TypeScript SDK 和 React 组件，让开发者轻松集成 AI 功能。
zh.content: 包含开发代理（将 ChatGPT 账号转为 OpenAI 兼容 API）、TypeScript SDK（本地调用）、React 组件（用户登录）以及 CLI 工具。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js、npm，支持 Vercel AI SDK 和 OpenAI 客户端适配器。
zh.hot: 免费使用 OpenAI 最新模型（如 GPT-5.6）吸引大量用户，今日新增 79 星，总星数 965，登顶 TypeScript 日榜第 3。
uses: 开发者 —— 快速搭建 AI 应用原型，无需付费 API 密钥
ChatGPT 用户 —— 通过 API 调用扩展 ChatGPT 功能
教育/学习 —— 低成本体验 OpenAI 最新模型

en.tag: Free AI with your ChatGPT account
en.what: An open-source tool that lets you use OpenAI's API for free with your ChatGPT account, no paid subscription required. It provides a dev proxy, TypeScript SDK, and React component for easy AI integration.
en.content: Includes a dev proxy (turns ChatGPT account into OpenAI-compatible API), TypeScript SDK (local calls), React component (user sign-in), and CLI tool.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, depends on Node.js and npm, supports Vercel AI SDK and OpenAI client adapters.
en.hot: Free access to latest OpenAI models (e.g., GPT-5.6) drives popularity, gaining 79 stars today, total 965, ranking #3 on TypeScript daily trending.
uses: Developers — quickly prototype AI apps without paid API keys
ChatGPT users — extend ChatGPT capabilities via API calls
Education/learning — experience latest OpenAI models at low cost

zh.tag: 构建原生代理应用的统一框架
zh.what: Agent-Native 是一个让开发者同时构建传统应用和 AI 代理的框架。它通过一次定义 Action，即可在 UI、Agent、HTTP、MCP、A2A 和 CLI 等多种表面复用，无需在“应用”和“代理”之间做选择。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架、示例模板（如 Clips、Plans、Design 等）以及完整的文档。提供 Actions、Agent 运行时、Toolkits 等模块，支持任意 Drizzle 兼容的 SQL 数据库和 Nitro 兼容的主机。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Drizzle ORM 进行数据库操作，Nitro 作为服务端框架。依赖 Zod 进行 schema 验证，支持 MCP 和 A2A 协议。
zh.hot: 今日新增 89 星，总星数 4050，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 4。它解决了应用与代理分离的痛点，提供统一的开发体验，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 全栈开发者 —— 希望同时构建传统 Web 应用和 AI 代理，减少重复工作
AI 应用开发者 —— 需要快速将 AI 能力集成到多种交互界面（UI、API、MCP 等）
创业团队 —— 用统一框架快速迭代产品，降低技术栈复杂度

en.tag: Unified framework for building agent-native applications
en.what: Agent-Native is a framework that lets developers build both traditional apps and AI agents simultaneously. By defining an Action once, it can be reused across UI, Agent, HTTP, MCP, A2A, and CLI surfaces, eliminating the need to choose between apps and agents.
en.content: The repo includes the core framework, example templates (Clips, Plans, Design, etc.), and full documentation. It provides modules like Actions, Agent runtime, and Toolkits, supporting any Drizzle-compatible SQL database and Nitro-compatible host.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses Drizzle ORM for database operations and Nitro as the server framework. Relies on Zod for schema validation and supports MCP and A2A protocols.
en.hot: Gained 89 stars today, total 4050, ranking #4 on TypeScript daily trending. It addresses the pain point of separating apps and agents by offering a unified development experience, attracting significant attention.
uses: Full-stack developers — who want to build both traditional web apps and AI agents without duplication
AI app developers — needing to quickly integrate AI capabilities across multiple surfaces (UI, API, MCP, etc.)
Startup teams — looking to iterate products rapidly with a unified framework and reduced tech stack complexity

zh.tag: 业界领先的 GraphQL 客户端，支持多框架
zh.what: Apollo Client 是一个功能强大的 GraphQL 客户端，支持 TypeScript、JavaScript 以及 React、Vue、Angular 等主流框架。它提供智能缓存、直观的 API 和全面的开发者工具，帮助加速应用开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心客户端库（@apollo/client）、与各框架的集成、缓存实现、开发者工具（DevTools、VS Code 扩展）以及详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 GraphQL 规范，支持 React、Vue、Angular、Svelte 等前端框架，以及 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: 作为 GraphQL 生态中最成熟的客户端之一，拥有近 2 万 Star，持续活跃更新，支持 React 19 等最新特性，是构建现代数据驱动应用的首选。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 在 React/Vue/Angular 等应用中集成 GraphQL 数据层
全栈开发者 —— 构建统一的数据查询和管理方案
需要离线缓存或实时更新的应用 —— 利用 Apollo Client 的智能缓存和订阅功能

en.tag: Industry-leading GraphQL client for TypeScript, JavaScript, and major frameworks
en.what: Apollo Client is a powerful GraphQL client supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, and major frameworks like React, Vue, and Angular. It delivers intelligent caching, intuitive APIs, and comprehensive developer tools to accelerate app development.
en.content: The repository includes the core client library (@apollo/client), framework integrations, caching implementation, developer tools (DevTools, VS Code extension), and comprehensive documentation with examples.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, depends on the GraphQL specification, supports frontend frameworks like React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and Node.js environments.
en.hot: As one of the most mature GraphQL clients, with nearly 20k stars and continuous active updates, it supports React 19 and other latest features, making it the go-to choice for modern data-driven applications.
uses: Frontend developers — integrating GraphQL data layer in React/Vue/Angular apps
Full-stack developers — building unified data query and management solutions
Apps needing offline caching or real-time updates — leveraging Apollo Client's intelligent caching and subscriptions

zh.tag: AI 代理浏览器，开源替代 ChatGPT Atlas 等
zh.what: BrowserOS 是一个开源的双浏览器项目，包含供 AI 代理驱动的 BrowserClaw 和供人类使用的 AI 浏览器 BrowserOS。它基于 Chromium 内核，内置 AI 代理，注重隐私，所有操作本地化，需自带 AI 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 BrowserClaw 和 BrowserOS 两个产品的完整代码，基于 Chromium 分支，提供 macOS、Windows、Linux 安装包。
zh.stack: 基于 Chromium 内核，使用 TypeScript 开发，支持 MCP 协议，可集成 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 客户端。
zh.hot: 作为 ChatGPT Atlas 等产品的开源替代，迅速吸引关注，GitHub 星标超 1.2 万，今日新增 70 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 让 AI 代理通过已登录账号自主操作浏览器
隐私敏感用户 —— 使用本地化 AI 浏览器，无需上传数据到云端
AI 工具链集成者 —— 通过 MCP 协议将浏览器能力接入 Claude Code、Cursor 等

en.tag: Open-source agentic browser; alternative to ChatGPT Atlas, Perplexity Comet, Dia.
en.what: BrowserOS is an open-source dual-browser project: BrowserClaw for AI agents to drive using your logged-in accounts, and BrowserOS for humans with a built-in AI agent. It's a privacy-first Chromium fork, local-only, and requires your own AI keys.
en.content: The repo contains the full codebase for both BrowserClaw and BrowserOS, built on a Chromium fork, with installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Built on Chromium, developed in TypeScript, supports MCP protocol for integration with AI clients like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to ChatGPT Atlas and similar tools, it quickly gained traction with over 12k stars, +70 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending.
uses: AI developers — let AI agents drive a browser using your logged-in accounts
Privacy-conscious users — use a local-only AI browser without cloud uploads
AI toolchain integrators — connect browser capabilities to Claude Code, Cursor via MCP

zh.tag: 聚合28家免费LLM的OpenAI兼容代理，月供40亿token
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个 OpenAI 兼容的代理服务，将 28 个 LLM 提供商的免费层（总计约每月 40 亿 token）整合到单个 /v1 端点后。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥存储，专为个人实验设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的代理服务器、Docker 镜像、桌面应用以及完整的文档。核心功能包括模型目录自动更新、按提供商的 token 预算跟踪和故障转移链。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Node.js 运行时，支持 Docker 部署。与 OpenAI 兼容的客户端（如 ChatGPT、LangChain）无缝集成。
zh.hot: 凭借聚合28家免费API的独特价值，上线后迅速获得17k+星标，今日新增116星，位列TypeScript日榜第7。
uses: 个人开发者 —— 免费探索多种LLM模型，无需为每个提供商注册付费
AI应用原型设计 —— 快速测试不同模型的效果，利用免费额度降低试错成本
教育与研究 —— 学生和研究者获取免费LLM访问权限，进行实验和学习

en.tag: Aggregate 28 free LLM providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ~4B tokens/month
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an OpenAI-compatible proxy that aggregates the free tiers of 28 LLM providers (~4B tokens/month) behind a single /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key storage, intended for personal experimentation only.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript proxy server, Docker image, desktop app, and full documentation. Core features include auto-updating model catalog, per-provider token budget tracking, and fallback chains.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js, supports Docker deployment. Integrates seamlessly with OpenAI-compatible clients like ChatGPT and LangChain.
en.hot: With the unique value of aggregating 28 free APIs, it quickly gained 17k+ stars, adding 116 today, ranking #7 on TypeScript daily trending.
uses: Individual developers — explore multiple LLM models for free without paying each provider
AI prototyping — quickly test different models, leverage free tiers to reduce costs
Education & research — students and researchers get free LLM access for experiments and learning

zh.tag: 离线优先的知识与AI生存服务器
zh.what: Project N.O.M.A.D. 是一个自包含的离线生存计算机，集成了关键工具、知识和AI，确保用户在任何时间、任何地点都能获取信息与赋能。它作为一个离线优先的知识与教育服务器，通过浏览器提供所有功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、Docker Compose模板、管理UI（Command Center）和API，通过Docker编排一系列容器化工具和资源，包括本地AI聊天、知识库、文档等。
zh.stack: 基于TypeScript开发，依赖Docker、Ollama（或兼容OpenAI API的软件如LM Studio）、Debian系操作系统，推荐Ubuntu。
zh.hot: 该项目获得34,845颗星，今日新增85颗，位列TypeScript日榜第8。其离线优先、自包含的生存计算理念在断网或灾难场景下极具吸引力，结合AI知识库功能引发广泛关注。
uses: 离线环境下的知识工作者 —— 在无网络时仍能访问AI和文档
灾难应急与野外生存 —— 作为便携式信息中心
教育工作者与学生 —— 本地部署的学习服务器
隐私敏感用户 —— 完全本地运行，无需云端

en.tag: Offline-first knowledge & AI survival server
en.what: Project N.O.M.A.D. is a self-contained offline survival computer packed with critical tools, knowledge, and AI to keep users informed and empowered anytime, anywhere. It serves as an offline-first knowledge and education server accessible via browser.
en.content: The repo includes installation scripts, Docker Compose templates, a management UI (Command Center) and API, orchestrating containerized tools like local AI chat, knowledge base, and documentation via Docker.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Docker, Ollama (or OpenAI API-compatible software like LM Studio), and Debian-based OS (Ubuntu recommended).
en.hot: With 34,845 stars and 85 new stars today, ranking #8 on TypeScript daily trending, its offline-first, self-contained survival computing concept is highly appealing for disconnected or disaster scenarios, combined with AI knowledge base capabilities.
uses: Knowledge workers in offline environments — access AI and docs without internet
Disaster response and wilderness survival — portable information hub
Educators and students — locally deployed learning server
Privacy-conscious users — fully local, no cloud dependency

zh.tag: 渐进式 Node.js 企业级后端框架
zh.what: Nest 是一个用于构建高效、可扩展的 Node.js 服务端应用的框架。它使用现代 JavaScript，基于 TypeScript 构建，并结合了 OOP、FP 和 FRP 的元素。底层默认使用 Express，也支持 Fastify 等其他库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nest 核心库（@nestjs/core）、常用模块（@nestjs/common）、CLI 工具、测试示例以及详尽的文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 技术栈：TypeScript、Node.js、Express（默认）、支持 Fastify，依赖注入、装饰器、模块化架构。
zh.hot: Nest 是 Node.js 后端开发的主流选择，拥有 76k+ Stars，社区活跃，生态丰富。今日新增 20 Stars，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 9，持续受到开发者青睐。
uses: 企业级后端开发者 —— 构建 RESTful API、微服务等
全栈工程师 —— 结合 Angular/React 进行全栈开发
技术团队 —— 需要标准化、可维护的 Node.js 项目架构

en.tag: Progressive Node.js framework for enterprise-grade server-side apps
en.what: Nest is a framework for building efficient, scalable Node.js server-side applications. It uses modern JavaScript, is built with TypeScript, and combines elements of OOP, FP, and FRP. Under the hood, it makes use of Express by default, with compatibility for Fastify and others.
en.content: The repository contains the Nest core library (@nestjs/core), common modules (@nestjs/common), CLI tools, testing examples, and comprehensive documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express (default), with Fastify support; dependency injection, decorators, modular architecture.
en.hot: Nest is a mainstream choice for Node.js backend development with 76k+ Stars, active community, and rich ecosystem. With 20 new stars today, it ranks 9th on TypeScript daily trending, continuing to gain developer favor.
uses: Enterprise backend developers — building RESTful APIs, microservices, etc.
Full-stack engineers — integrating with Angular/React for full-stack development
Tech teams — needing standardized, maintainable Node.js project architecture

zh.tag: 多AI代理协作平台，你当老板，AI团队自动执行任务
zh.what: Agent Teams AI 是一个桌面应用，让你扮演老板角色，AI 代理作为团队成员自动处理任务、相互沟通和审查工作。你只需通过看板下达高级指令，即可管理多个 AI 团队完成编码和项目工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，提供看板视图、任务详情、代理执行日志、代码审查、用量分析等功能。支持 200+ 模型和 75+ LLM 提供商，包括免费无需认证的模型。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 Electron 构建桌面应用，集成多种 LLM API 和代码编辑器（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）。
zh.hot: 将 AI 代理协作概念具象化为“老板-团队”模式，降低使用门槛，且支持海量模型和免费使用，上线即获 1698 星，日增 25 星。
uses: 开发者：用 AI 团队自动化编码和项目管理，只需下达高级指令
项目经理：通过看板监控多个 AI 代理的任务进度和代码审查
AI 爱好者：体验多代理协作模式，无需复杂配置即可使用免费模型

en.tag: Multi-agent collaboration platform: you're the boss, AI teams execute tasks autonomously
en.what: Agent Teams AI is a desktop app where you act as the boss, and AI agents work as your team members, handling tasks, messaging each other, and reviewing work autonomously. You just give high-level commands via a kanban board to manage multiple AI teams for coding and project work.
en.content: The repo contains the full desktop app source code, featuring kanban board, task details, agent execution logs, code review, usage analytics, and more. Supports 200+ models and 75+ LLM providers, including free models with no authentication required.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Electron for the desktop app, integrating multiple LLM APIs and code editors (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.).
en.hot: It concretizes the multi-agent collaboration concept into a 'boss-team' model, lowering the barrier to entry. With support for a vast range of models and free usage, it quickly gained 1698 stars (25 daily) and ranked #10 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript).
uses: Developers: Automate coding and project management with AI teams by giving high-level commands
Project managers: Monitor task progress and code reviews of multiple AI agents via kanban
AI enthusiasts: Experience multi-agent collaboration with free models, no complex setup needed

zh.tag: 终端原生 IDE 风格自动补全
zh.what: inshellisense 为终端提供类似 IDE 的命令行自动补全体验。它基于 withfig/autocomplete 项目，支持超过 600 个命令行工具，兼容 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 inshellisense 的源代码、安装脚本和文档。核心是一个终端原生运行时，通过 `is` 命令启动自动补全会话，支持多种 shell 集成。
zh.stack: TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行时，集成 withfig/autocomplete 的补全规则。
zh.hot: 微软出品，解决终端补全痛点，支持 600+ 工具和多平台，今日新增 108 星，总星数破万。
uses: 开发者 —— 提升命令行操作效率，减少记忆命令参数
系统管理员 —— 快速执行复杂命令，降低出错率
多 shell 用户 —— 统一补全体验，无需为每个 shell 单独配置

en.tag: IDE-style autocomplete for any shell
en.what: inshellisense brings IDE-style autocomplete to your terminal. It's a native runtime for the withfig/autocomplete project, supporting 600+ CLI tools across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.content: The repo contains source code, installation scripts, and docs. The core is a terminal-native runtime that starts an autocomplete session via the `is` command, with plugins for multiple shells.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, requires Node.js runtime, integrates autocomplete rules from withfig/autocomplete.
en.hot: Microsoft-backed solution to a common pain point, supporting 600+ tools and all major platforms. Gained 108 stars today, crossing 10k total.
uses: Developers — boost CLI productivity and reduce memorization of flags
Sysadmins — execute complex commands faster with fewer errors
Multi-shell users — get consistent autocomplete across bash, zsh, fish, etc.

zh.tag: 网页内容提取为 Markdown 的轻量库
zh.what: Defuddle 是一个从网页中提取核心内容并转换为 Markdown 的工具，能自动去除评论、侧边栏等无关元素。它比 Mozilla Readability 更宽容，保留更多不确定元素，并支持脚注、数学公式、代码块等的一致性输出。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库（浏览器和 Node.js 版本）、CLI 工具以及完整的 API 文档。支持通过 URL 或 HTML 输入，输出 Markdown、HTML 或 JSON 格式，并提取标题、作者、schema.org 元数据。
zh.stack: TypeScript 编写，依赖 linkedom、JSDOM 等 DOM 实现（可选），支持浏览器和 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: 作为 Obsidian Web Clipper 的底层引擎，Defuddle 因 Obsidian 生态的广泛使用而快速获得关注，今日新增 28 星，总星数 8603。
uses: Obsidian 用户 —— 配合 Web Clipper 插件一键剪藏网页内容为 Markdown
开发者 —— 构建网页内容提取工具或 RSS 阅读器，替代 Mozilla Readability
知识管理爱好者 —— 将网页正文转为干净 Markdown 存入笔记系统

en.tag: Lightweight library to extract main content from web pages as Markdown
en.what: Defuddle is a tool that extracts the main content from web pages and converts it to Markdown, automatically removing clutter like comments, sidebars, etc. It is more forgiving than Mozilla Readability, retains more uncertain elements, and provides consistent output for footnotes, math, code blocks, etc.
en.content: The repo includes the core library (browser and Node.js versions), a CLI tool, and full API documentation. It accepts URL or HTML input, outputs Markdown, HTML, or JSON, and extracts title, author, schema.org metadata.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, optionally depends on DOM implementations like linkedom or JSDOM, supports browser and Node.js environments.
en.hot: As the engine behind Obsidian Web Clipper, Defuddle gains rapid attention from the Obsidian ecosystem, with 28 new stars today and 8603 total stars.
uses: Obsidian users — clip web pages to Markdown with the Web Clipper plugin
Developers — build content extraction tools or RSS readers as a replacement for Mozilla Readability
Knowledge management enthusiasts — convert web articles to clean Markdown for note-taking systems

zh.tag: Claude 生态的一站式插件与技能市场
zh.what: Build with Claude 是一个为 Claude Code 打造的插件市场与发现平台。它汇集了 Claude Skills、Agents、Commands、Hooks、Plugins 以及 Marketplace 集合，帮助用户扩展 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Agent SDK 和 OpenClaw 的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 117 个 Agents、175 个 Commands、28 个 Hooks、26 个 Skills、51 个 Plugins 的精选集合，并索引了 2 万+ 社区插件、4500+ MCP 服务器和 1100+ 插件市场。还提供 Web UI 用于浏览和搜索。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，与 Claude Code 的 /plugin 命令集成，支持通过 marketplace 添加和安装插件。
zh.hot: 作为 Claude Code 生态的核心插件枢纽，它解决了用户寻找和安装扩展的痛点，Star 数达 3220，日增 6，在 TypeScript 日榜排第 13。
uses: Claude Code 用户 —— 快速安装社区贡献的插件、技能和命令
插件开发者 —— 发布和推广自己的 Claude 扩展
AI 工具爱好者 —— 探索 MCP 服务器和外部市场

en.tag: A one-stop marketplace for Claude plugins, skills, agents, and more
en.what: Build with Claude is a plugin marketplace and discovery platform for Claude Code. It aggregates Claude Skills, Agents, Commands, Hooks, Plugins, and Marketplace collections to extend Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Agent SDK, and OpenClaw.
en.content: The repo includes curated collections of 117 Agents, 175 Commands, 28 Hooks, 26 Skills, 51 Plugins, and indexes 20k+ community plugins, 4,500+ MCP servers, and 1,100+ plugin marketplaces. A Web UI is also available for browsing and searching.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, integrates with Claude Code's /plugin command, supports adding and installing plugins via marketplace.
en.hot: As a central plugin hub for the Claude Code ecosystem, it solves the pain point of finding and installing extensions, with 3220 stars (+6 today) and ranking #13 on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Claude Code users — quickly install community-contributed plugins, skills, and commands
Plugin developers — publish and promote their Claude extensions
AI tool enthusiasts — explore MCP servers and external marketplaces

zh.tag: 下一代 Node.js & TypeScript ORM，支持多种数据库
zh.what: Prisma 是一个开源的下一代 ORM，为 Node.js 和 TypeScript 提供类型安全的数据库访问。它包含 Prisma Client（自动生成的查询构建器）、Prisma Migrate（声明式数据建模与迁移）和 Prisma Studio（图形化数据管理界面）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prisma ORM 的核心源码，包括 Prisma Client、Prisma Migrate 和 Prisma Studio 的代码，以及文档、示例和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQL Server、SQLite、MongoDB 和 CockroachDB 等多种数据库。
zh.hot: Prisma 凭借其类型安全和声明式数据建模，成为 Node.js 生态中最受欢迎的 ORM 之一，拥有超过 47,000 颗星，持续活跃。
uses: Node.js/TypeScript 后端开发者 —— 需要类型安全的数据库操作
全栈开发者 —— 快速构建 REST、GraphQL 或 gRPC API
数据工程师 —— 进行数据库迁移和数据管理

en.tag: Next-generation ORM for Node.js & TypeScript, supporting multiple databases
en.what: Prisma is an open-source next-generation ORM that provides type-safe database access for Node.js and TypeScript. It includes Prisma Client (auto-generated query builder), Prisma Migrate (declarative data modeling and migration), and Prisma Studio (GUI for data management).
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Prisma ORM, including Prisma Client, Prisma Migrate, and Prisma Studio, along with documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB, and CockroachDB.
en.hot: With its type safety and declarative data modeling, Prisma has become one of the most popular ORMs in the Node.js ecosystem, boasting over 47,000 stars and continuous activity.
uses: Node.js/TypeScript backend developers — need type-safe database operations
Full-stack developers — quickly build REST, GraphQL, or gRPC APIs
Data engineers — perform database migrations and data management

zh.tag: 智能单体仓库平台，加速构建与CI
zh.what: Nx 是一个专为 TypeScript 和多语言代码库设计的单体仓库解决方案，使用 Rust 构建以获得高性能，通过 TypeScript 进行扩展。它能缓存未变更的部分、仅运行受影响的代码，并提供集成的 CI 解决方案，帮助开发者将交付时间缩短一半。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nx 核心 CLI、插件系统、Nx Cloud 集成、以及丰富的文档和示例。支持从简单到复杂的单体仓库管理，并提供自动修复失败 PR 等高级功能。
zh.stack: 主要技术栈：TypeScript、Rust（核心性能）、Node.js。依赖包括 npm/pnpm/yarn 等包管理器，以及可选的 Nx Cloud 服务。
zh.hot: Nx 拥有 29k+ Stars，作为单体仓库领域的标杆工具，持续吸引大型项目和团队采用。其 AI 代理集成和自动修复功能是近期热门亮点。
uses: 大型前端/全栈项目团队，需要高效管理多个应用和库
希望加速 CI/CD 流程的 DevOps 团队
使用 TypeScript 或多种语言（如 Go、Rust）的混合代码库

en.tag: Smart monorepo platform that accelerates builds and CI
en.what: Nx is a monorepo solution for TypeScript and polyglot codebases, built with Rust for performance and extensible via TypeScript. It caches unchanged parts, runs only affected code, and comes with an integrated CI solution, helping developers ship in half the time.
en.content: The repo includes the Nx core CLI, plugin system, Nx Cloud integration, and extensive documentation and examples. It supports monorepo management from simple to complex, with advanced features like automatic fix of failed PRs.
en.stack: Tech stack: TypeScript, Rust (core performance), Node.js. Dependencies include npm/pnpm/yarn package managers, and optional Nx Cloud service.
en.hot: With 29k+ Stars, Nx is a benchmark monorepo tool, continuously adopted by large projects and teams. Its AI agent integration and auto-fix features are recent hot highlights.
uses: Large frontend/full-stack project teams needing efficient management of multiple apps and libraries
DevOps teams looking to accelerate CI/CD pipelines
Mixed codebases using TypeScript or multiple languages (e.g., Go, Rust)

zh.tag: 免费开源的人体运动捕捉系统
zh.what: FreeMoCap 是一个免费开源的运动捕捉系统，无需昂贵硬件即可进行科研级人体动作捕捉。它通过普通摄像头（如网络摄像头）录制视频，利用计算机视觉和 AI 算法自动提取 3D 骨骼运动数据，并提供可视化界面进行编辑和导出。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 后端（负责视频处理、姿态估计、3D 重建）和 React 前端 GUI（基于 Electron），以及文档、示例数据和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Python（后端，依赖 skellytracker、MediaPipe 等）、TypeScript/React（前端 GUI，Electron 桌面应用）、uv 包管理器。
zh.hot: FreeMoCap 降低了运动捕捉的门槛，让个人研究者、教育者和爱好者无需昂贵设备即可获得专业级数据。近 1 万星标反映了社区对开源科研工具的巨大需求。
uses: 科研人员 —— 低成本进行生物力学、运动分析等研究
教育工作者 —— 在课堂中演示运动捕捉原理
独立游戏/动画开发者 —— 快速生成角色动画数据
运动爱好者 —— 分析自身运动姿态

en.tag: Free and open-source motion capture system for everyone
en.what: FreeMoCap is a free and open-source motion capture system that enables research-grade human motion capture without expensive hardware. It uses ordinary cameras (e.g., webcams) to record video, automatically extracts 3D skeletal motion data via computer vision and AI, and provides a GUI for editing and exporting.
en.content: The repository includes a Python backend (for video processing, pose estimation, 3D reconstruction) and a React frontend GUI (Electron-based), along with documentation, sample data, and installation scripts.
en.stack: Tech stack: Python (backend, with skellytracker, MediaPipe, etc.), TypeScript/React (frontend GUI, Electron desktop app), uv package manager.
en.hot: FreeMoCap lowers the barrier to motion capture, enabling individual researchers, educators, and enthusiasts to obtain professional-grade data without expensive gear. Its ~10k stars reflect the huge demand for open-source scientific tools.
uses: Researchers — low-cost biomechanics and motion analysis
Educators — demonstrate motion capture in classrooms
Indie game/animation developers — quickly generate character animation data
Sports enthusiasts — analyze their own movement

zh.tag: 浏览器自动化与测试的 JavaScript 库
zh.what: Puppeteer 是一个 JavaScript 库，提供高级 API 来控制 Chrome 或 Firefox 浏览器，支持无头模式（无 UI）运行。它基于 DevTools 协议或 WebDriver BiDi，可用于自动化网页操作、抓取、测试等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Puppeteer 库的源代码、示例、文档和测试。核心功能包括浏览器启动、页面导航、元素交互、截图、PDF 生成等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行时，通过 npm 安装。支持与 Chrome DevTools 协议和 WebDriver BiDi 集成。
zh.hot: 拥有 95,360 星，是浏览器自动化领域最流行的库之一。近期新增 MCP 支持和 WebMCP API，进一步扩展了 AI 代理场景下的应用。
uses: Web 开发者：用于自动化测试和端到端测试
数据工程师：用于网页抓取和数据提取
AI 代理开发者：通过 MCP 集成实现浏览器自动化

en.tag: JavaScript library for browser automation and testing
en.what: Puppeteer is a JavaScript library that provides a high-level API to control Chrome or Firefox over the DevTools Protocol or WebDriver BiDi. It runs headless by default and is used for browser automation, web scraping, testing, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, examples, documentation, and tests for the Puppeteer library. Core features include browser launching, page navigation, element interaction, screenshots, PDF generation, and more.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, depends on Node.js runtime, installed via npm. Integrates with Chrome DevTools Protocol and WebDriver BiDi.
en.hot: With 95,360 stars, it's one of the most popular browser automation libraries. Recent additions include MCP support and WebMCP API, expanding its use in AI agent scenarios.
uses: Web developers: for automated and end-to-end testing
Data engineers: for web scraping and data extraction
AI agent developers: for browser automation via MCP integration

zh.tag: 固执己见的通用代码格式化工具，终结代码风格争论
zh.what: Prettier 通过解析代码并重新打印，强制统一项目内的代码风格，避免开发者在代码审查中陷入无意义的格式争论。它支持 JavaScript、TypeScript、CSS、HTML、Vue、GraphQL 等十余种语言，可直接集成到编辑器、Git 预提交钩子及 CI 流程中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心格式化引擎、多语言解析器封装、CLI 命令行工具、丰富的编辑器集成插件以及开放的插件 API。同时还提供在线 Playground 和完整的文档网站，方便用户即时预览与接入。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/TypeScript 开发，底层依赖 Babel、Flow、TypeScript 等语言解析器，可在 Node.js 与浏览器环境运行，并通过 npm 分发。
zh.hot: 作为前端生态事实上的代码风格标准，Prettier 已积累 52k+ Stars，本月新增 364 星，在 GitHub JavaScript 月榜排名第 11。其“零配置”理念和广泛的编辑器支持让它几乎成为现代 JavaScript 项目的标配。
uses: 前端开发团队 —— 统一多人协作时的代码风格，减少代码审查中的格式争论
开源项目维护者 —— 在 CI 中强制检查代码格式，保证贡献者提交的代码风格一致
全栈开发者 —— 格式化 JavaScript、TypeScript、CSS、HTML、GraphQL 等多种语言文件
技术写作者 —— 统一 Markdown 文档的排版风格，提升可读性

en.tag: Opinionated multi-language code formatter that ends style debates
en.what: Prettier enforces a consistent style by parsing your code and re-printing it with its own rules, eliminating nit-picky formatting debates in code reviews. It supports over a dozen languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, and GraphQL, and integrates seamlessly into editors, pre-commit hooks, and CI pipelines.
en.content: The repository contains the core formatting engine, parsers for multiple languages, a CLI tool, editor integrations, and an open plugin API. It also includes an online Playground and comprehensive documentation for instant testing and adoption.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/TypeScript, it relies on parsers like Babel, Flow, and TypeScript, runs in both Node.js and browser environments, and is distributed via npm.
en.hot: With 52k+ stars and 364 new stars this month, ranking 11th on GitHub's JavaScript monthly trending list, Prettier has become the de facto code style standard. Its zero-config philosophy and broad editor support make it an essential tool for modern JavaScript projects.
uses: Frontend teams — enforce consistent style across collaborators and eliminate formatting debates in reviews
Open-source maintainers — integrate into CI to ensure all contributions follow the same code style
Full-stack developers — format multiple languages including JS, TS, CSS, HTML, and GraphQL in one tool
Technical writers — standardize Markdown document formatting for better readability

zh.tag: AI 求职代理：自动扫描、评分、定制简历，本地运行
zh.what: 一个开源的 AI 求职系统，能自动扫描招聘网站，用 A-F 评分体系（1.0-5.0）评估职位，并针对每个职位定制简历、追踪申请进度。所有操作都在本地 AI 编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex）中完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个多代理系统，可扫描招聘网站、评估职位、定制简历并追踪申请。提供多语言 README、演示 GIF、Press 页面和趋势图表。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 构建，依赖 AI 编码 CLI（Claude Code、Codex 等）作为运行环境，使用本地 AI 模型处理任务。
zh.hot: 解决了求职者的核心痛点——用 AI 反向筛选公司，而非被公司筛选。上线后迅速获得 61,681 星，日增 170 星，被 WIRED、Business Insider 等媒体报道。
uses: 求职者 —— 自动化批量申请，节省时间
开发者 —— 学习如何构建 AI 代理系统
招聘者 —— 了解 AI 如何改变求职流程

en.tag: AI job search agent: scan, score, tailor CV, track applications, runs locally
en.what: An open-source AI job search system that scans job portals, evaluates listings with a structured A-F rubric (1.0-5.0 score), tailors CVs for each role, and tracks applications. It runs entirely in your local AI coding CLI (e.g., Claude Code, Codex).
en.content: The repo contains a multi-agent system for scanning job portals, evaluating listings, tailoring CVs, and tracking applications. Includes multilingual README, demo GIF, press page, and star trend chart.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, relies on AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) as runtime, using local AI models for task processing.
en.hot: Addresses a core pain point for job seekers—using AI to choose companies instead of being filtered. Rapidly gained 61,681 stars with 170 daily, featured by WIRED, Business Insider, etc.
uses: Job seekers — automate bulk applications, save time
Developers — learn how to build AI agent systems
Recruiters — understand how AI transforms job search

zh.tag: 基于 WebRTC 的流式 BitTorrent 客户端
zh.what: WebTorrent 是一个用 JavaScript 编写的流式 BitTorrent 客户端，同时支持 Node.js 和浏览器环境。在浏览器中，它利用 WebRTC 数据通道实现点对点传输，无需插件或扩展即可直接下载和播放 torrent 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库，提供 API 用于创建客户端、添加种子、监听事件和流式传输文件。同时提供命令行工具和桌面应用（WebTorrent Desktop），以及丰富的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 实现，依赖 WebRTC 进行浏览器端 P2P 传输，Node.js 端使用 TCP/UDP。支持通过 npm 安装，可与 Browserify、Webpack 等打包工具集成。
zh.hot: 拥有 31k+ Star，本月新增 488，长期活跃。作为浏览器端 torrent 流式传输的标杆项目，解决了传统 torrent 无法在 Web 中直接使用的痛点，创新性地结合 WebRTC 技术。
uses: Web 开发者 —— 在网站中嵌入 torrent 下载或流媒体播放功能
Node.js 开发者 —— 构建高性能的 torrent 下载工具或服务
P2P 技术爱好者 —— 学习 WebRTC 与 BitTorrent 协议的结合实现

en.tag: Streaming torrent client using WebRTC for browser and Node.js
en.what: WebTorrent is a streaming BitTorrent client written in JavaScript, running in both Node.js and the browser. In the browser, it uses WebRTC data channels for peer-to-peer transport, enabling torrent download and streaming without plugins or extensions.
en.content: The repository contains the core JavaScript library with APIs for creating clients, adding torrents, listening to events, and streaming files. It also includes a command-line tool, the WebTorrent Desktop application, examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Pure JavaScript implementation, using WebRTC for browser P2P transport and TCP/UDP for Node.js. Installable via npm, integrates with bundlers like Browserify and Webpack.
en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 488 added this month, it's a long-standing benchmark for browser-based torrent streaming. It solves the pain point of using torrents on the web by innovatively leveraging WebRTC.
uses: Web developers — embed torrent downloading or media streaming in websites
Node.js developers — build high-performance torrent download tools or services
P2P enthusiasts — learn the integration of WebRTC and BitTorrent protocol

zh.tag: JavaScript 代码质量守护者，静态分析利器
zh.what: ESLint 是一个用于识别和报告 ECMAScript/JavaScript 代码中模式的工具。它通过可插拔的规则系统，帮助开发者发现并修复代码问题，确保代码风格一致性和最佳实践。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ESLint 核心代码、内置规则、CLI 工具、配置文档以及插件系统。支持通过 npm 安装，可自定义规则和配置文件。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js，使用 Espree 解析器进行 JavaScript 解析，利用 AST 评估代码模式。完全可插拔，每个规则都是一个插件。
zh.hot: ESLint 是 JavaScript 生态中最流行的静态代码分析工具，拥有 27428 颗星，今日新增 8 星，持续活跃。其可插拔设计和广泛社区支持使其成为项目标配。
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript 开发者 —— 用于代码质量检查和风格统一
开源项目维护者 —— 集成到 CI 流程，自动检查代码规范
团队协作 —— 通过共享配置确保跨成员代码一致性

en.tag: The guardian of JavaScript code quality, a powerful static analysis tool
en.what: ESLint is a tool for identifying and reporting patterns in ECMAScript/JavaScript code. With a pluggable rule system, it helps developers find and fix code issues, ensuring consistent code style and best practices.
en.content: The repository contains ESLint core code, built-in rules, CLI tools, configuration documentation, and a plugin system. It supports installation via npm, with customizable rules and configuration files.
en.stack: Built on Node.js, uses Espree parser for JavaScript parsing, evaluates code patterns via AST. Fully pluggable, every rule is a plugin.
en.hot: ESLint is the most popular static code analysis tool in the JavaScript ecosystem, with 27,428 stars and 8 new stars today, remaining highly active. Its pluggable design and extensive community support make it a standard in projects.
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript developers — for code quality checks and style consistency
Open source maintainers — integrate into CI pipelines for automated code linting
Team collaboration — ensure code consistency across members via shared configurations

zh.tag: 反“AI流水线”前端框架，为AI代理注入设计品味与精致UI技能
zh.what: Taste Skill 是一套可移植的 Agent 技能集合，专门解决 AI 生成的前端界面千篇一律、缺乏设计感的问题。它通过结构化的布局、排版、动效和间距规则，让 AI 代理（如 Codex、Cursor、Claude Code）输出更精致、更具品牌感的界面。同时内置图像生成技能，可用于快速生成 Web、移动端和品牌套系的视觉参考板。
zh.content: 仓库包含一系列可复用的 Agent Skill 模块（前端布局、排版、动效、间距规范）以及图像生成提示词与参考板模板，支持与 ChatGPT Images 等工具链配合后交由主流 AI 编程助手实现。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 构建，兼容 Vercel Labs 的 Agent Skills 生态，可与 ChatGPT Images、Codex、Cursor、Claude Code 等主流 AI 工具链无缝集成。
zh.hot: 在 AI 生成代码泛滥导致界面同质化严重的背景下，Taste Skill 切中了开发者对“AI 审美”的痛点；仓库已获 64.7k Star，本月新增 19.1k，位列 GitHub JavaScript 月榜第 3，足见社区对反“AI 流水线”设计的强烈需求。
uses: 前端开发者/AI 辅助编程用户 —— 想让 Cursor/Codex 输出更精致、不千篇一律的界面
设计师与创意开发者 —— 需要快速生成品牌视觉参考板并直接落地为代码
独立开发者/创业公司 —— 在缺少专职设计师时，用结构化技能提升产品 UI 质感
AI Agent 构建者 —— 希望为自研 Agent 集成反“slop”的前端设计与实现能力

en.tag: Anti-slop agent skills framework that gives AI builders design taste
en.what: Taste Skill is a portable set of agent skills that upgrades AI-built interfaces with stronger layout, typography, motion, and spacing to eliminate generic-looking UIs. It acts as an anti-slop frontend framework, giving AI agents like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code a refined design taste. The repo also includes image-generation skills for creating reference boards for web, mobile, and brand kits.
en.content: The repository contains reusable agent skill modules covering frontend layout, typography, motion, and spacing guidelines, along with image-generation prompts and reference board templates designed to be paired with tools like ChatGPT Images and implemented via Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code.
en.stack: Built primarily in JavaScript and compatible with the Vercel Labs Agent Skills ecosystem, it integrates seamlessly with mainstream AI toolchains including ChatGPT Images, Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
en.hot: As AI-generated code floods the web with homogenized interfaces, Taste Skill strikes a nerve by curing AI's bad taste; it has amassed 64.7k stars with 19.1k added this month alone, ranking 3rd on GitHub's JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers using AI-assisted coding who want Cursor/Codex to produce polished, non-generic UIs
Designers and creative developers looking to rapidly generate brand reference boards and turn them into code
Indie hackers and startups needing to elevate product UI quality without dedicated designers
AI agent builders seeking to equip their agents with anti-slop frontend design and implementation skills

zh.tag: 高性能低开销的 Node.js Web 框架，专注开发者体验与插件生态
zh.what: Fastify 是一个专为 Node.js 设计的高性能 Web 框架，致力于在提供卓越开发者体验的同时保持极低的服务器开销。它通过强大的插件架构让开发者能够快速构建可扩展的后端服务，并在高负载下依然保持出色的响应速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Fastify v5 核心源码、完整的类型定义、官方文档网站源码，以及丰富的示例和基准测试脚本。核心由轻量级的路由引擎、请求生命周期管理器和插件系统组成，配套有完善的 CI/CD 工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 运行时开发，核心使用 JavaScript 编写并完整支持 TypeScript，依赖 find-my-way 高性能路由库、Pino 日志库，以及 @fastify 系列官方插件。
zh.hot: 拥有 36.7k Star 的 Fastify 凭借比 Express 更低的性能开销和原生的异步/等待支持，成为 Node.js 生态中构建高并发服务的首选框架之一。本周新增 85 Star 并冲入 JavaScript 周榜第 7，反映出社区对其 v5 版本稳定性与插件生态的持续认可。
uses: 需要支撑高并发 API 服务的后端开发团队
希望从 Express 迁移到更现代、更低开销框架的 Node.js 开发者
构建微服务架构并需要强大插件扩展能力的工程师
追求高性能日志与请求链路管理的运维型开发者

en.tag: High-performance, low-overhead Node.js web framework with plugin architecture
en.what: Fastify is a high-performance web framework for Node.js designed to deliver the best developer experience with minimal overhead. Its powerful plugin architecture enables developers to build scalable backend services that maintain excellent responsiveness under heavy load.

物联网设备 —— 设备间直接通信，绕过 NAT 限制

en.what: Iroh is a networking library that lets apps connect via public keys instead of IP addresses. It handles NAT traversal and connection maintenance automatically, ensuring the fastest path.
en.content: The repo contains the core iroh library, examples, and protocols built on iroh (iroh-blobs, iroh-gossip, iroh-docs). It provides Rust API and CLI tools.
en.stack: Written in Rust, built on QUIC (via the noq library), and uses BLAKE3 hashing for content addressing.
en.hot: Iroh solves the pain of changing IPs and NAT traversal in P2P connections with a simple public-key dialing API, gaining significant traction. Currently 11,850 stars, +10 today.
uses: Decentralized app developers — need reliable P2P connections without managing IPs
IoT devices — direct device-to-device communication bypassing NAT
File sync and sharing — use iroh-blobs for large-scale content-addressed transfer

zh.tag: 免费 DPI 绕过工具，利用 Google Apps Script 中继
zh.what: 这是一个用 Rust 重写的免费 DPI 绕过工具，通过部署在个人 Google 账户中的 Google Apps Script 作为中继，隐藏真实访问目标。它让 ISP 只看到加密流量发往 www.google.com，从而绕过审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、跨平台桌面 UI（CLI + GUI）、HTTP/SOCKS5 代理支持，以及详细的英文和波斯文文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Google Apps Script 作为中继，无运行时依赖，支持 Mac/Windows/Linux/Android/OpenWRT。
zh.hot: 完全免费且无需额外服务器，利用 Google 免费额度实现翻墙，吸引了大量关注，今日新增 18 星，总星数 3655。
uses: 受网络审查地区的用户 —— 免费访问被屏蔽网站
技术爱好者 —— 研究 DPI 绕过和 Google Apps Script 中继技术
需要临时翻墙的用户 —— 快速部署，无需复杂配置

en.tag: Free DPI bypass via Google Apps Script relay with TLS SNI concealment
en.what: A free DPI bypass tool rewritten in Rust that uses a Google Apps Script deployed in your own Google account as a relay to conceal the real destination. Your ISP only sees encrypted traffic to www.google.com, effectively bypassing censorship.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, a cross-platform desktop UI (CLI + GUI), HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy support, and detailed documentation in English and Persian.
en.stack: Built with Rust, relies on Google Apps Script as a relay, no runtime dependencies, supports Mac/Windows/Linux/Android/OpenWRT.
en.hot: Completely free and requires no extra server, leveraging Google's free tier to bypass censorship, attracting significant attention with 18 new stars today and 3655 total stars.
uses: Users in censored regions — free access to blocked websites
Tech enthusiasts — studying DPI bypass and Google Apps Script relay techniques
Users needing temporary circumvention — quick deployment without complex setup

zh.tag: 你的个人AI超级智能：本地优先的记忆、代理编排与深度研究
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一个开源的 AI 框架，旨在成为用户的个人超级智能。它能够构建本地优先的生活记忆，编排代理集群和工作流，并执行深度研究。

开发者 —— 集成和扩展代理编排、深度研究功能
隐私敏感者 —— 使用本地优先方案，避免云端数据泄露

en.tag: Your personal AI super intelligence: local-first memory, agent orchestration, and deep research
en.what: OpenHuman is an open-source AI framework designed to be your personal super intelligence. It builds a local-first memory of your life, orchestrates agent fleets and workflows, and performs deep research.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine, memory system, agent orchestration modules, and deep research tools, with CLI and possibly GUI interfaces.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, likely leveraging LLM APIs, vector databases, etc., with a focus on local-first and performance.
en.hot: With 35K+ stars, OpenHuman has gone viral for offering a local-first, open-source personal AI super intelligence, addressing user demand for privacy and powerful AI agents.
uses: Personal users — build local memory and AI assistant for daily life and work
Developers — integrate and extend agent orchestration and deep research capabilities
Privacy-conscious users — leverage local-first approach to avoid cloud data leaks

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 会议助手，实时转录并自动总结纪要
zh.what: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 开发的 AI 会议助手，支持在 macOS 和 Windows 上实现 100% 本地化的实时会议转录、说话人分离与智能总结。它无需云端连接，通过 Parakeet/Whisper 实现 4 倍速实时转录，并借助 Ollama 自动生成会议纪要，满足企业对隐私与合规的严苛要求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理与转录引擎、Ollama 集成模块，以及面向 macOS 和 Windows 的预编译安装包和演示文档。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 构建以保证高性能与低资源占用，集成 Parakeet/Whisper 语音识别模型实现实时转录，并通过 Ollama 在本地运行大模型完成会议总结。
zh.hot: 在数据隐私监管日益严格的背景下，其「100% 本地处理、零云端」的架构精准击中了企业合规痛点；凭借 25.3K Star 和本月新增 2,854 Star 登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8，显示出市场对隐私优先型生产力工具的强烈需求。
uses: 企业合规团队 —— 需在完全离线环境下处理敏感会议内容，满足数据主权与隐私合规要求。
远程办公用户 —— 希望自动获得带说话人分离的实时转录与会议纪要，无需上传云端。
开发者与隐私爱好者 —— 寻求可自托管、可审计的开源会议工具，并能基于 Rust 源码二次定制。
咨询与法律行业 —— 在客户机密对话场景中，要求本地存储且可控的 AI 会议记录方案。

en.tag: Privacy-first AI meeting assistant with local transcription & summarization
en.what: Meetily is a Rust-built, privacy-first AI meeting assistant that delivers 100% on-device live transcription, speaker diarization, and smart summarization for macOS and Windows. It runs entirely offline using Parakeet/Whisper for 4x faster real-time transcription and Ollama for automated meeting minutes, ensuring enterprises retain full data sovereignty without cloud dependencies.
en.content: The repository houses the full desktop client source code, a Rust-based local audio processing and transcription engine, Ollama integration modules, along with pre-built installers and documentation for macOS and Windows.
en.stack: The core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage, integrating Parakeet/Whisper speech recognition for real-time transcription and leveraging Ollama to run LLMs locally for meeting summarization.
en.hot: Amid tightening data privacy regulations, its "100% local processing, zero cloud" architecture directly addresses enterprise compliance pain points; its 25.3K stars and 2,854 new stars this month—ranking 8th on GitHub Trending—signal strong market demand for privacy-first productivity tools.
uses: Enterprise compliance teams —— Process sensitive meetings in fully offline environments to meet data sovereignty and privacy requirements.
Remote professionals —— Automatically obtain real-time transcripts with speaker diarization and summaries without cloud uploads.
Developers and privacy advocates —— Seek a self-hostable, auditable open-source meeting tool that can be customized via the Rust codebase.
Consulting and legal sectors —— Handle confidential client conversations with locally stored, fully controllable AI meeting records.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的 JS/TS 打包器，兼容 Rollup API
zh.what: Rolldown 是一个用 Rust 编写的 JavaScript/TypeScript 打包器，旨在成为 Vite 未来的底层打包工具。它提供与 Rollup 兼容的 API 和插件接口，但在性能上更接近 esbuild。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 源码、Node.js 绑定（N-API）、CLI 工具、以及基于 Rollup 插件的兼容层。提供 npm 包和 WASM 支持。
zh.stack: 主要语言 Rust，使用 N-API 桥接 Node.js，依赖 Rollup 插件生态。支持多平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）和 WASM。
zh.hot: 作为 Vite 未来的核心打包器，Rolldown 吸引了大量关注。13.8k Stars 反映了社区对其高性能和 Rollup 兼容性的期待。
uses: Vite 用户 —— 期待更快构建体验的开发者
Rollup 插件作者 —— 希望复用现有生态
性能敏感项目 —— 需要快速打包的大型 JS/TS 应用

en.tag: Fast Rust bundler for JS/TS with Rollup-compatible API
en.what: Rolldown is a JavaScript/TypeScript bundler written in Rust, intended to serve as the future bundler used in Vite. It provides Rollup-compatible APIs and plugin interface, but is more similar to esbuild in scope and performance.
en.content: The repo contains core Rust source code, Node.js bindings via N-API, a CLI tool, and a compatibility layer for Rollup plugins. It offers npm packages and WASM support.
en.stack: Written in Rust with N-API bindings for Node.js, leveraging the Rollup plugin ecosystem. Supports multiple platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows) and WASM.
en.hot: As the future core bundler for Vite, Rolldown has garnered significant attention. Its 13.8k stars reflect the community's anticipation for its high performance and Rollup compatibility.
uses: Vite users — developers seeking faster build times
Rollup plugin authors — those wanting to reuse existing ecosystem
Performance-sensitive projects — large JS/TS apps needing fast bundling

zh.tag: 一种新型的现代化 Shell，结构化管道与数据驱动
zh.what: Nushell 是一种新型的 Shell，它采用结构化数据管道，将命令输出视为表格或列表，支持类似 SQL 的查询、过滤和操作。它旨在提供比传统 Bash/Zsh 更直观、更强大的命令行体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nushell 核心引擎、内置命令、插件系统、配置文件示例以及详细的文档和书籍。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 crates.io 生态，支持跨平台（Linux/macOS/Windows），可通过包管理器安装。
zh.hot: Nushell 以 4 万+ Star 成为最受欢迎的现代 Shell 之一，其结构化管道理念吸引了大量寻求替代传统 Shell 的开发者。
uses: 希望提升命令行效率的开发者 —— 利用结构化数据管道替代文本解析
数据工程师/分析师 —— 直接在终端中处理 CSV、JSON 等结构化数据
Rust 爱好者 —— 学习 Rust 构建 CLI 工具的最佳实践

en.tag: A modern shell with structured pipelines and data-driven design
en.what: Nushell is a new type of shell that treats command output as structured data (tables/lists), enabling SQL-like queries, filtering, and manipulation. It aims to provide a more intuitive and powerful command-line experience than traditional Bash/Zsh.
en.content: The repo includes the Nushell core engine, built-in commands, plugin system, sample config files, and comprehensive documentation including a book.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem, cross-platform (Linux/macOS/Windows), installable via package managers.
en.hot: With 40K+ stars, Nushell is one of the most popular modern shells, attracting developers seeking an alternative to traditional shells with its structured pipeline concept.
uses: Developers seeking more efficient command-line workflows — replace text parsing with structured data pipelines
Data engineers/analysts — process CSV, JSON, and other structured data directly in the terminal
Rust enthusiasts — learn best practices for building CLI tools in Rust

zh.tag: 专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计的 Git 工作树 CLI 工具
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，用于高效管理 Git 工作树，特别针对并行 AI 代理工作流进行了优化。它简化了多分支并行开发场景下的工作树创建、切换和清理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 二进制文件、文档站点源码、CI 配置和测试。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Git 命令进行底层操作，提供终端交互界面。
zh.hot: Worktrunk 发布后迅速成为最流行的 Git 工作树管理器，今日新增 19 星，总星数达 6018，位列 Rust 日榜第 10。其专为 AI 代理并行工作流设计的定位吸引了大量关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 管理多个并行分支的工作树，提升开发效率
多任务开发者 —— 同时处理多个功能分支，快速切换上下文
团队协作 —— 在代码审查和并行开发中保持工作区整洁

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, optimized for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a CLI tool for efficient Git worktree management, specifically optimized for parallel AI agent workflows. It simplifies creating, switching, and cleaning up worktrees in multi-branch parallel development scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust CLI binary, documentation site source, CI configuration, and tests.
en.stack: Built with Rust, relies on Git commands for underlying operations, and provides a terminal interface.
en.hot: Since its release, Worktrunk has quickly become the most popular Git worktree manager, gaining 19 stars today and reaching 6018 total stars, ranking 10th on the Rust daily trending list. Its focus on AI agent parallel workflows has drawn significant attention.
uses: AI agent developers — manage worktrees for multiple parallel branches to boost productivity
Multi-task developers — handle several feature branches simultaneously with quick context switching
Team collaboration — keep workspaces clean during code reviews and parallel development

zh.tag: Rust 语言官方源码仓，包含编译器与标准库
zh.what: Rust 编程语言官方主仓库，包含编译器、标准库及文档。致力于通过所有权模型和类型系统，让开发者构建高性能且内存安全的系统级软件。

区块链/Web3 工程师 —— 构建高效、可靠的智能合约与节点程序
云原生与基础设施开发者 —— 用于编写容器、微服务及 DevOps 工具
编程语言爱好者与研究者 —— 学习现代类型系统、所有权模型及编译器实现

en.tag: Official Rust language source repo with compiler and standard library
en.what: This is the official main source repository for the Rust programming language, containing the compiler, standard library, and documentation. It empowers developers to build reliable and efficient software through its ownership model and rich type system.
en.content: The repository houses the Rust compiler (rustc), standard library, official documentation, test suites, and build scripts.
en.stack: Self-hosted Rust compiler with LLVM backend, accompanied by Cargo, rustfmt, Clippy, and rust-analyzer for a complete toolchain.
en.hot: With 114.7K stars and consistently ranking on the Rust trending list, its zero-cost abstractions and memory safety guarantees have made it the go-to choice for systems programming, blockchain, and cloud-native infrastructure.
uses: Systems programmers building high-performance, memory-safe low-level software
Blockchain and Web3 engineers developing efficient smart contracts and node implementations
Cloud-native and infrastructure developers creating containers, microservices, and DevOps tooling
Programming language enthusiasts and researchers studying modern type systems, ownership models, and compiler design

zh.tag: 容器生态的乐高套件，构建自定义容器系统的开源框架
zh.what: Moby 是 Docker 创建的开源项目，旨在提供模块化的容器工具组件和组装框架，让开发者能够构建自定义的容器化系统。它包含构建工具、注册表、编排工具、运行时等组件，可灵活组合。
zh.content: 仓库包含容器构建工具、容器注册表、编排工具、运行时等组件，以及将这些组件组装成系统的框架。项目遵循模块化、可替换、安全可用、开发者优先等原则。
