zh.hot: 作为 Docker 的上游项目，Moby 拥有 7.2 万星标，是容器生态的核心基础设施，持续吸引开发者关注和贡献。
uses: 容器引擎开发者 —— 基于 Moby 组件构建或定制容器运行时和工具
系统集成商 —— 利用 Moby 的模块化框架组装自定义容器平台
容器技术爱好者 —— 学习容器内部原理并参与开源贡献

en.tag: A Lego set for the container ecosystem to assemble custom container-based systems
en.what: Moby is an open-source project by Docker that provides a modular toolkit and framework for assembling custom container-based systems. It includes components like build tools, registry, orchestration, and runtime, which can be used as building blocks.
en.content: The repository contains container build tools, a container registry, orchestration tools, a runtime, and a framework for assembling them into systems. It follows principles of modularity, swappable components, usable security, and developer focus.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on container runtime, networking, and storage technologies, tightly integrated with the Docker ecosystem.
en.hot: As the upstream for Docker, Moby has 71,908 stars, making it a core infrastructure in the container ecosystem, continuously attracting developer attention and contributions.
uses: Container engine developers — build or customize container runtimes and tools using Moby components
System integrators — assemble custom container platforms with Moby's modular framework
Container enthusiasts — learn container internals and contribute to open source

zh.tag: 用 Go 和 Web 技术构建桌面应用
zh.what: Wails 允许开发者使用 Go 编写后端逻辑，并结合任意前端技术（如 React、Vue）构建跨平台桌面应用。它将 Go 代码和 Web 前端打包成一个单一二进制文件，无需内嵌 Web 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Wails CLI 工具、核心运行时库、模板项目以及丰富的文档和示例。提供了项目创建、编译和打包的完整工具链。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go，前端支持任何 Web 技术（React、Vue、Svelte 等），利用系统原生 WebView 渲染。依赖 Go 标准库和系统 WebView 组件。
zh.hot: Wails 提供了一种轻量、高效的桌面应用开发方式，让 Go 开发者无需学习 Electron 即可构建原生界面。今日新增 81 星，总星数超 35.5k，在 Go 生态中持续受到关注。
uses: Go 开发者希望用熟悉的语言构建跨平台桌面应用
需要轻量级替代 Electron 的桌面应用场景
快速原型开发或构建工具类桌面应用

en.tag: Build desktop applications using Go & Web Technologies
en.what: Wails enables developers to write backend logic in Go and combine it with any frontend technology (e.g., React, Vue) to build cross-platform desktop applications. It wraps Go code and a web frontend into a single binary without requiring a built-in web server.
en.content: The repository includes the Wails CLI tool, core runtime library, project templates, and extensive documentation and examples. It provides a complete toolchain for project creation, compilation, and bundling.
en.stack: Backend uses Go, frontend supports any web technology (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.), leveraging the system's native WebView for rendering. Depends on Go standard library and system WebView components.
en.hot: Wails offers a lightweight and efficient way to build desktop apps, allowing Go developers to create native UIs without learning Electron. With 81 new stars today and over 35.5k total stars, it continues to gain traction in the Go ecosystem.
uses: Go developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps using their familiar language
Scenarios requiring a lightweight alternative to Electron for desktop apps
Rapid prototyping or building tool-type desktop applications

zh.tag: 以太坊协议的官方 Go 语言实现
zh.what: go-ethereum（简称 geth）是以太坊协议的官方 Go 语言实现，提供完整的以太坊节点客户端。它支持运行全节点、归档节点或轻节点，并通过 JSON RPC 接口与其他进程交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心以太坊协议实现、命令行客户端 geth、网络工具 devp2p、合约绑定生成器 abigen 等可执行程序。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 1.23+ 和 C 编译器。
zh.hot: 作为以太坊生态的核心基础设施，持续获得稳定关注，今日新增 15 颗星，总星数超 5.1 万。
uses: 以太坊开发者 —— 运行节点、测试网络或开发 DApp
区块链研究者 —— 研究以太坊协议实现细节
基础设施运维 —— 部署和维护以太坊节点

en.tag: Official Go implementation of the Ethereum protocol
en.what: go-ethereum (geth) is the official Go implementation of the Ethereum protocol, providing a full Ethereum node client. It can run as a full node, archive node, or light node, and exposes JSON RPC endpoints for interaction.
en.content: The repository includes the core Ethereum protocol implementation, the geth CLI client, networking utilities (devp2p), and contract binding generator (abigen).
en.stack: Developed in Go, requires Go 1.23+ and a C compiler.
en.hot: As core infrastructure of the Ethereum ecosystem, it maintains steady attention with 15 new stars today and over 51k total stars.
uses: Ethereum developers — run nodes, testnets, or build DApps
Blockchain researchers — study Ethereum protocol implementation
Infrastructure operators — deploy and maintain Ethereum nodes

zh.tag: 基础设施即代码的行业标准工具
zh.what: Terraform 是一个基础设施即代码工具，允许用户通过声明式配置文件安全、可预测地创建、更改和改进基础设施。它支持众多云服务商和内部解决方案，将 API 编码为可共享、版本控制的配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Terraform 核心引擎，提供 CLI 工具、配置语言（HCL）解析器、状态管理、资源图构建和执行计划生成等核心功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 的配置语言 HCL 和插件系统。
zh.hot: Terraform 是基础设施即代码领域的标杆项目，拥有近 5 万星标，长期稳定在 GitHub 热门榜。其强大的多云管理能力和活跃的社区生态持续吸引开发者。
uses: 云基础设施工程师 —— 使用 Terraform 管理多云环境，实现基础设施自动化部署与变更
DevOps 团队 —— 将基础设施配置纳入版本控制，实现 CI/CD 集成与协作
平台工程师 —— 构建内部开发者平台，提供自助式基础设施服务
初学者 —— 通过 Terraform 学习基础设施即代码概念和实践

en.tag: Industry-standard Infrastructure as Code tool
en.what: Terraform is an Infrastructure as Code tool that enables users to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure using declarative configuration files. It supports numerous cloud providers and in-house solutions, codifying APIs into version-controlled, shareable configurations.
en.content: The repository contains the Terraform core engine, including CLI tools, HCL parser, state management, resource graph construction, and execution plan generation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) and a plugin system.
en.hot: Terraform is the benchmark in IaC with nearly 50k stars, consistently appearing on GitHub trending. Its multi-cloud management capabilities and vibrant community keep attracting developers.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers — manage multi-cloud environments with automated deployment and changes
DevOps teams — version control infrastructure configs for CI/CD integration and collaboration
Platform engineers — build internal developer platforms with self-service infrastructure
Beginners — learn Infrastructure as Code concepts and practices via Terraform

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与调度平台
zh.what: Kubernetes（K8s）是开源的容器集群管理系统，用于自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用。它基于 Google 十五年大规模运行生产工作负载的 Borg 系统经验构建，能够跨多台主机实现高效的资源调度与自愈。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面组件（kube-apiserver、kube-scheduler、kube-controller-manager）、节点代理 kubelet、命令行工具 kubectl，以及完整的内置 API 和丰富的扩展机制（如 CRD、Operator、CNI/CSI/CRI 插件接口）。
zh.stack: 核心以 Go 语言编写，使用 etcd 作为分布式键值存储，组件间通过 gRPC/HTTP 通信，并基于容器运行时接口（CRI）对接 Docker、containerd 等底层运行时。
zh.hot: 作为云原生技术栈的基石，Kubernetes 拥有近 12.4 万 Star，本月新增 1,895 星，稳居 Go 语言月榜第 13 位，几乎已成为现代云基础设施的事实标准控制平面。
uses: 云原生 / SRE / DevOps 工程师构建高可用、可扩展的微服务架构
企业运维团队统一调度混合云、多云及本地数据中心的容器集群
平台开发者基于 K8s API 与 CRD 扩展能力构建内部 PaaS 或 Serverless 平台
开源贡献者与 CNCF 生态参与者投身核心基础设施演进

en.tag: Production-Grade Container Orchestration and Scheduling Platform
en.what: Kubernetes is an open-source system for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across multiple hosts. Built on Google’s 15+ years of experience running production workloads at scale with Borg, it provides a robust, self-healing framework for distributed systems.
en.content: The repository hosts the core control plane components (kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager), the node agent kubelet, the CLI tool kubectl, as well as comprehensive built-in APIs and extensive extension mechanisms such as CRD, Operator, and CNI/CSI/CRI interfaces.
en.stack: The core is written in Go, relying on etcd as the distributed key-value store, using gRPC/HTTP for inter-component communication, and integrating with underlying runtimes such as Docker and containerd via the Container Runtime Interface (CRI).
en.hot: As the cornerstone of cloud-native technology, Kubernetes boasts nearly 123.8k stars, with 1,895 new stars this month, ranking 13th on the Go Trending monthly list, making it the de facto standard control plane for modern cloud infrastructure.
uses: Cloud-native, SRE, and DevOps engineers building highly available, scalable microservices architectures
Enterprise ops teams managing hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud, and on-premises container clusters
Platform developers building internal PaaS or Serverless platforms using the K8s API and CRD extensions
Open-source contributors and CNCF ecosystem participants driving core infrastructure evolution

zh.tag: Go 语言测试利器，断言与模拟工具包
zh.what: Testify 是一个 Go 语言测试工具包，提供简洁的断言、模拟对象和测试套件功能。它与标准库无缝集成，帮助开发者编写可读性强、易于维护的测试代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 assert（断言）、mock（模拟）、suite（测试套件）等子包，提供丰富的断言函数和模拟接口。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，依赖标准库 testing 包。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 生态中最流行的测试库之一，拥有 26k+ Star，持续活跃维护，是 Go 开发者编写测试的首选工具。
uses: Go 开发者编写单元测试和集成测试
需要模拟接口或对象的测试场景
希望提升测试代码可读性和维护性的团队

en.tag: A Go testing toolkit with assertions and mocking
en.what: Testify is a Go testing toolkit that provides easy assertions, mocking, and test suite support. It integrates seamlessly with the standard library, helping developers write readable and maintainable test code.
en.content: The repository includes sub-packages like assert, mock, and suite, offering a rich set of assertion functions and mocking interfaces.
en.stack: Pure Go implementation, depends on the standard testing package.
en.hot: As one of the most popular testing libraries in the Go ecosystem, with 26k+ Stars, it's actively maintained and the go-to tool for writing tests in Go.
uses: Go developers writing unit and integration tests
Scenarios requiring mocking of interfaces or objects
Teams aiming to improve test code readability and maintainability

zh.tag: Go 应用的完整配置解决方案
zh.what: Viper 是一个为 Go 应用设计的完整配置库，支持多种配置源（文件、环境变量、远程系统等），并具备实时监控和更新配置的能力。它遵循 12-Factor 应用原则，能够处理所有类型的配置需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Viper 库的源代码、文档和示例，支持 JSON、TOML、YAML 等多种配置文件格式，并提供命令行标志绑定和远程配置读取功能。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，依赖 Go Modules 管理，支持 Etcd、Consul 等远程配置后端。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 生态中最流行的配置库之一，Viper 拥有超过 30k Stars，被 Hugo、Docker Notary 等众多知名项目采用，稳定性和实用性备受认可。
uses: Go 开发者 —— 快速集成配置管理到任何 Go 应用
微服务架构 —— 统一管理多环境配置
CLI 工具开发者 —— 结合命令行标志和配置文件

en.tag: Complete configuration solution for Go applications
en.what: Viper is a complete configuration solution for Go applications, supporting multiple configuration sources (files, environment variables, remote systems, etc.) with live watching and updating capabilities. It follows 12-Factor app principles and handles all types of configuration needs.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, and examples for the Viper library, supporting multiple config file formats like JSON, TOML, YAML, along with command-line flag binding and remote config reading.
en.stack: Pure Go implementation, uses Go Modules for dependency management, supports remote config backends like Etcd and Consul.
en.hot: As one of the most popular configuration libraries in the Go ecosystem, Viper has over 30k stars and is adopted by many well-known projects like Hugo and Docker Notary, earning widespread recognition for its stability and practicality.
uses: Go developers — quickly integrate configuration management into any Go application
Microservice architectures — unify multi-environment configuration
CLI tool developers — combine command-line flags and config files

zh.tag: 基于 YAML 模板的快速漏洞扫描器，安全社区驱动
zh.what: Nuclei 是一款高性能的漏洞扫描工具，通过简洁的 YAML 领域特定语言让全球安全社区协作编写检测模板。它能够快速发现应用程序、API、网络、DNS 及云配置中的安全漏洞，并以极低的误报率模拟真实攻击场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心扫描引擎、YAML 模板解析器、丰富的官方模板库以及多协议支持模块（HTTP/DNS/TCP/SSL 等），同时提供完善的 CLI 工具和 SDK 集成接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，依托 YAML 模板引擎实现漏洞检测逻辑。支持跨平台运行并可与 CI/CD 流程及各类云原生工具链无缝集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 29,811 Stars 和本周新增 228 Stars 的热度，Nuclei 已成为安全社区事实上的漏洞扫描标准。其 YAML 模板生态让全球研究者能够实时响应最新漏洞，实现了「当天漏洞、当天检测」的协作式安全防御。
uses: 企业安全团队 —— 用于资产梳理、漏洞巡检与红蓝对抗演练
渗透测试工程师 —— 快速验证目标环境中已知 CVE 与配置缺陷
DevSecOps 工程师 —— 集成至 CI/CD 流水线实现自动化安全左移
安全研究员 —— 编写并共享 YAML 模板，跟踪分析最新漏洞趋势

en.tag: Fast, community-powered vulnerability scanner using YAML templates
en.what: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner that uses a simple YAML-based DSL to enable global security collaboration on detection templates. It rapidly identifies vulnerabilities across applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations while mimicking real-world attack scenarios with minimal false positives.
en.content: The repository houses the core scanning engine, YAML template parser, extensive official template libraries, and multi-protocol support modules (HTTP/DNS/TCP/SSL), along with a comprehensive CLI tool and SDK integration interfaces.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on a YAML template engine for vulnerability detection logic. It supports cross-platform execution and integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and various cloud-native toolchains.
en.hot: With 29,811 Stars and 228 new Stars this week, Nuclei has become the de facto standard for community-driven vulnerability scanning. Its YAML template ecosystem allows global researchers to respond to emerging threats in real time, enabling same-day detection of trending vulnerabilities through collaborative security defense.
uses: Enterprise security teams — for asset inventory, vulnerability patrols, and red/blue team exercises
Penetration testers — to rapidly verify known CVEs and misconfigurations in target environments
DevSecOps engineers — integrating into CI/CD pipelines for automated shift-left security
Security researchers — writing and sharing YAML templates to track and analyze emerging vulnerability trends

zh.tag: 终端AI编程代理，已迁移至Crush
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个基于终端的 AI 编程助手，提供交互式 TUI 界面，支持多种 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），可执行命令、搜索文件、修改代码，并集成 LSP 和会话管理。项目已归档并迁移至 Charm 团队维护的 Crush。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具，提供 TUI（基于 Bubble Tea）、多 AI 提供商支持、会话管理、工具集成（命令执行、文件搜索、代码修改）、Vim 风格编辑器、SQLite 持久化存储、LSP 集成、文件变更追踪等功能。
zh.stack: Go 语言，依赖 Bubble Tea（TUI 框架）、SQLite（持久化）、LSP（代码智能），支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 等多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 尽管已归档，但凭借强大的终端 AI 编程体验和 13.5k+ Stars 持续吸引关注，今日新增 14 Stars，位列 Go 趋势榜第 11 名。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中直接获得 AI 编程辅助，无需离开命令行
AI 模型爱好者 —— 可切换多种 AI 提供商，对比不同模型表现
终端重度用户 —— 享受 TUI 界面和 Vim 风格编辑的流畅体验

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent, migrated to Crush
en.what: OpenCode is a terminal-based AI coding assistant with an interactive TUI, supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.), capable of executing commands, searching files, modifying code, and integrating LSP and session management. The project is archived and has moved to Crush maintained by the Charm team.
en.content: The repository contains a Go CLI tool with a TUI (built with Bubble Tea), multi-AI provider support, session management, tool integration (command execution, file search, code modification), Vim-like editor, SQLite persistence, LSP integration, and file change tracking.
en.stack: Go language, with Bubble Tea (TUI framework), SQLite (persistence), LSP (code intelligence), and support for multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, etc.
en.hot: Despite being archived, it continues to attract attention with its powerful terminal AI coding experience and 13.5k+ Stars, gaining 14 new stars today and ranking 11th on Go Trending.
uses: Developers — get AI coding assistance directly in the terminal without leaving the command line
AI model enthusiasts — switch between multiple AI providers to compare model performance
Heavy terminal users — enjoy a smooth TUI interface and Vim-like editing experience

zh.tag: Go 注释自动生成 Swagger 2.0 API 文档
zh.what: swag 是一个 Go 库，通过解析 Go 注释中的声明，自动生成符合 Swagger 2.0 规范的 RESTful API 文档。它支持多种主流 Go Web 框架，如 Gin、Echo 等，并能与 Swagger UI 集成，方便开发者快速为现有项目添加交互式文档。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 swag（注释解析与文档生成）、命令行工具 swag init/format、以及针对 Gin、Echo、net/http 等框架的插件。还提供了丰富的示例和声明式注释格式说明。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，依赖 Go 标准库及 go/ast 用于解析注释。可选集成 Swagger UI 前端。
zh.hot: 拥有 12931 颗星，作为 Go 生态中自动生成 Swagger 文档的事实标准，持续活跃维护，今日新增 9 星，位列 Go 日榜第 12 名。
uses: Go 后端开发者 —— 快速为 RESTful API 生成 Swagger 文档，减少手动编写
API 文档维护者 —— 通过注释保持文档与代码同步，避免过时
团队协作场景 —— 结合 Swagger UI 提供交互式 API 测试界面

en.tag: Automatically generate Swagger 2.0 RESTful API docs from Go annotations
en.what: swag is a Go library that automatically generates Swagger 2.0 compliant RESTful API documentation by parsing annotations in Go comments. It supports popular Go web frameworks like Gin and Echo, and integrates with Swagger UI to quickly add interactive docs to existing projects.
en.content: The repo includes the core library for annotation parsing and doc generation, CLI tools (swag init/format), plugins for Gin, Echo, net/http, etc., along with examples and declarative comment format documentation.
en.stack: Pure Go implementation, leveraging Go standard library and go/ast for comment parsing. Optionally integrates with Swagger UI frontend.
en.hot: With 12,931 stars, it's the de facto standard for auto-generating Swagger docs in the Go ecosystem. It's actively maintained, gaining 9 stars today and ranking #12 on Go daily trending.
uses: Go backend developers — quickly generate Swagger docs for RESTful APIs, reducing manual work
API doc maintainers — keep docs in sync with code via annotations, preventing outdated docs
Team collaboration — integrate with Swagger UI for interactive API testing

zh.tag: 开源编程语言，构建简单、可靠、高效的软件
zh.what: Go 是一种静态类型、编译型编程语言，设计用于简化系统编程。它支持并发、垃圾回收，并拥有丰富的标准库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编译器的源代码、标准库、文档和测试用例。目录结构包括 src、lib、doc 等，支持从源码构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言自举编译，依赖 C 编译器（如 gcc）和 Plan 9 汇编器。构建系统使用 Go 工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 语言的官方仓库，持续获得高关注。今日新增 27 星，总星数超 13.5 万，稳居 GitHub 最受欢迎项目之列。
uses: 后端开发者 —— 使用 Go 构建高性能微服务或 CLI 工具
系统程序员 —— 学习或贡献系统级编程语言实现
DevOps 工程师 —— 利用 Go 的并发特性开发云原生应用

en.tag: Open source programming language for building simple, reliable, efficient software
en.what: Go is a statically typed, compiled programming language designed for simplicity in systems programming. It features concurrency, garbage collection, and a rich standard library.
en.content: The repository contains the Go compiler source code, standard library, documentation, and tests. Directory structure includes src, lib, doc, etc., supporting build from source.
en.stack: Bootstrapped primarily in Go, with dependencies on a C compiler (e.g., gcc) and Plan 9 assembler. Build system uses the Go toolchain.
en.hot: As the official Go language repository, it maintains high attention. Gaining 27 stars today, total stars exceed 135k, consistently among GitHub's most popular projects.
uses: Backend developers — build high-performance microservices or CLI tools with Go
Systems programmers — learn or contribute to a systems-level language implementation
DevOps engineers — leverage Go's concurrency for cloud-native applications

zh.tag: 世界上最快的静态网站生成框架
zh.what: Hugo 是一个用 Go 编写的静态网站生成器，以速度和灵活性著称。它能在数秒内渲染完整站点，支持多语言、高级模板系统和强大的分类法。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hugo 核心引擎、CLI 工具、模板系统、资产管道以及完整的文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库及部分外部库，支持通过 Hugo Modules 扩展。
zh.hot: Hugo 拥有 89k+ Star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的静态站点生成器之一，因其极快的构建速度和丰富的主题生态持续吸引用户。
uses: 个人博客和简历网站 —— 快速搭建并部署静态内容
企业和文档站点 —— 利用多语言和分类法管理大量内容
作品集和落地页 —— 通过灵活模板快速创建视觉页面

en.tag: The world's fastest framework for building websites
en.what: Hugo is a static site generator written in Go, known for its speed and flexibility. It renders a complete site in seconds, supporting multilingual, advanced templating, and powerful taxonomy.
en.content: The repo includes Hugo's core engine, CLI tool, templating system, asset pipeline, and comprehensive documentation and installation guides.
en.stack: Developed in Go, relying on Go standard library and some external libraries, extensible via Hugo Modules.
en.hot: With 89k+ stars, Hugo is one of the most popular static site generators on GitHub, attracting users for its blazing-fast build speed and rich theme ecosystem.
uses: Personal blogs and resume sites — quickly build and deploy static content
Corporate and documentation sites — manage large content with multilingual and taxonomy
Portfolios and landing pages — create visual pages quickly with flexible templates

zh.tag: 云原生 MySQL 水平扩展数据库集群系统
zh.what: Vitess 是一个围绕 MySQL 构建的云原生水平可扩展分布式数据库系统，通过通用分片实现无限扩展。它使应用代码和数据库查询对数据分布在多个数据库服务器上保持透明，并支持在几秒内原子化地拆分和合并分片。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Vitess 核心引擎、VTGate 代理、VTTablet 守护进程、Topology 服务以及管理工具，支持分片、连接池、查询重写、在线模式变更等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 MySQL 协议、gRPC、etcd/ZooKeeper 等，支持 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: 作为 YouTube 自 2011 年使用的核心数据库组件，Vitess 已被 Slack、Square、京东等大型公司采用，拥有 2.1 万+ Star，是云原生数据库分片领域的标杆项目。
uses: 需要水平扩展 MySQL 的互联网公司，尤其是 SaaS 和电商平台
希望将 MySQL 迁移到 Kubernetes 的 DevOps 团队
构建高可用、多租户数据库服务的云原生开发者

en.tag: Cloud-native horizontally scalable distributed database system for MySQL
en.what: Vitess is a cloud-native horizontally scalable distributed database system built around MySQL, achieving unlimited scaling through generalized sharding. It keeps application code and queries agnostic to data distribution across multiple servers, and supports atomic shard splitting and merging in seconds.
en.content: The repo contains the Vitess core engine, VTGate proxy, VTTablet daemon, topology service, and management tools, supporting sharding, connection pooling, query rewriting, online schema changes, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on MySQL protocol, gRPC, etcd/ZooKeeper, and supports Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: As a core database component used by YouTube since 2011, Vitess has been adopted by large companies like Slack, Square, and JD.com, with 21k+ stars, making it a benchmark in cloud-native database sharding.
uses: Internet companies needing horizontal MySQL scaling, especially SaaS and e-commerce platforms
DevOps teams migrating MySQL to Kubernetes
Cloud-native developers building high-availability, multi-tenant database services

zh.tag: 本地运行开源大模型的极简工具
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让开发者能在本地快速运行和管理开源大模型的工具。它支持 Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等主流模型，并提供简洁的 CLI 和 REST API。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的 Go 语言源码、安装脚本（macOS/Windows/Linux/Docker）、Python 和 JavaScript 客户端库，以及模型库和集成文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，后端依赖 llama.cpp 进行模型推理，提供 REST API 和 Python/JS SDK。
zh.hot: 176k+ Stars 彰显其作为本地 AI 基础设施的统治地位，本周新增 594 Stars 热度不减。支持最新模型和 Claude Code 等集成，持续吸引开发者。
uses: 开发者 —— 本地测试和调试开源大模型
AI 应用构建者 —— 通过 REST API 集成模型到应用
隐私敏感用户 —— 本地运行模型避免数据外传
学习研究 —— 快速体验不同模型无需云服务

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with ease
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets developers quickly run and manage open-source large language models locally. It supports mainstream models like Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, and provides a simple CLI and REST API.
en.content: The repo contains Ollama's Go source code, install scripts (macOS/Windows/Linux/Docker), Python and JavaScript client libraries, model library, and integration docs.
en.stack: Built with Go, backend relies on llama.cpp for model inference, provides REST API and Python/JS SDKs.
en.hot: With 176k+ stars, it dominates as local AI infrastructure; 594 new stars this week show sustained interest. Support for latest models and integrations like Claude Code keeps developers engaged.
uses: Developers — test and debug open-source LLMs locally
AI app builders — integrate models via REST API
Privacy-conscious users — run models locally to avoid data leaks
Learners — quickly try different models without cloud services

zh.tag: 面向AI代理的高性能代码智能引擎，支持257种语言
zh.what: Gortex 是一个高性能的代码智能引擎，专为 AI 代理和 IDE 设计。它将代码索引为图结构，并通过 CLI、MCP Server 和 Web UI 暴露功能，支持多仓库和 257 种语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个单一静态二进制文件，无依赖链，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。提供 175 个可配置的 MCP 工具，以及基于 tree-sitter AST 分析和编译器级解析的持久化知识图谱。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 tree-sitter 进行语法解析，支持多种编译器级解析（如 Python、TypeScript、Go 等）。
zh.hot: Gortex 因其极致的 token 优化（最高减少 50 倍）和零依赖的易用性而受到关注，当前在 GitHub 上获得 953 颗星，并进入 Go 语言日榜。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 集成到 Claude Code、Cursor 等 19 种编码代理中，减少 token 消耗
IDE 用户 —— 通过 MCP Server 或 Web UI 获取代码智能，支持多仓库
性能敏感场景 —— 需要高效代码解析和跨服务调用链分析的团队

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents, supporting 257 languages
en.what: Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine designed for AI agents and IDEs. It indexes code into a graph and exposes functionality via CLI, MCP Server, and Web UI, supporting multiple repositories and 257 languages.
en.content: The repository contains a single static binary with no dependency chain, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It offers 175 configurable MCP tools and a persistent knowledge graph built from tree-sitter AST analysis and compiler-grade resolution.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging tree-sitter for grammar parsing, with compiler-grade resolution for languages like Python, TypeScript, Go, and more.
en.hot: Gortex gains attention for its extreme token optimization (up to 50x reduction) and zero-dependency ease of use, currently with 953 stars and trending in Go daily.
uses: AI agent developers — integrate with 19 coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor to reduce token usage
IDE users — access code intelligence via MCP Server or Web UI with multi-repo support
Performance-sensitive scenarios — teams needing efficient code parsing and cross-service call chain analysis

zh.tag: 云原生监控告警系统与多维时序数据库
zh.what: Prometheus 是 CNCF 毕业项目，通过拉取模式采集目标指标，基于多维数据模型存储时序数据，并提供 PromQL 查询与灵活的告警规则。它能独立完成监控、可视化与告警闭环，无需依赖分布式存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prometheus 主服务源码、PromQL 查询引擎、告警规则评估器、HTTP API、多种服务发现适配器，以及官方文档与架构图。
zh.stack: 以 Go 为主语言实现，支持通过 HTTP 拉取或 Push Gateway 接收指标，可与 Grafana 等可视化工具及多种服务发现后端（Kubernetes、Consul 等）集成。
zh.hot: 作为云原生监控的事实标准，Prometheus 已积累 65,191 Stars，本周新增 277，位列 GitHub Go 周榜第 14，是 Kubernetes 生态不可或缺的观测基础设施。
uses: SRE / 运维团队 —— 构建云原生监控与统一告警体系
后端开发者 —— 为微服务与容器集群埋点暴露指标
企业 IT 架构 —— 进行基础设施监控、容量规划与故障定位
平台厂商 —— 集成或基于 Prometheus 二次开发可观测性产品

en.tag: Cloud-native monitoring and multi-dimensional time series database
en.what: A CNCF graduated project that scrapes metrics from targets using a pull model, stores them in a multi-dimensional time series model, and offers PromQL querying with flexible alerting. It operates as autonomous single nodes without distributed storage dependencies.
en.content: The repository holds the Prometheus server source, PromQL query engine, rule evaluator, HTTP APIs, various service discovery adapters, plus official documentation and architecture diagrams.
en.stack: Implemented primarily in Go, supporting HTTP scraping or Push Gateway ingestion, and integrating with visualization tools like Grafana and service discovery backends such as Kubernetes and Consul.
en.hot: With 65,191 stars and 277 new this week, it ranks #14 on GitHub's Go Trending weekly list, serving as the de facto observability standard in the Kubernetes and cloud-native ecosystem.
uses: SRE / DevOps teams — building unified cloud-native monitoring and alerting stacks
Backend developers — instrumenting microservices and container clusters with metrics
Enterprise IT — monitoring infrastructure, capacity planning, and incident diagnosis
Platform vendors — integrating or extending Prometheus for commercial observability offerings

zh.tag: 纯 Go 实现的 QUIC 协议库，生产级 HTTP/3 支持
zh.what: quic-go 是用纯 Go 语言实现的 QUIC 协议库，完全遵循 RFC 9000 系列标准。它支持 HTTP/3、QPACK、HTTP Datagrams 等扩展，并提供 FIPS 140-3 兼容性，适用于生产环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 QUIC 协议实现，包括传输层、HTTP/3 支持、QPACK 压缩、不可靠数据报扩展等。提供详细的文档和示例，并集成了 qlog 事件日志。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，无外部依赖，使用 Go 标准库加密（FIPS 模式）。支持 Go 1.26+ 的 FIPS 140-3 环境。
zh.hot: QUIC 协议在 HTTP/3 和低延迟网络中日益普及，quic-go 作为最成熟的 Go 实现，拥有 11.7k+ Stars，被 AdGuardHome 等知名项目采用。
uses: Go 后端开发者 —— 构建支持 HTTP/3 的 Web 服务器或代理
网络协议研究者 —— 测试和扩展 QUIC 协议特性
需要低延迟、可靠传输的应用 —— 如实时通信、游戏、CDN

en.tag: Production-ready QUIC implementation in pure Go with HTTP/3 support
en.what: quic-go is a pure Go implementation of the QUIC protocol (RFC 9000 series), fully compliant with standards. It supports HTTP/3, QPACK, HTTP Datagrams, and other extensions, with FIPS 140-3 compatibility for production use.
en.content: The repository contains a complete QUIC protocol implementation, including transport layer, HTTP/3 support, QPACK compression, unreliable datagram extension, and more. It provides detailed documentation, examples, and qlog event logging.
en.stack: Pure Go implementation with no external dependencies, using Go standard library cryptography (FIPS mode). Supports FIPS 140-3 environments with Go 1.26+.
en.hot: With QUIC gaining traction in HTTP/3 and low-latency networking, quic-go is the most mature Go implementation, boasting 11.7k+ Stars and adopted by projects like AdGuardHome.
uses: Go backend developers — building HTTP/3-enabled web servers or proxies
Network protocol researchers — testing and extending QUIC features
Applications needing low-latency, reliable transport — e.g., real-time comms, gaming, CDN

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网与远程访问基础设施
zh.what: Tailscale 基于 WireGuard 协议构建安全的虚拟专用网络，让用户无需公网 IP 或端口转发即可将设备组成私有网络。它集成了身份验证和两因素认证（2FA），简化了团队和设备之间的安全远程访问与内网穿透。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 tailscaled 守护进程与 tailscale 命令行工具的核心源码，覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS 及 BSD 系统的网络栈与控制逻辑。移动端 App 的底层网络库亦来源于此，但各平台 GUI 包装代码位于其他独立仓库。
zh.stack: 项目以 Go 语言为主开发，要求使用最新版 Go 1.26 编译，并基于 WireGuard 协议实现加密通信。构建脚本 `build_dist.sh` 用于将版本信息嵌入二进制，支持多种 Linux 发行版及跨平台打包。
zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。
uses: 远程办公团队 —— 无需公网 IP 即可安全访问公司内网与私有云资源
开发运维人员 —— 快速搭建跨云、跨地域的容器与服务器调试网络
个人技术爱好者 —— 将家庭 NAS、树莓派等设备组成加密私有网络
安全合规企业 —— 基于 SSO/2FA 的零信任网络替代传统 VPN 方案

en.tag: Zero-config WireGuard VPN for secure remote access and private networking
en.what: Tailscale builds secure virtual private networks on top of WireGuard, allowing devices to form a private mesh network without public IPs or port forwarding. It integrates identity-based authentication and two-factor authentication (2FA) to simplify secure remote access and intranet penetration for teams and devices.
en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. It also serves as the underlying network library for mobile apps, while platform-specific GUI wrappers reside in separate repositories.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
uses: Remote teams — Securely access corporate intranets and private cloud resources without public IPs
DevOps engineers — Quickly build debug networks across multi-cloud and multi-region servers and containers
Homelab enthusiasts — Encrypt and interconnect personal devices like NAS and Raspberry Pi into a private mesh
Security-focused enterprises — Replace legacy VPNs with zero-trust networking based on SSO and 2FA

zh.tag: Tailscale 控制服务器的开源自托管实现，可自建私有 VPN 控制平面
zh.what: Headscale 是 Tailscale 商业控制服务器的完全开源替代方案，允许用户在自己的服务器上部署私有控制平面，管理 WireGuard 节点、分配 IP 与路由。它专为个人开发者、家庭实验室及小型组织设计，实现去厂商锁定的安全组网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的控制服务端代码、CLI 工具、NixOS 模块及完整文档，提供容器镜像与二进制开发构建，支持多种官方 Tailscale 客户端接入。
zh.stack: 采用 Go 语言开发，基于 WireGuard 协议构建 overlay 网络控制层；作为独立服务端兼容 Tailscale 官方客户端，通过 NAT 穿透实现节点自动发现与组网。
zh.hot: 仓库已收获 41.8k Stars，本周新增 369 星并位列 GitHub Go 周榜第 7，反映出用户对自托管网络主权、去厂商锁定及低成本安全组网的强烈需求。
uses: 自托管爱好者与家庭实验室用户——希望完全掌控网络控制平面，避免依赖第三方商业服务。
中小团队与开源组织——需要低成本、跨地域的加密组网与设备访问控制。
隐私敏感型开发者与运维人员——追求数据不出境，通过自建控制服务器实现端到端加密连接。
寻求厂商替代方案的企业——意图摆脱商业 Tailscale 控制层绑定，实现可审计、可定制的 VPN 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source, self-hosted Tailscale control server for private VPN mesh networks
en.what: Headscale is a fully open-source, self-hosted alternative to the Tailscale commercial control server, letting users deploy their own control plane to manage WireGuard nodes, assign IPs, and share routes. It targets hobbyists, homelabbers, and small organizations seeking a vendor-free, secure mesh network.
en.content: The repository includes the Go-based control server, CLI tools, a NixOS module, and full documentation, shipping container images and development binaries for official Tailscale clients.
en.stack: Written in Go and built on WireGuard for the overlay control plane; it runs as a standalone server compatible with official Tailscale clients, enabling automatic NAT traversal and node discovery.
en.hot: With 41.8k stars and 369 added this week, placing 7th on GitHub's Go Trending, it reflects strong demand for network sovereignty, vendor independence, and low-cost secure mesh networking.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts and homelabbers who want full control over their network control plane without relying on third-party commercial services.
Small teams and open-source organizations needing low-cost, cross-region encrypted mesh and device access control.
Privacy-focused developers and operators seeking data residency and end-to-end encryption through a self-hosted control server.
Businesses looking for vendor independence—aiming to replace the commercial Tailscale control layer with an auditable, customizable VPN infrastructure.

zh.tag: 容器安全沙箱与用户态应用内核，兼容 K8s/Docker
zh.what: gVisor 是 Google 开源的容器应用内核，用 Go 语言在用户态实现了一套 Linux 兼容接口，为容器提供额外的安全隔离层。它通过限制应用对宿主机内核的直接访问，大幅降低容器逃逸风险，同时保持接近原生容器的启动速度与资源开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含 runsc（兼容 OCI 的容器运行时）、Sentry（用户态内核）、Gofer（文件系统代理）等核心组件，以及大量 Linux 系统调用的 Go 语言实现与测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要采用 Go 语言编写，支持 x86_64 与 ARM64 架构；作为 OCI 运行时可直接对接 Docker、containerd 与 Kubernetes 生态。
zh.hot: 在容器安全需求激增的背景下，gVisor 以近 1.9 万 Star 成为云原生沙箱的热门选择，本周新增 85 Star 并跻身 Go 语言周榜第 13 位，体现了社区对"轻量隔离"方案的持续追捧。
uses: 云原生平台运维者 —— 为多租户集群或不可信工作负载提供安全沙箱。
安全合规团队 —— 在保持容器敏捷性的同时满足更严格的内核隔离要求。
边缘与 Serverless 开发者 —— 利用快速启动、低开销的用户态内核运行短时函数或微服务。

en.tag: Userspace application kernel for sandboxed containers with OCI/K8s compatibility
en.what: gVisor is an open-source application kernel from Google that implements a Linux-compatible interface in userspace using Go, adding an extra security isolation layer to containers. By limiting direct access to the host kernel, it significantly reduces container escape risks while maintaining near-native startup speed and resource overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the runsc OCI runtime, the Sentry userspace kernel, the Gofer filesystem proxy, and extensive Go implementations of Linux system calls along with test suites.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go and supports x86_64 and ARM64 architectures; as an OCI runtime it integrates directly with Docker, containerd, and Kubernetes.
en.hot: With nearly 19k stars, gVisor is trending as a top cloud-native sandbox amid surging container security demands; its 85 new stars this week and #13 spot on the Go trending list reflect strong community interest in lightweight isolation.
uses: Cloud-native platform operators —— providing secure sandboxes for multi-tenant clusters or untrusted workloads.
Security and compliance teams —— meeting stricter kernel isolation requirements without sacrificing container agility.
Edge and serverless developers —— leveraging fast-start, low-overhead userspace kernels for short-lived functions or microservices.

zh.tag: 开源格斗游戏引擎，兼容 MUGEN 资源
zh.what: Ikemen GO 是一个完全用 Go 语言重写的开源格斗游戏引擎，兼容 M.U.G.E.N 1.1 Beta 的资源格式，并扩展了多种新功能。它支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 甚至 Android 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎源码、构建脚本、调试指南，以及从原 Ikemen 引擎分支而来的完整项目。还提供了预编译的可执行文件、夜间构建版和默认界面包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 SDL2 等库进行图形和输入处理，支持跨平台编译（包括 Android 的 Docker 构建）。
zh.hot: 作为 M.U.G.E.N 社区长期维护的现代替代品，Ikemen GO 凭借活跃的开发（每日提交）和跨平台支持，在 GitHub 上获得 1452 星，今日新增 8 星。
uses: 格斗游戏爱好者 —— 创建自定义角色、场景和游戏模式
独立游戏开发者 —— 基于成熟引擎快速原型化格斗游戏
M.U.G.E.N 模组制作者 —— 迁移现有资源到更现代的引擎

en.tag: Open-source fighting game engine with MUGEN resource support
en.what: Ikemen GO is an open-source fighting game engine rewritten entirely in Go, compatible with M.U.G.E.N 1.1 Beta resources and adding many new features. It supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and even Android.
en.content: The repo includes engine source code, build scripts, debugging guides, and the complete project forked from the original Ikemen engine. Pre-built binaries, nightly builds, and a default screenpack are also available.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, with dependencies on SDL2 for graphics and input, supporting cross-platform builds (including Android via Docker).
en.hot: As a modern, actively maintained alternative to M.U.G.E.N, Ikemen GO gains 1452 stars (8 today) due to its active development and cross-platform support.
uses: Fighting game enthusiasts — create custom characters, stages, and game modes
Indie game developers — quickly prototype fighting games on a mature engine
M.U.G.E.N modders — migrate existing resources to a more modern engine

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 跨语言高性能开源 RPC 框架与通信基础设施
zh.what: gRPC 是由 Google 开源的现代高性能远程过程调用（RPC）框架，旨在让客户端与服务端应用透明通信。它基于 HTTP/2 和 Protocol Buffers 构建，支持多种编程语言，简化了分布式连接系统的构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 C++ 的核心运行时、多语言绑定（Python、Ruby、PHP、C#、Go、Java 等）以及丰富的示例代码。同时提供构建脚本、测试套件和每日更新的预编译包。
zh.stack: 核心基于 C++ 实现，依赖 Protocol Buffers 作为接口定义与序列化格式，通过 HTTP/2 传输。提供各语言原生 SDK，涵盖 Node.js、Go、Java、Dart、Kotlin 等主流生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.1K+ Star 的社区认可度与本周新增 158 Star 的持续热度，gRPC 已成为云原生时代服务间通信的事实标准。其多语言支持与卓越性能使其在微服务架构中广受欢迎，稳居 C++ 周榜第 4。
uses: 后端开发者构建跨语言微服务与分布式系统
云原生架构师设计服务网格与容器化通信方案
基础平台团队打造高性能内部 API 与基础设施
多语言技术栈团队统一服务调用协议与接口规范

en.tag: Cross-language, high-performance open-source RPC framework
en.what: gRPC is a modern, high-performance open-source RPC framework by Google that enables transparent communication between client and server applications. Built on HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers, it supports multiple languages and simplifies building distributed connected systems.
en.content: The repository contains the C++-based core runtime, multi-language bindings (Python, Ruby, PHP, C#, Go, Java, etc.), and extensive examples. It also includes build scripts, test suites, and daily precompiled packages.
en.stack: The core is implemented in C++, relying on Protocol Buffers for IDL and serialization over HTTP/2. It offers native SDKs for major ecosystems including Node.js, Go, Java, Dart, and Kotlin.
en.hot: With 45.1K+ stars and 158 new stars this week, gRPC has become the de facto standard for service-to-service communication in the cloud-native era. Its multi-language support and outstanding performance make it widely adopted in microservices, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Backend developers building cross-language microservices and distributed systems
Cloud-native architects designing service mesh and containerized communication
Platform teams building high-performance internal APIs and infrastructure
Polyglot teams standardizing service call protocols and interface specifications

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 原生单元测试与微基准框架，支持 TDD/BDD
zh.what: Catch2 是一个专为 C++ 设计的现代单元测试框架，同时提供微基准测试与基础 BDD 宏支持。它让测试代码看起来像普通 C++ 布尔表达式，无需繁琐的宏定义即可自然编写测试用例。
zh.content: 仓库包含多头文件库源码、CMake 构建配置、CI 工作流及详尽文档；v3 版本从单头文件重构为常规多文件库，提供独立的 benchmark 模块与测试宏集合。
zh.stack: 核心基于现代 C++（C++14/17/20 为主），使用 CMake 构建，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 多平台 CI，并提供 Godbolt 在线体验。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态最流行的测试框架之一，Catch2 已积累超 21k Star，本周新增 769 星并跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 7 名，反映出 C++ 社区对简洁、现代测试工具的旺盛需求。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 需要为项目快速引入单元测试与回归测试
TDD/BDD 实践者 —— 想用接近自然语言的断言和场景描述写测试
性能工程师 —— 需要集成微基准测试以追踪代码性能回归
开源库维护者 —— 寻求跨平台、 header-only（v2）或现代库形态（v3）的测试方案

en.tag: Modern C++-native unit-testing & micro-benchmarking framework for TDD/BDD
en.what: Catch2 is a modern, C++-native unit testing framework that also offers micro-benchmarking capabilities and basic BDD macros. It lets you write tests using natural C++ boolean expressions without cumbersome macro boilerplate.
en.content: The repository houses a multi-header library source, CMake build configs, CI workflows, and extensive docs. Starting with v3, it was restructured from a single-header library into a normal multi-file library with a dedicated benchmark module and test macro suite.
en.stack: Built on modern C++ (primarily C++14/17/20), uses CMake, supports cross-platform CI on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and offers Godbolt online playground integration.
en.hot: One of the most popular C++ testing frameworks with over 21k stars, Catch2 gained 769 stars this week and hit #7 on the GitHub C++ Trending list, signaling strong demand for lightweight, modern C++ testing tools.
uses: C++ developers looking to quickly integrate unit and regression tests
TDD/BDD practitioners who want natural-language-like assertions and scenario descriptions
Performance engineers needing built-in micro-benchmarking to track code regressions
Open-source maintainers seeking cross-platform testing in header-only (v2) or modern library (v3) form

zh.tag: C++即时模式GUI库，轻量无依赖，专为工具与调试界面而生
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个无冗余、自包含的 C++ 即时模式图形用户界面库，专注于为开发者提供内容创作与调试工具的快速迭代能力。它输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可无缝集成到现有 3D 渲染管线中，无需外部依赖。与传统保留模式 UI 不同，它更适合构建高性能的内部工具、可视化面板和调试窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以核心头文件与单文件源码（imgui.h / imgui.cpp）为主体，并附带大量官方渲染后端与平台绑定（DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、GLFW、SDL、Win32 等）。同时提供开箱即用的示例程序、综合 Demo 窗口、文档 Wiki，以及独立的 imgui_test_engine 测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 编写，自包含且无任何外部依赖；通过可插拔后端接入 DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、WebGPU 等现代图形 API，并可绑定至 GLFW、SDL、Win32 等窗口系统。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中事实标准的工具型 UI 方案，Dear ImGui 已积累 74.7K Stars，本月新增 338 星并位列 Trending 月榜第 13。它几乎被所有主流游戏引擎和 3D 工具链采用，填补了高性能即时调试界面的长期空白。
uses: 游戏/图形引擎开发者 —— 为自研引擎快速搭建关卡编辑器、材质调试与性能分析面板
实时可视化与监控工具 —— 构建机器人、量化交易、嵌入式系统的实时数据看板
桌面工具软件作者 —— 为 C++ 桌面程序创建轻量、可移植的 ImGui 原生界面
算法与科研调试 —— 在图形/仿真/AI 训练过程中快速可视化参数与中间状态

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free, self-contained immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that empowers developers to build content creation and debugging tools with rapid iteration. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered directly into any 3D pipeline, requiring zero external dependencies. Unlike retained-mode UI libraries, it is purpose-built for high-performance internal tools, visualizers, and debug windows.
en.content: The repository centers on core single-file headers (imgui.h / imgui.cpp) and ships with official renderer backends and platform bindings (DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, GLFW, SDL, Win32, etc.). It also includes ready-to-run examples, a comprehensive demo window, extensive documentation, and a separate imgui_test_engine for automated testing.
en.stack: Written in pure C++ with zero external dependencies; integrates with modern graphics APIs via swappable backends for DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU, alongside platform bindings for GLFW, SDL, and Win32.
en.hot: With 74.7K Stars and 338 new stars this month (ranking 13th on the monthly GitHub Trending), Dear ImGui is the de-facto standard for tooling UIs in C++. It is adopted by virtually every major game engine and 3D toolchain, filling a long-standing gap for high-performance immediate-mode debugging interfaces.
uses: Game/graphics engine developers — rapidly build level editors, material debuggers, and profiling dashboards for custom engines
Real-time visualization & monitoring — create live data dashboards for robotics, quant trading, and embedded systems
Desktop tool builders — craft lightweight, portable native UIs for C++ applications without heavy framework overhead
Algorithm & research debugging — visualize parameters and intermediate states during graphics, simulation, or AI training runs

zh.tag: 让 3D 网格更小、渲染更快的优化库
zh.what: meshoptimizer 是一个用于优化三角形网格的库，旨在减少网格数据大小并提升 GPU 渲染效率。它提供多种算法，涵盖顶点缓存优化、顶点重排、索引缓存优化、过度绘制减少、顶点量化、网格简化等，适用于游戏引擎、3D 渲染管线等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 头文件和源文件，提供核心优化算法；同时附带命令行工具 gltfpack（用于自动优化 glTF 文件）和单头文件库 clusterlod.h（用于连续 LOD）。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖；提供 C/C++ 接口，支持通过 FFI 从其他语言调用；另有 Rust crate（meshopt）和 JavaScript 包（meshoptimizer.js）封装。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 图形领域的老牌优化库，meshoptimizer 凭借其高效算法和广泛兼容性持续获得关注。今日新增 11 星，总星数达 8161，在 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜排名第 6，说明其稳定性和实用性深受开发者认可。
uses: 游戏开发者 —— 优化模型网格，提升渲染性能并减少显存占用
3D 工具链开发者 —— 集成到 glTF 处理管线，自动优化模型文件
图形学研究者 —— 研究或对比不同网格优化算法的效果

en.tag: A mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render
en.what: meshoptimizer is a library for optimizing triangle meshes, aiming to reduce mesh data size and improve GPU rendering efficiency. It provides algorithms for vertex cache optimization, vertex reordering, index cache optimization, overdraw reduction, vertex quantization, mesh simplification, etc., suitable for game engines and 3D rendering pipelines.
en.content: The repository includes C/C++ headers and source files for core optimization algorithms, along with a command-line tool gltfpack for automatic glTF optimization and a single-header library clusterlod.h for continuous level of detail.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies; provides C/C++ interface with FFI support for other languages; also available as Rust crate (meshopt) and JavaScript package (meshoptimizer.js).
en.hot: As a veteran optimization library in 3D graphics, meshoptimizer continues to gain attention for its efficient algorithms and broad compatibility. With 11 new stars today and 8161 total stars, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending C++ daily, it demonstrates strong developer trust in its stability and practicality.
uses: Game developers — optimize mesh geometry for better rendering performance and lower VRAM usage
3D pipeline developers — integrate into glTF processing workflows for automatic model optimization
Graphics researchers — study or compare different mesh optimization algorithms

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: C++ 微基准测试支持库，类似单元测试
zh.what: Google Benchmark 是一个用于对代码片段进行微基准测试的库，类似于单元测试框架。它帮助开发者测量小段代码的性能，并生成可重复的、精确的计时结果。

en.tag: A microbenchmark support library for C++, similar to unit tests
en.what: Google Benchmark is a library for microbenchmarking code snippets, similar to unit testing. It helps developers measure the performance of small code segments and produce repeatable, precise timing results.
en.content: The repository contains a C++ header-only library, CMake build system, examples, user guide, and Python bindings. Core functionality registers benchmark functions via macros and state objects, then automatically runs and times them.
en.stack: Usable with C++11, requires C++17 to build; depends on CMake and git; optional Python bindings.
en.hot: As Google's official benchmark library, it has 10301 stars and is the de facto standard for C++ performance testing, stable and widely used.
uses: C++ developers — benchmark functions or algorithms for performance

zh.tag: 开源离网 LoRa 网状网络设备固件

en.tag: Open-source off-grid LoRa mesh device firmware
en.what: Meshtastic Firmware is the official device firmware for the Meshtastic project, enabling long-range, low-power communication without internet or cellular infrastructure. It supports text messaging, location sharing, and telemetry over a decentralized mesh network.

en.stack: Written in C++, built with PlatformIO, and supports LoRa radio protocols.

zh.tag: 开源魔兽世界巫妖王之怒模拟器
zh.what: AzerothCore 是一个基于 MaNGOS 和 TrinityCore 的开源魔兽世界巫妖王之怒（WotLK）服务器模拟器，提供完整的游戏服务端解决方案。它支持模块化扩展，社区驱动开发，并持续修复漏洞和优化性能。

怀旧玩家 —— 在自建服务器上体验经典 WotLK 内容

en.tag: Open-source WotLK MMORPG server emulator
en.what: AzerothCore is an open-source MMORPG server emulator for World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King, based on MaNGOS and TrinityCore. It offers a complete server-side solution with modular extensibility, community-driven development, and continuous bug fixes and performance optimizations.

Mod makers — to create custom game content using the module system
Nostalgic players — to experience classic WotLK content on self-hosted servers

zh.tag: 比特币官方核心客户端与全节点验证软件
zh.what: Bitcoin Core 是比特币网络的官方参考实现，负责连接 P2P 网络、下载并完整验证所有区块与交易。它还内置了钱包功能与可选的图形界面，为用户提供完整的比特币交互能力。作为集成与 staging 仓库，它承载了比特币协议最新的开发与稳定代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含比特币协议的核心源码（共识、网络、验证、钱包、GUI），以及构建脚本、测试套件（C++ 单元测试与 Python 功能/回归测试）和开发文档。master 分支为日常开发主线，release 分支与标签用于标记稳定版本，GUI 开发曾在独立仓库进行。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、Qt（可选 GUI）、SQLite/Berkeley DB（钱包）、libsecp256k1 等密码学与网络库。构建系统采用 Autotools，并支持跨平台编译（Windows、Linux、macOS），测试依赖 Python 框架。

节点运维者——部署全节点以独立验证交易、增强网络去中心化与安全性。
安全研究人员——审计核心代码、测试升级补丁或进行密码学相关实验。
加密货币从业者——集成钱包功能或构建基于比特币网络的衍生应用。

en.tag: Bitcoin's official core client and full-node validation software
en.what: Bitcoin Core is the reference implementation of the Bitcoin protocol, connecting to the peer-to-peer network to download and fully validate blocks and transactions. It also includes an integrated wallet and an optional graphical user interface for end-user interaction. As the integration and staging tree, it hosts both the latest development and stable release code for the Bitcoin network.
en.content: The repository contains the core protocol source (consensus, networking, validation, wallet, GUI), build scripts, test suites (C++ unit tests and Python functional/regression tests), and extensive developer documentation. The master branch serves as the daily integration branch, while release branches and tags mark stable versions, with GUI development maintained in a separate repository.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on Boost, Qt (optional GUI), SQLite/Berkeley DB (wallet), libsecp256k1, and other cryptographic/networking libraries. It uses Autotools for building, supports cross-platform compilation on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and leverages Python frameworks for functional testing.
en.hot: As the authoritative reference implementation of the Bitcoin network, it commands nearly 90k stars, reflecting massive community trust. Its addition of 550 stars this month and rank at #14 on GitHub's monthly C++ Trending list signal sustained mainstream interest and active developer engagement in protocol-level improvements.
uses: Blockchain developers — studying the reference implementation of Bitcoin consensus, networking, and validation logic.
Node operators — running full nodes to independently verify transactions and strengthen network decentralization.
Security researchers — auditing core code, testing upgrade patches, and conducting cryptographic experiments.
Crypto builders — integrating wallet functionality or developing applications atop the Bitcoin network.

zh.tag: C++ 的 YAML 解析与生成库

Game engines/toolchains — using YAML for level or resource description
Embedded systems — lightweight YAML processing needs

Game developers — study classic game engine reimplementation techniques

zh.tag: C++ 的实验性继任者，旨在改进 C++ 生态
zh.what: Carbon Language 是一个实验性的编程语言，旨在成为 C++ 的继任者。它通过 LLVM 实现高性能，并与现有 C++ 代码互操作，同时提供更现代的语言特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Carbon 语言的设计文档、编译器实现、示例代码和相关工具。
zh.stack: 基于 LLVM 构建，使用 C++ 实现编译器，支持与 C++ 代码互操作。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 的潜在继任者，Carbon 吸引了大量关注，目前拥有 33,827 颗星，尽管仍处于实验阶段。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 探索下一代系统编程语言的可能性
语言设计爱好者 —— 研究现代语言设计决策和实现
性能敏感项目团队 —— 评估未来迁移选项

en.tag: An experimental successor to C++, aiming to improve the C++ ecosystem
en.what: Carbon Language is an experimental programming language designed to be a successor to C++. It achieves high performance via LLVM, interoperates with existing C++ code, and offers modern language features.
en.content: The repository contains design documents, compiler implementation, example code, and related tools for the Carbon language.
en.stack: Built on LLVM, with the compiler implemented in C++, supporting interoperability with C++ code.
en.hot: As a potential successor to C++, Carbon has garnered significant attention with 33,827 stars, despite being experimental.
uses: C++ developers — exploring the next generation of systems programming languages
Language design enthusiasts — studying modern language design decisions and implementations
Performance-critical project teams — evaluating future migration options

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流主机，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务器，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户从自己的 PC 远程串流游戏到其他设备，支持低延迟、高性能的流式传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Sunshine 的完整源代码、构建脚本、Docker 配置和文档。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、NVFBC、VAAPI 等编解码库，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel GPU 硬件编码。
zh.hot: 拥有 39,608 颗星，是游戏串流领域最受欢迎的自托管方案之一。近期因自建游戏串流需求增长而持续热门。
uses: 游戏玩家 —— 从 PC 串流游戏到笔记本、平板或手机
家庭媒体中心 —— 将游戏画面投射到客厅电视
远程办公/学习 —— 低延迟远程访问高性能 PC

en.tag: Self-hosted game stream host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games from their PC to other devices with low latency and high performance.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts, Docker configuration, and documentation for Sunshine. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.stack: Developed in C++, depends on FFmpeg, NVFBC, VAAPI for encoding, supports NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPU hardware encoding.
en.hot: With 39,608 stars, it's one of the most popular self-hosted game streaming solutions. Its popularity continues due to growing demand for self-hosted game streaming.
uses: Gamers — stream games from PC to laptop, tablet, or phone
Home media centers — project game visuals to living room TV
Remote work/study — low-latency remote access to high-performance PC

zh.tag: 致敬 90 年代 UI 的类 Unix 图形操作系统
zh.what: SerenityOS 是一个为 64 位 x86、Arm 和 RISC-V 计算机打造的图形化类 Unix 操作系统。它融合了 90 年代末生产力软件的审美与 2000 年代末 Unix 的易用性，拥有自定义内核、浏览器、开发工具等完整生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的操作系统源码，包括内核、系统服务（窗口服务器、登录服务器等）、用户态库（LibC、LibJS、LibGL 等）、应用程序（浏览器、IDE、游戏等）以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，部分汇编和 C；构建系统基于 CMake，依赖 GCC/Clang 编译器。
zh.hot: 凭借复古 UI 设计、完整自研生态和活跃社区，长期吸引开发者关注，GitHub 星标超 3.3 万，本月新增 350 星。
uses: 操作系统爱好者 —— 学习现代 OS 设计与实现
复古 UI 爱好者 —— 体验 90 年代风格桌面环境
C++ 开发者 —— 参与大型开源项目贡献代码
技术探索者 —— 研究自研浏览器、内核等组件

en.tag: A graphical Unix-like OS paying homage to 90s UI
en.what: SerenityOS is a graphical Unix-like operating system for 64-bit x86, Arm, and RISC-V machines. It combines the aesthetics of late-1990s productivity software with the power-user accessibility of late-2000s Unix, featuring a custom kernel, browser, development tools, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the complete OS source code, including kernel, system services (WindowServer, LoginServer, etc.), userland libraries (LibC, LibJS, LibGL, etc.), applications (browser, IDE, games, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with some assembly and C; build system is CMake-based, relying on GCC/Clang compilers.
en.hot: With its retro UI design, complete self-built ecosystem, and active community, it has long attracted developers, amassing over 33k stars on GitHub with 350 new stars this month.
uses: OS enthusiasts — learn modern OS design and implementation
Retro UI fans — experience a 90s-style desktop environment
C++ developers — contribute to a large open-source project
Technology explorers — study self-built browser, kernel, etc.

zh.tag: vLLM 昇腾 NPU 社区插件，让大模型推理原生支持国产算力
zh.what: 这是 vLLM 推理引擎的社区维护硬件插件，旨在让主流大模型能够高效运行在华为昇腾（Ascend）NPU 上；它为国产 AI 算力提供了与 CUDA 生态对标的高性能推理方案，降低异构迁移成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含昇腾定制的算子实现、Attention 与采样后端加速模块、vLLM 版本兼容层，以及完整的构建脚本与中文/英文文档。
zh.stack: 核心模块以 C++ 编写并绑定 Python，底层调用华为 CANN 计算架构与 PyTorch 昇腾后端，通过 vLLM 的硬件插件接口完成对接。
zh.hot: 在国产算力替代与自主可控需求推动下，该插件补全了 vLLM 在昇腾生态的关键一环；仓库已获 2,431 Star，本周新增 52 星并跻身 GitHub C++ Trending 第 13 位，关注度持续走高。
uses: 昇腾 NPU 集群用户 —— 希望在华为 910B/310P 等硬件上无缝运行 vLLM 推理服务的工程团队。
国产算力平台构建者 —— 需要基于自主可控芯片搭建大模型推理底座的云厂商与科研机构。
异构适配开发者 —— 从事 AI 推理引擎后端移植、算子优化与硬件插件集成的系统工程师。

en.tag: Community plugin for running vLLM inference natively on Huawei Ascend NPUs
en.what: This community-maintained hardware plugin enables the vLLM inference engine to run efficiently on Huawei Ascend NPUs. It provides a high-performance serving solution for domestic AI hardware, reducing the migration cost from CUDA-centric ecosystems.
en.content: The repository houses Ascend-customized operators, attention and sampling acceleration backends, vLLM compatibility layers, plus build scripts and bilingual documentation.
en.stack: Core modules are written in C++ with Python bindings, calling Huawei's CANN stack and PyTorch Ascend backend underneath, and interfacing with vLLM through its hardware plugin API.
en.hot: Driven by demand for domestic hardware independence, the plugin fills a critical gap for vLLM on Ascend; having earned 2,431 stars with 52 added this week and a spot at #13 on GitHub's C++ Trending, it is gaining significant traction.
uses: Ascend NPU cluster users — Engineering teams seeking to run vLLM inference natively on Huawei 910B/310P hardware.
Domestic AI platform builders — Cloud providers and research institutes building LLM serving stacks on homegrown chips.
Heterogeneous adaptation developers — Systems engineers working on backend porting, operator optimization, and hardware plugin integration for inference engines.

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 异步网络与底层 I/O 基础设施库
zh.what: Asio 是一个跨平台的 C++ 库，专注于提供异步网络与底层 I/O 编程能力，统一封装了各操作系统的复杂原生 API。开发者可用它高效构建 TCP/UDP 套接字、串口通信及定时器等组件，广泛应用于高并发服务器、实时系统和嵌入式通信场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件-only 与源码编译两种形态的完整实现，以及示例程序、单元测试和离线 HTML 文档。根目录按 src、include、doc、example 组织，便于直接集成或打包构建。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++（C++11 起），零依赖或可选衔接 Boost，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 及嵌入式平台。编译系统覆盖 Autotools、CMake 和纯 Makefile，适配多种工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 异步网络编程的事实标准之一，Asio 凭借稳定 API 与卓越性能持续吸引开发者，目前获星 6.1k，本周新增 175 星并跻身 C++ 周榜第 8。最新 1.38.1 版本的发布进一步印证了社区对高性能底层 I/O 基础设施的旺盛需求。
uses: 需要构建高并发网络服务或实时通信系统的后端 C++ 开发者
追求跨平台一致 API、不想直接编写操作系统原生 I/O 代码的嵌入式/工具链团队
希望基于成熟异步模型开发游戏服务器、金融行情网关或物联网网关的工程团队

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ library for asynchronous networking and low-level I/O
en.what: Asio is a cross-platform C++ library for network and low-level I/O programming, offering a consistent asynchronous model across operating systems. It abstracts complex native APIs into composable components like TCP/UDP sockets, serial ports, and timers, making it ideal for high-concurrency servers and real-time systems.
en.content: The repository ships the library in both header-only and compiled source forms, alongside examples, unit tests, and offline HTML documentation. It is organized under src, include, doc, and example directories for easy integration or packaging.
en.stack: Written in modern C++ (C++11 and up) with zero mandatory dependencies—optionally interoperable with Boost—and supports Linux, Windows, macOS, and embedded targets. Build systems include Autotools, CMake, and plain Makefiles for broad toolchain compatibility.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for C++ asynchronous networking, Asio maintains strong momentum with 6.1k stars and 175 added this week, ranking 8th on the GitHub C++ Trending list. The recent 1.38.1 release underscores continued community demand for robust, high-performance low-level I/O infrastructure.
uses: Backend C++ developers building high-concurrency network services or real-time communication systems
Embedded and tooling teams seeking a cross-platform, consistent API without managing native OS I/O directly
Engineering teams developing game servers, financial market gateways, or IoT hubs on a proven asynchronous model

zh.tag: 让 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上流畅运行的兼容层
zh.what: Proton 是 Valve 开发的工具，基于 Wine 并整合了额外组件，使 Windows 专属游戏能在 Linux 操作系统上运行。它集成在 Steam 客户端中，普通用户无需手动配置即可使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Proton 的完整源代码、构建脚本（Makefile）以及 Wine 等子模块。高级用户可自行修改 Wine 版本或组件，并通过 Docker/Podman 容器化构建。
zh.stack: 基于 Wine，使用 C++ 开发，构建依赖 Docker 或 Podman 容器环境。
zh.hot: Proton 是 Linux 游戏生态的核心组件，拥有 32k+ Star，持续活跃。今日新增 18 Star，位列 C++ 日榜第 19 名，反映了 Linux 玩家对兼容性的持续关注。
uses: Linux 游戏玩家 —— 无需折腾即可运行 Windows 游戏
游戏开发者 —— 测试和优化游戏在 Linux 下的兼容性
开源贡献者 —— 改进 Wine 或 Proton 组件以提升兼容性

en.tag: Compatibility layer for running Windows games on Linux
en.what: Proton is a Valve-developed tool based on Wine and additional components that allows Windows-exclusive games to run on Linux. It is integrated into the Steam client, requiring no manual configuration for most users.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Proton, build scripts (Makefile), and submodules like Wine. Advanced users can modify Wine versions or components and build using Docker/Podman containers.
en.stack: Built on Wine, developed in C++, with build dependencies on Docker or Podman containers.
en.hot: Proton is a core component of the Linux gaming ecosystem with 32k+ stars and continuous activity. With 18 new stars today, it ranks 19th on the C++ daily trending list, reflecting ongoing interest in Linux game compatibility.
uses: Linux gamers — run Windows games without hassle
Game developers — test and optimize compatibility on Linux
Open source contributors — improve Wine or Proton components for better compatibility

zh.tag: 开源金融终端，提供市场分析与投资研究工具
zh.what: FinceptTerminal 是一个现代化的金融应用程序，提供高级市场分析、投资研究和经济数据工具。它旨在为用户提供交互式探索和数据驱动的决策支持，界面友好。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码，基于 Qt6 构建的桌面 GUI，以及 Python 脚本用于数据处理。提供实时市场数据、图表、投资组合分析等功能模块。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 C++20、Qt6 框架、Python 3.11+，以及 AGPL-3.0 许可证。依赖项通过 CMake 管理。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 29k+ 星标，今日新增 104 星，位居 C++ 日榜第一。尽管维护频率降低，但作为开源金融终端，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 个人投资者 —— 用于市场分析和投资决策支持
金融研究人员 —— 获取经济数据和进行量化研究
开发者 —— 学习和扩展金融终端功能

en.tag: Open-source financial terminal for market analytics and investment research
en.what: FinceptTerminal is a modern finance application offering advanced market analytics, investment research, and economic data tools, designed for interactive exploration and data-driven decision-making in a user-friendly environment.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, a Qt6-based desktop GUI, and Python scripts for data processing. It includes modules for real-time market data, charting, portfolio analysis, and more.
en.stack: Tech stack includes C++20, Qt6 framework, Python 3.11+, licensed under AGPL-3.0. Dependencies are managed via CMake.
en.hot: The project has gained 29k+ stars on GitHub, with 104 new stars today, ranking #1 on C++ daily trending. Despite reduced maintenance, its open-source financial terminal nature attracts significant attention.
uses: Individual investors — for market analysis and investment decision support
Financial researchers — to access economic data and conduct quantitative research
Developers — to learn and extend financial terminal capabilities

zh.tag: Google 开源 C++ 通用库，生产级标准库扩展
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 开源的 C++ 通用库集合，旨在补充和扩展 C++ 标准库。它从 Google 内部代码库提取，经过大规模生产环境验证，提供 C++17 兼容的高可靠基础组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 base、algorithm、cleanup、container、debugging、flags、hash、log、numeric、strings、synchronization、time 等模块代码，覆盖初始化、算法扩展、容器、日志与并发工具等基础能力，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17 标准开发，官方支持 Bazel 与 CMake 构建，兼容主流编译器与平台，无外部运行时依赖，仅依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 608 Star 冲上 GitHub 周榜第 2，反映出 C++ 开发者对经过 Google 生产环境验证、能填补标准库空白的高质量基础组件的强劲需求。17964 Star 的积累也证明了其作为现代 C++ 基础设施的核心地位。
uses: C++ 后端/基础架构开发者 —— 需要可靠的基础工具库替代或补充标准库
追求代码稳定性与工程规范的大型项目 —— 使用 Google 内部验证过的高质量保证库
跨平台 C++ 应用开发团队 —— 借助其良好的编译器与平台支持降低移植成本

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries extending the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ libraries from Google designed to augment the standard library. Extracted from Google's internal codebase and battle-tested in production, it provides C++17-compliant foundational utilities.
en.content: The repository includes modular components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, debugging, flags, hash, log, strings, synchronization, and time, supporting both Bazel and CMake build systems.
en.stack: Built on C++17 with official Bazel and CMake support, compatible with major compilers and platforms, with zero external runtime dependencies beyond the C++ standard library.
en.hot: Surging to #2 on GitHub Trending with 608 new stars this week, it reflects strong demand from C++ developers for battle-tested, production-grade utilities that fill gaps in the standard library. Its 17,964 total stars cement its role as essential modern C++ infrastructure.
uses: C++ backend and infrastructure developers who need reliable foundational utilities to complement or replace the standard library
Large-scale projects prioritizing code stability and engineering rigor, leveraging Google's internally battle-tested libraries
Cross-platform C++ teams looking to reduce porting costs through broad compiler and platform support

zh.tag: 基于 MCP 的语音交互 AI 聊天机器人
zh.what: 小智 AI 聊天机器人是一个基于 MCP 协议的语音交互入口，利用 Qwen / DeepSeek 等大模型实现 AI 对话，并通过 MCP 协议控制多端设备。支持离线语音唤醒、全双工语音交互、摄像头视觉输入、OLED 显示、电池管理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ESP-IDF 固件源码，支持 Wi-Fi、以太网、USB RNDIS 和 4G 联网；提供 WebSocket 和 MQTT+UDP 两种通信方式；内置 Opus 音频流处理、AEC 全双工、说话人识别、38 种界面语言；设备端和云端 MCP 扩展能力。
zh.stack: 基于 ESP-IDF v6.0+ 框架，使用 C++ 编写；依赖 ESP-SR 离线语音唤醒库、MCP 协议栈、Opus 编解码器；支持 ESP32 系列多款芯片。
zh.hot: 将大模型能力与嵌入式硬件结合，通过 MCP 协议实现设备控制，创意十足；视频教程和 DIY 指南降低了门槛，吸引了大量硬件爱好者和 AI 开发者，Star 数已达 2.8 万。
uses: 硬件爱好者 —— 用 ESP32 自制 AI 语音助手
AI 开发者 —— 探索 MCP 协议在嵌入式端的应用
智能家居玩家 —— 通过语音控制 LED、舵机等外设
教育场景 —— 学习嵌入式 AI 和语音交互开发

en.tag: An MCP-based voice-interactive AI chatbot
en.what: XiaoZhi AI chatbot is a voice interaction entry that leverages large models like Qwen / DeepSeek for AI conversations and controls multi-terminal devices via the MCP protocol. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex voice interaction, camera vision input, OLED display, and battery management.
en.content: The repository contains complete ESP-IDF firmware source code, supporting Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB RNDIS, and 4G networking; provides WebSocket and MQTT+UDP communication; includes Opus audio streaming, AEC full-duplex, speaker recognition, 38 interface languages; device-side and cloud-side MCP extensions.
en.stack: Built on ESP-IDF v6.0+ framework, written in C++; depends on ESP-SR offline voice wake-up library, MCP protocol stack, Opus codec; supports multiple ESP32 chip series.
en.hot: Combines large model capabilities with embedded hardware, enabling device control via MCP protocol—highly innovative; video tutorials and DIY guides lower the barrier, attracting many hardware enthusiasts and AI developers, reaching 28k stars.
uses: Hardware enthusiasts — build your own AI voice assistant with ESP32
AI developers — explore MCP protocol on embedded devices
Smart home tinkerers — control LEDs, servos, etc. via voice
Education — learn embedded AI and voice interaction development

zh.tag: 程序员专属的3D CAD建模工具
zh.what: OpenSCAD 是一款用于创建实体3D CAD对象的软件，它通过脚本文件描述对象并渲染3D模型，而非交互式建模。它专注于CAD方面，适合设计机械零件等工程用途。
zh.content: 仓库包含OpenSCAD的源代码、构建脚本、文档和示例。主要提供两种建模技术：构造实体几何（CSG）和2D轮廓挤出。
zh.stack: 使用C++开发，依赖Qt、CGAL、OpenCSG等库，支持Linux/UNIX、Windows和macOS。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源CAD工具，持续获得关注，今日新增11星，总星数近万，在C++日榜排名第23。
uses: 工程师和设计师 —— 用于创建参数化的机械零件模型
3D打印爱好者 —— 通过脚本精确控制模型生成
教育场景 —— 学习编程式建模和CAD概念

en.tag: The Programmers Solid 3D CAD Modeller
en.what: OpenSCAD is a software for creating solid 3D CAD objects. It reads a script file describing the object and renders the 3D model, focusing on CAD aspects rather than artistic modeling. Ideal for designing machine parts.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts, documentation, and examples. It offers two main modeling techniques: constructive solid geometry (CSG) and extrusion of 2D outlines.
en.stack: Developed in C++, depends on Qt, CGAL, OpenCSG, etc. Supports Linux/UNIX, Windows, and macOS.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source CAD tool, it continues to gain attention with 11 stars today and nearly 10k total stars, ranking 23rd on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Engineers and designers — for creating parametric mechanical part models
3D printing enthusiasts — for precise control over model generation via scripts
Educational settings — for learning programmatic modeling and CAD concepts

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only与编译双模式
zh.what: spdlog 是一款高性能 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only和编译两种集成方式。它提供丰富的日志输出目标、异步/同步模式、运行时与编译时日志级别过滤，以及基于 fmt 的现代化格式化语法。

Full-stack developers who need deep, first-principles understanding of transformers, attention, and agent internals.
AI product managers and tech leads who want end-to-end technical literacy to assess algorithm feasibility without pure research backgrounds.
Self-learners and interview candidates looking for a structured, locally runnable long-form curriculum to replace scattered tutorials.

zh.tag: 跨平台安全文件传输工具，支持端到端加密与断点续传

uses: 开发运维人员 —— 在不同服务器或本地与远程之间快速安全地传输配置文件与日志

en.tag: Secure CLI tool for effortless cross-platform file transfers with encryption
en.what: croc is a CLI tool that lets any two computers simply and securely transfer files and folders. It uses PAKE for end-to-end encryption and works through a relay, eliminating the need for local servers or port forwarding. It supports resumable transfers, multiple files, IPv6-first with IPv4 fallback, and proxies like Tor.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go source code, CLI entry point, relay server implementation, and cross-platform install scripts with CI configs. The README includes detailed installation guides for Homebrew, Scoop, Nix, and more, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Go, it uses PAKE for key exchange, a custom relay protocol for data transfer, and supports IPv6/IPv4 dual-stack with SOCKS5 proxy support (e.g., Tor).
en.hot: With an out-of-the-box, pain-free cross-device transfer experience, croc has earned 35.6K stars, gaining 167 this week and hitting #20 on GitHub's Go Trending chart. It fills the gap between tedious scp/rsync setup and instant tools that lack encryption.
uses: DevOps/Developers —— quickly and securely transfer configs and logs between servers or local and remote machines
Cross-platform teams —— instantly share large files or project folders across Windows, macOS, and Linux colleagues
Privacy-conscious users —— send files securely over untrusted networks using end-to-end encryption and Tor proxy support
CLI power users —— replace scp/rsync without needing SSH setup or port forwarding for ad-hoc transfers

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货

zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator

en.what: Audiobookshelf is a fully open-source self-hosted audiobook and podcast server. It allows streaming all audio formats on the fly, searching and auto-downloading podcast episodes, with multi-user support and cross-device progress sync.
en.content: The repository includes server-side code, a web client, and companion Android & iOS apps (beta). It provides installation docs, reverse proxy setup, and media organization guides.

Podcast fans — auto-download and manage podcast episodes with RSS feeds
Families or small groups — multi-user permissions and shared media library
Privacy-conscious users — fully self-hosted, no third-party data exposure

zh.tag: 轻量开源 API 客户端，离线优先的 Postman 替代品
zh.what: Bruno 是一款开源的 API 测试与探索 IDE，旨在替代 Postman 和 Insomnia。它采用本地文件存储集合，使用纯文本标记语言 Bru 保存请求信息，支持 Git 协作，且完全离线运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron）、CLI 工具、Docker 镜像，以及 Bru 语言解析器。提供丰富的请求编辑、集合管理、环境变量、脚本等功能。

uses: API 开发者 —— 快速测试和调试 REST/GraphQL API
团队协作 —— 通过 Git 共享和管理 API 集合
隐私敏感用户 —— 拒绝云端同步，数据完全本地存储

en.tag: Lightweight open-source API client, offline-first Postman alternative
en.what: Bruno is an open-source IDE for exploring and testing APIs, designed as a lightweight alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It stores collections locally on the filesystem, uses a plain text markup language (Bru) for request data, supports Git-based collaboration, and is fully offline.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron), CLI tool, Docker image, and Bru language parser. It offers rich request editing, collection management, environment variables, scripting, and more.
en.stack: Built with Electron, frontend uses React, backend uses Node.js. Primary language is JavaScript, relies on Git for version control.
en.hot: With its offline-first, local file storage, and native Git collaboration philosophy, Bruno attracts developers concerned about data privacy, amassing 45k+ stars with 24 new stars today.
uses: API developers — quickly test and debug REST/GraphQL APIs
Team collaboration — share and manage API collections via Git
Privacy-conscious users — no cloud sync, data stays local

zh.tag: 免费获取个人专属 .is-a.dev 子域名

en.what: is-a.dev is a free service that lets developers register a clean .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal websites or projects. Users apply by submitting a Pull Request on GitHub, and DNS records are automatically published once approved.

Users who need to capture m3u8 videos from streaming sites.
Users who prefer open-source tools over commercial downloaders.

zh.tag: 跨平台隐私优先语音转文字工具，支持本地与云端模型
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的桌面端语音听写应用，用户可通过全局热键在任何软件中将语音实时转为文字。它支持完全离线的本地转录（Whisper / NVIDIA Parakeet），也允许接入自有密钥的云模型，确保音频数据不出本地即可隐私可控地完成输入。

寻求免费替代方案的知识工作者——以开源方案替换 WisprFlow/Granola 进行日常语音记录。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation with local & cloud models
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source desktop dictation app that turns speech into text anywhere via a global hotkey. It offers fully offline transcription with local engines like Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet, or cloud processing via BYOK, keeping user audio data private and under their own control.
en.content: The repository includes the full cross-platform desktop client source and release builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux, featuring global hotkey handling, voice dictation, meeting transcription, AI note-taking, and agent modules, plus API docs and a website.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript and built on a cross-platform desktop framework (likely Electron or Tauri) with a modern web-based UI, it binds locally to Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet for on-device inference and exposes REST APIs for optional cloud integration.
en.hot: Positioned as a free, open-source and zero-telemetry alternative to paid tools like WisprFlow and Granola, OpenWhispr gained strong traction this month with 802 new stars, reaching 4,617 total stars and ranking #10 on GitHub’s JavaScript monthly trending chart.
uses: Writers and developers needing efficient voice input — dictate into any editor via a global hotkey.
Privacy-conscious users and teams — run fully offline meeting transcription and note-taking with local models.
Knowledge workers seeking free alternatives — replace paid tools like WisprFlow or Granola for daily voice logging.
