en.what: Cockpit is a web-based graphical interface for managing Linux servers. It allows sysadmins to perform tasks like starting containers, storage administration, network configuration, and log inspection directly from a browser, interacting with the OS in real-time.

zh.tag: 一键检测硬件，推荐可运行的LLM模型

Hardware reviewers: use built-in benchmarks to measure real tok/s and contribute results to the community
General users: easily browse and select models via TUI without manual configuration

zh.tag: Rust 全栈框架，开箱即用
zh.what: Topcoat 是一个模块化、开箱即用的 Rust 全栈 Web 框架，专注于简洁和生产力。它允许在服务器端渲染所有标记，组件可以异步并直接查询数据库，同时通过将表达式翻译为 JavaScript 实现客户端交互，无需 WebAssembly 或客户端构建步骤。

uses: Rust 全栈开发者 —— 快速构建服务端渲染的 Web 应用，无需前后端分离

tokio 生态用户 —— 与现有异步基础设施无缝集成

en.tag: Batteries-included full-stack Rust framework
en.what: Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack web apps, prioritizing simplicity and productivity. It renders all markup on the server, enabling async components to query databases directly, while translating expressions to JavaScript for client-side interactivity without WebAssembly or a client build step.
en.content: The repository includes the framework core, router, view components, signal system, along with examples and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Rust with the tokio async runtime, uses a custom view! macro for templating, and supports signal-driven reactive updates.
en.hot: Gained 2247 stars this week, total 3233, ranking #6 in Rust weekly. As an official tokio full-stack framework, it fills a Next.js-like gap in the Rust ecosystem, drawing significant attention.
uses: Rust full-stack developers — quickly build server-rendered web apps without front-backend separation
Frontend developers wanting to replace JS/TS with Rust — leverage Rust's type safety and performance
tokio ecosystem users — seamless integration with existing async infrastructure

zh.tag: Rust 全栈跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面与移动端
zh.what: Dioxus 是一个基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，开发者只需维护一套代码库即可构建 Web、桌面和移动应用。它提供了类似 React 的组件化开发体验，并内置基于 Signals 的状态管理、热重载与零配置启动能力。通过 Server Functions 还能直接在同一代码库中编写后端逻辑，实现真正的全栈开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 UI 库、跨平台渲染器（Web/桌面/移动端）、CLI 打包工具以及 Server Functions 全栈运行时。此外还提供了丰富的官方示例、文档站点和多语言 README，方便开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 生态，核心使用自研的 Virtual DOM 与 Signals 响应式系统，编译目标涵盖 WebAssembly、桌面端（基于 Winit/Tao）及移动端原生渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.8K Star 的热度和本周 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名的成绩，Dioxus 吸引了大量希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript 技术栈的开发者。其“一套代码、多端运行”的全栈能力，加上对热重载和零配置体验的重视，精准击中了 Rust 社区对高性能跨平台 UI 方案的强烈需求。
uses: Rust 开发者 —— 希望用单一代码库同时覆盖前端页面与桌面/移动原生应用的项目。
全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.tag: Rust fullstack cross-platform UI framework for web, desktop, and mobile
en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. It offers a React-like component model with zero-config setup, integrated hot-reloading, and signals-based state management. Server Functions enable backend logic to live alongside the UI, streamlining fullstack development in Rust.
en.content: The repo contains the core UI library, cross-platform renderers for web, desktop, and mobile, a CLI bundler, and a fullstack runtime for Server Functions. It also ships with extensive examples, documentation, and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built entirely on Rust, featuring a custom Virtual DOM and signals-based reactivity, compiling to WebAssembly, desktop (via Winit/Tao), and mobile native targets.
en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.
Cross-platform product teams —— groups that need memory-safe, high-performance alternatives to heavy Electron-style solutions.

zh.tag: Jellyfin 非官方桌面客户端，基于 CEF 和 mpv
zh.what: Jellium Desktop 是一个非官方的 Jellyfin 桌面客户端，旨在提供比网页版更流畅、更原生的媒体播放体验。它利用 CEF 渲染界面，mpv 作为播放后端，支持跨平台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源码、构建脚本（支持 Linux AppImage/Flatpak、macOS DMG、Windows 安装包）以及开发工具链（just 任务运行器）。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Rust 主语言，CEF（Chromium Embedded Framework）用于 UI，mpv 用于视频播放，跨平台构建支持 Linux、macOS、Windows。
zh.hot: Jellyfin 用户对原生桌面客户端需求强烈，Jellium 凭借 CEF+mpv 的流畅体验和跨平台支持，上线即获 1400+ Star，今日新增 155，登顶 Rust 日榜第 4。
uses: Jellyfin 用户：需要比网页版更流畅、功能更丰富的桌面播放器
媒体中心爱好者：在 Linux/macOS/Windows 上统一管理并播放 Jellyfin 媒体库
Rust 开发者：学习如何结合 CEF 和 mpv 构建跨平台桌面应用

en.tag: Unofficial Jellyfin desktop client built on CEF and mpv
en.what: Jellium Desktop is an unofficial Jellyfin desktop client that offers a smoother, more native media playback experience than the web version. It uses CEF for UI rendering and mpv as the playback backend, with cross-platform support.
en.content: The repository includes full client source code, build scripts (Linux AppImage/Flatpak, macOS DMG, Windows packages), and a development toolchain (just command runner).
en.stack: Tech stack: Rust as the main language, CEF (Chromium Embedded Framework) for UI, mpv for video playback, cross-platform builds for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: Jellyfin users have a strong demand for native desktop clients. Jellium, with its smooth CEF+mpv experience and cross-platform support, quickly gained 1400+ stars, adding 155 today, ranking 4th on Rust daily trending.
uses: Jellyfin users: need a smoother, more feature-rich desktop player than the web version
Media center enthusiasts: manage and play Jellyfin media library uniformly on Linux/macOS/Windows
Rust developers: learn how to combine CEF and mpv to build cross-platform desktop apps

zh.tag: 一站式媒体下载与学习管理桌面应用
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款开源桌面应用，支持从 1800+ 网站下载视频、音频、课程和电子书，并内置 PDF/EPUB 阅读器、专注模式、带时间戳的笔记和间隔重复功能。无需命令行，无需 Python，开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Tauri + Rust + Svelte 构建，提供媒体下载、播放、阅读、笔记和插件系统。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Tauri（桌面框架）、Rust（后端）、Svelte（前端）、yt-dlp（媒体下载）、SQLite（本地存储）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 357 星，总星数 7277，位列 Rust 日榜第 10。其“一站式下载+学习”的定位精准解决了用户在多平台间切换的痛点，且完全免费开源。
uses: 在线课程学习者 —— 一键下载 Udemy、YouTube 等平台的课程视频和资料
媒体收藏爱好者 —— 从 1800+ 站点下载视频、音乐和电子书
高效学习者 —— 利用内置阅读器、笔记和间隔重复功能进行主动学习

en.tag: All-in-one desktop app for downloading, organizing and studying media
en.what: OmniGet is an open-source desktop app that downloads videos, audio, courses, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites, with built-in PDF/EPUB reader, focus mode, timestamped notes, and spaced repetition. No command line, no Python, just download and run.
en.content: The repo contains the full desktop app source code built with Tauri + Rust + Svelte, featuring media downloading, playback, reading, note-taking, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Tech stack: Tauri (desktop framework), Rust (backend), Svelte (frontend), yt-dlp (media downloading), SQLite (local storage).
en.hot: Gained 357 stars today, total 7277, ranked #10 in Rust daily trending. Its 'all-in-one download + study' positioning solves the pain of switching between platforms, and it's completely free and open-source.
uses: Online course learners — one-click download courses from Udemy, YouTube, and more
Media collectors — download videos, music, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites
Active learners — use built-in reader, notes, and spaced repetition for effective study

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 终端原生 AI Agent 多路复用器，支持持久会话与插件扩展
zh.what: herdr 是一款驻扎在终端内的 Agent 多路复用器，让你能在一个界面中并行运行、监控多个 AI Agent 的状态。它支持会话分离与跨终端重连，Agent 脱离终端后仍可后台运行，并通过纯 Socket API 实现 Agent 之间的相互调用。同时支持键盘与鼠标双模式操作，以及可扩展的插件市场。
zh.content: 仓库主体为一个 Rust 编写的单二进制文件，无需 Electron 或 Node.js 环境，直接嵌入现有终端。核心包含窗格分割与状态可视化、会话持久化、插件系统、纯 Socket API，以及兼容 tmux 风格快捷键与鼠标点击的混合交互层。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 构建，单二进制分发，零额外依赖。提供 curl / Homebrew / mise 等多种安装方式，并已推出 Windows Beta 版本。
zh.hot: 在 AI Agent 工具链需求井喷的节点，herdr 上线不到两周便收获 1.7 万+ Star，本周激增 2512 颗，冲入 Trending 周榜第 17。它用原生终端体验替代了笨重的 Electron 方案，以「Agent 多路复用 + 可编排 Socket API」精准解决了开发者同时管理多 Agent 的痛点。
uses: 终端重度用户/开发者 —— 需要在不离开终端的情况下并行管理多个 AI Agent 任务。
AI Agent 开发者 —— 需要构建、调试和编排 Agent 工作流，并让 Agent 之间互相通信。
远程/服务器开发者 —— 通过 SSH 断连重连，保持 Agent 长时间后台运行不中断。
插件生态爱好者 —— 希望通过插件扩展窗格和工作流，打造自定义终端 Agent 环境。

en.tag: Terminal-native AI agent multiplexer with persistent sessions and plugins
en.what: herdr is a terminal-native agent multiplexer that lets you run and monitor multiple AI agents in parallel from a single interface. Sessions can be detached and reattached from any terminal or over SSH, and agents themselves can orchestrate each other through a pure socket API. It supports both keyboard and mouse workflows, plus a plugin marketplace for extensibility.
en.content: The repo is built as a single Rust binary with no Electron or Node.js runtime, embedding directly into your existing terminal. It ships with core pane splitting and status visualization, persistent sessions, a plugin system, a pure socket API, and a hybrid interaction layer supporting both tmux-style keybindings and mouse actions.
en.stack: Written entirely in Rust and distributed as a single self-contained binary with zero extra dependencies. Installable via curl, Homebrew, and mise, with a Windows beta already available.
en.hot: Riding the wave of AI-agent tooling demand, herdr racked up 17.7k+ stars within weeks of launch, adding 2,512 this week alone and hitting #17 on GitHub Trending. It replaces heavy Electron wrappers with a native terminal experience and solves the pain of orchestrating multiple agents via its unique multiplexing and socket API.
uses: Terminal-heavy developers who need to run and monitor multiple AI agent tasks without leaving the terminal.
Agent developers who need to build, debug, and orchestrate agent workflows with inter-agent communication.
Remote/server developers who require persistent agent sessions that survive SSH disconnects and terminal restarts.
Plugin ecosystem enthusiasts looking to extend pane management and workflows through a customizable plugin marketplace.

zh.tag: OpenAI 官方轻量级终端 AI 编码代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的终端原生 AI 编码代理，可在本地计算机上直接运行。它能理解自然语言指令，协助完成代码编写、重构、调试等任务。用户可通过 ChatGPT 账户或 API 密钥接入，无需离开终端即可进行智能开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Codex CLI 的 Rust 源码、跨平台编译构建脚本，以及支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 的预编译二进制发布。除终端版外，项目还指向 IDE 插件和云端 Codex Web 的入口。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 开发，保证高性能与低资源占用；提供 curl、npm、Homebrew 等多种安装方式，支持通过 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API 密钥进行身份验证。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方出品的终端编码工具，凭借 99.2k Stars 的超高人气和单日新增 328 Stars 的强劲势头，成功登顶 Rust 日榜第二。它将 AI 编程能力直接嵌入开发者最熟悉的终端环境，轻量且开源。
uses: 终端重度使用者 —— 希望在命令行中直接调用 AI 辅助编程的开发者
全栈工程师 —— 需要快速完成代码生成、重构与调试的敏捷开发场景
开源贡献者 —— 希望基于 Apache-2.0 协议研究或扩展 AI Agent 能力的工程师
ChatGPT 订阅用户 —— 想将现有 Plus/Pro/Edu 等计划权益延伸至本地开发环境

en.tag: OpenAI's official lightweight coding agent for your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your machine. It interprets natural language instructions to help write, refactor, and debug code without leaving your terminal. Users can authenticate via their ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for Codex CLI, cross-platform build scripts, and precompiled binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It also points to IDE extensions and the cloud-based Codex Web agent.
en.stack: Core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage. It supports multiple installation methods including curl, npm, and Homebrew, and authenticates via ChatGPT accounts or OpenAI API keys.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI terminal coding tool, it commands massive attention with 99.2k Stars and 328 new Stars today, ranking second on the Rust daily trending list. It brings AI coding directly into the familiar terminal environment in a lightweight, open-source package.
uses: Terminal power users — developers who want AI assistance directly in their command line
Full-stack engineers — those needing rapid code generation, refactoring, and debugging
Open-source contributors — engineers looking to study or extend an Apache-2.0 AI agent
ChatGPT subscribers — users wanting to extend their Plus/Pro/Edu benefits to local development

zh.tag: 比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 S3 兼容对象存储
zh.what: RustFS 是一个基于 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API。它针对小对象（如 4KB）进行了极致优化，性能可达 MinIO 的 2.3 倍，同时支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台无缝迁移和共存。
zh.content: 仓库包含 RustFS 核心存储引擎、S3 API 网关、CLI 工具、Docker 部署配置以及完整的文档和示例。项目采用模块化架构，支持分布式部署和水平扩展。
zh.stack: 主要编程语言为 Rust，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时、S3 兼容库（如 aws-sdk-s3）、以及 RocksDB 或自研存储引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的性能优势和 Rust 的内存安全特性，RustFS 在 GitHub 上获得 30k+ Stars，并登上 Trending 周榜。其 S3 兼容性降低了迁移成本，吸引了大量数据湖和 AI 场景用户。
uses: 数据湖与 AI 训练场景 —— 需要高性能小对象存储的机器学习平台
替代 MinIO/Ceph —— 追求更高吞吐和更低延迟的 S3 兼容存储
边缘计算与 IoT —— 轻量级分布式存储部署在资源受限环境
云原生基础设施 —— 作为 Kubernetes 的持久化存储后端

en.tag: 2.3x faster than MinIO for small objects, S3-compatible object storage
en.what: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust, compatible with S3 API. It is extremely optimized for small objects (e.g., 4KB), achieving 2.3x the performance of MinIO, while supporting seamless migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms like MinIO and Ceph.
en.content: The repository contains the core storage engine, S3 API gateway, CLI tools, Docker deployment configs, and comprehensive documentation with examples. The project uses a modular architecture supporting distributed deployment and horizontal scaling.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, relying on Tokio async runtime, S3-compatible libraries (e.g., aws-sdk-s3), and RocksDB or custom storage engine.
en.hot: With 2.3x performance advantage over MinIO and Rust's memory safety, RustFS has gained 30k+ stars on GitHub and made it to the Trending weekly list. Its S3 compatibility reduces migration costs, attracting users in data lake and AI scenarios.
uses: Data lakes & AI training — high-performance small object storage for ML platforms
MinIO/Ceph replacement — S3-compatible storage with higher throughput and lower latency
Edge computing & IoT — lightweight distributed storage for resource-constrained environments
Cloud-native infrastructure — persistent storage backend for Kubernetes

zh.tag: 魔法般的 shell 历史管理工具，支持加密同步
zh.what: Atuin 用 SQLite 数据库替代传统的 shell 历史记录，并记录命令的额外上下文（如退出码、执行时间、工作目录等）。它提供可选的端到端加密同步功能，让你在多台机器间共享历史记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的命令行工具、同步服务器、以及可选的加密同步服务。提供全屏搜索 UI、统计功能、快捷键绑定等。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 SQLite 数据库存储历史记录，支持加密同步（可选自建服务器或使用官方服务）。
zh.hot: 30k+ Stars 说明其解决了 shell 历史管理的核心痛点：跨设备同步、搜索效率、上下文记录。今日新增 30 Stars 保持热度。
uses: 开发者/运维人员 —— 需要跨多台机器同步和高效搜索 shell 历史
终端重度用户 —— 希望记录命令退出码、耗时等额外信息
隐私敏感用户 —— 需要端到端加密的历史同步方案

en.tag: Magical shell history tool with encrypted sync across machines
en.what: Atuin replaces your existing shell history with a SQLite database, recording additional context like exit code, duration, and working directory. It offers optional fully encrypted synchronization of history across machines via an Atuin server.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust CLI tool, a sync server, and optional encrypted sync service. Features a full-screen search UI, statistics, and key bindings.
en.stack: Built with Rust, uses SQLite for history storage, supports encrypted sync (self-hosted or official server).
en.hot: 30k+ Stars show it solves core shell history pain points: cross-device sync, search efficiency, and context recording. 30 new stars today maintain its popularity.
uses: Developers/DevOps — need cross-machine sync and efficient shell history search
Heavy terminal users — want extra context like exit codes and duration
Privacy-conscious users — require end-to-end encrypted history sync

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 AI 代理操作系统
zh.what: IronClaw 是一个专注于隐私、安全和可扩展性的 AI 代理操作系统。它让你拥有一个完全本地运行、数据加密且不离开你控制的个人 AI 助手。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心代理引擎、WebUI 界面、命令行工具以及安装脚本。支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows/WSL。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖本地 LLM 提供商 API，支持加密凭证存储和后台服务。
zh.hot: 获得 12.5k+ Stars，因其强调隐私和本地控制，在 AI 代理工具中脱颖而出，符合用户对数据主权的关注。
uses: 注重隐私的用户 —— 希望 AI 助手完全本地运行，数据不泄露
开发者 —— 需要可扩展、可审计的 AI 代理框架
安全敏感场景 —— 如企业内网、个人敏感信息处理

en.tag: Privacy-first AI agent OS
en.what: IronClaw is an Agent OS focused on privacy, security, and extensibility. It provides a personal AI assistant that runs entirely locally, with encrypted data that never leaves your control.
en.content: The repository contains the core agent engine written in Rust, a WebUI, CLI tools, and installation scripts. It supports macOS, Linux, and Windows/WSL.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, relies on local LLM provider APIs, features encrypted credential storage and background service.
en.hot: With 12.5k+ stars, it stands out among AI agent tools for its emphasis on privacy and local control, resonating with users' concerns about data sovereignty.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — want a fully local AI assistant with no data leakage
Developers — need an extensible and auditable AI agent framework
Security-sensitive scenarios — e.g., corporate intranet, personal sensitive data processing

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面服务端，支持自托管
zh.what: RustDesk Server 是 RustDesk 远程桌面软件的服务器端程序，允许用户自建远程桌面服务。它包含 ID/中继服务器和 CLI 工具，支持完全自托管，免费开源。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个可执行程序：hbbs（ID/中继服务器）、hbbr（中继服务器）和 rustdesk-utils（CLI 工具），以及配置文档和环境变量说明。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Cargo 构建系统，支持通过命令行、环境变量或配置文件进行配置。

ggml 生态用户 —— 扩展 ggml 到语音领域

en.tag: C/C++ speech-to-text inference library supporting 16+ model families via GGUF/ggml
en.what: transcribe.cpp is a C/C++ speech-to-text inference library built on ggml, supporting 16 model families and 60+ variants including Parakeet, Whisper, Canary, Qwen3-ASR, and more. It offers Metal, Vulkan, and CUDA backends for fast GPU inference plus a tinyBLAS-accelerated CPU path, with streaming and batch processing.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library, per-model documentation with WER verification, example code, and model conversion tools. All models are numerically verified and WER-tested, published under the handy-computer Hugging Face organization.
en.stack: Tech stack: C/C++, ggml (runtime), GGUF (model format), Metal/Vulkan/CUDA (GPU backends), tinyBLAS (CPU acceleration). Dependencies: CMake, optional GPU SDKs.
en.hot: Gained 395 stars today, total 1292, ranked #20 on GitHub Trending daily. It fills a gap in the ggml ecosystem for speech-to-text inference, supporting a wide range of models with excellent performance, attracting STT developers and the ggml community.
uses: STT application developers — quickly integrate diverse STT models into C/C++ projects
Edge device deployment — leverage ggml's lightweight nature on CPU/GPU
Model researchers — compare WER and performance across STT models
ggml ecosystem users — extend ggml to the speech domain

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hyprland 合成器的完整源代码、文档链接、安装指南、配置示例和画廊展示。代码库以 C++ 编写，易于扩展和阅读。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，不依赖 wlroots、libweston、kwin 或 mutter，完全独立实现。依赖 Wayland 协议和相关库。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。

Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.

en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.
uses: Linux desktop users — seeking a beautiful, efficient, and customizable tiling window management experience
Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: 开源参数化 3D 建模工具
zh.what: FreeCAD 是一款免费开源的跨平台参数化 3D 建模器，主要用于设计各种尺寸的真实物体。它支持参数化建模，允许用户通过修改历史参数轻松调整设计。

zh.tag: 经典开源后末日回合制生存游戏，被誉为僵尸生存类Roguelike的祖师爷

en.tag: Classic open-source post-apocalyptic turn-based survival roguelike
en.what: Cataclysm: DDA is a hardcore turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players scavenge a procedurally generated, persistent wasteland for supplies, craft gear, drive vehicles, and fight or flee from zombies, mutants, and killer robots to survive as long as possible.

zh.tag: ESP32 多频段无线攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32-DIV 是一款基于 ESP32-S3 的开源多频段无线工具套件，集成了 Wi-Fi、BLE、2.4GHz、Sub-GHz、红外、RFID/NFC 和 GPS 功能。它支持数据包监控、信标泛滥、去认证攻击、信号重放等多种攻防操作，适用于无线安全研究、渗透测试和射频工具开发。

zh.hot: 该项目将多种无线攻防功能集成到一个手持设备中，降低了无线安全研究的门槛，吸引了安全爱好者和硬件极客。今日新增 26 星，总星数 3478，位居 GitHub C++ 日榜第 3。
uses: 无线安全研究人员 —— 用于测试 Wi-Fi/BLE 等协议的安全性
渗透测试人员 —— 在授权环境中执行无线攻击模拟
硬件爱好者 —— 学习 ESP32 开发和射频硬件设计
教育场景 —— 无线通信原理的实践教学工具

en.tag: Multi-band wireless offensive & defensive toolkit on ESP32
en.what: ESP32-DIV is an open-source multi-band wireless toolkit based on the ESP32-S3, integrating Wi-Fi, BLE, 2.4GHz, Sub-GHz, IR, RFID/NFC, and GPS. It supports packet monitoring, beacon flooding, deauthentication attacks, signal replay, and more, suitable for wireless security research, penetration testing, and RF tool development.
en.content: The repository includes complete firmware source code, hardware design files (PCB schematics), a web-based flashing tool, and detailed Wiki documentation. The firmware is written in C++ with a touchscreen UI and rich feature menus.
en.stack: Built on the ESP32-S3 microcontroller, developed with Arduino framework or ESP-IDF, relying on libraries such as WiFi.h, BLE libraries, IRremote, etc., supports SD card logging and web-based flashing.
en.hot: This project integrates multiple wireless offensive and defensive capabilities into a single handheld device, lowering the barrier to wireless security research and attracting security enthusiasts and hardware geeks. It gained 26 stars today, totaling 3478, ranking 3rd on GitHub C++ daily trending.
uses: Wireless security researchers — for testing the security of Wi-Fi/BLE and other protocols
Penetration testers — for performing wireless attack simulations in authorized environments
Hardware enthusiasts — for learning ESP32 development and RF hardware design
Educational scenarios — as a hands-on teaching tool for wireless communication principles

zh.tag: 为逆向工程师和程序员打造的现代化十六进制编辑器

en.tag: A modern hex editor for reverse engineers and programmers
en.what: ImHex is a powerful hex editor designed for reverse engineering, programming, and low-level data analysis. It offers an intuitive interface, rich visualization tools, and powerful pattern search capabilities to help users efficiently analyze and edit binary files.

en.stack: Developed in C++, using ImGui for the graphical interface, supporting multiple operating systems. Integrates pattern matching language, disassembler, and data analysis tools.

Programmers — debug low-level data structures and file formats

Data enthusiasts — explore and edit arbitrary binary data

IoT 与边缘设备开发者 —— 部署轻量级 ML 解决方案到资源受限设备

en.tag: Cross-platform ML solutions for live and streaming media

Web developers — run real-time ML models in the browser without a backend
IoT and edge device developers — deploy lightweight ML solutions to resource-constrained devices

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client, full open-source code

zh.content: 仓库包含 OfficeCLI 的核心源码、单一可执行二进制发布文件，以及丰富的示例资源（GIF 展示、文档模板等）和多语言 README。其核心是一个内置 HTML 渲染引擎的 C# 命令行工具，支持 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx 的高保真解析与渲染。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C# 开发，以单一二进制文件形式发布，不依赖 Microsoft Office 或任何外部运行时，支持跨平台运行。内置自研 HTML 渲染引擎负责将 Office 文档转换为 HTML/PNG 供 AI 视觉闭环使用。
zh.hot: 作为首个专为 AI 智能体打造的 Office 自动化工具，它精准切中了 Agent 时代 AI 处理办公文档的刚需；凭借「一行代码 + 无需 Office」的极简体验，一周内激增 4,611 Star，总星数逼近 1.9 万，强势登上 GitHub 周榜第 10。
uses: AI 智能体开发者 —— 需要让 Agent 具备读写 Office 文档能力的工程师
自动化办公场景 —— 批量生成报告、幻灯片、数据表格的无代码/低代码工作流
RAG / 企业知识库建设者 —— 需要高精度解析 Word/Excel/PPT 内容并供 AI 理解的团队
跨平台运维人员 —— 在无 Office 环境的 Linux/服务器上处理 Office 文件

en.tag: Open-source CLI suite that gives AI agents full control over Office documents
en.what: OfficeCLI is an open-source Office suite purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files through a single command. It features a built-in high-fidelity HTML rendering engine that converts documents to HTML or PNG, giving AI agents visual 'eyes' for review and correction. It runs as a single binary without requiring any Microsoft Office installation or dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains the core C# source code, single-binary releases, and rich showcase assets including GIF demos and multi-language documentation. Its centerpiece is a CLI tool with a built-in HTML rendering engine that faithfully parses and renders .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files.
en.stack: Built primarily in C# and distributed as a single, self-contained binary with zero external dependencies and no Microsoft Office installation required. It includes a custom-built HTML rendering engine that converts Office documents into HTML or PNG for AI visual feedback loops.
en.hot: As the world's first Office suite built specifically for AI agents, it directly addresses the urgent need for automated document processing in the Agent era. Its 'one-line command, zero Office install' experience fueled a surge of 4,611 stars this week, bringing the total to nearly 19,000 and landing it at #10 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers who need to equip agents with the ability to read and write Office documents
Automation workflows that batch-generate reports, presentations, and spreadsheets with minimal setup
RAG and enterprise knowledge-base builders requiring high-fidelity parsing of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
Cross-platform DevOps users who need to process Office files on Linux or servers without Microsoft Office installed

zh.tag: 个人 AI 交易代理，一条命令赋予全栈交易能力
zh.what: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人化的 AI 交易代理框架，只需一条命令即可部署具备完整市场分析、策略执行与风险管理能力的交易 Agent。它支持通过 API 和 MCP 协议与外部工具链集成，并配备 Shadow Account 模拟环境用于策略验证。项目由香港大学数据科学研究院（HKUDS）维护，提供从后端到前端的一站式解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 FastAPI 的 Python 后端、React 19 构建的可视化前端，以及支持 PyPI 一键安装的 CLI 工具。同时提供示例代码、API/MCP 接口文档和 Shadow Account 模拟交易模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+ 开发，后端采用 FastAPI，前端使用 React 19，通过 PyPI 包 `vibe-trading-ai` 分发。支持 API 与 MCP 协议扩展，便于接入外部数据源和交易工具。
zh.hot: 仓库已积累 24.7k Star，本周激增 5,616 并冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 4，反映出 AI Agent 与量化金融结合的巨大关注度。其「一键启动个人交易代理」的极低门槛和 HKUDS 的学术背书，持续吸引开发者与交易者涌入。
uses: 量化交易者 —— 希望用 AI Agent 自动化策略执行与风险监控。
AI Agent 开发者 —— 需要基于 MCP 协议扩展金融交易能力的工具链。
金融科技爱好者 —— 想通过 Shadow Account 零成本验证和迭代交易策略。
全栈开发者 —— 寻求基于 FastAPI + React 的开源交易系统参考架构。

en.tag: Personal AI trading agent empowering comprehensive capabilities with one command
en.what: Vibe-Trading is a personal AI trading agent framework that can be deployed with a single command to deliver comprehensive market analysis, strategy execution, and risk management. It supports integration with external toolchains via API and MCP protocols, and includes a Shadow Account simulation environment for strategy backtesting. Maintained by HKUDS, it provides an end-to-end solution from FastAPI backend to React frontend.
en.content: The repository includes a FastAPI-based Python backend, a React 19 visualization frontend, and a CLI tool installable via PyPI. It also ships with example code, API/MCP interface documentation, and a Shadow Account simulation module.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with a FastAPI backend and React 19 frontend, distributed via the PyPI package `vibe-trading-ai`. Supports API and MCP protocol extensions for easy integration with external data sources and trading tools.
en.hot: With 24.7k stars and a weekly surge of 5,616 to rank #4 on GitHub Trending, it reflects massive interest in the intersection of AI agents and quantitative finance. Its extremely low barrier to entry via "one command" deployment, backed by HKUDS's academic credibility, continues to attract developers and traders.
uses: Quantitative traders — looking to automate strategy execution and risk monitoring via AI agents.
AI agent developers — who need a toolchain for extending financial trading capabilities through MCP protocols.
Fintech enthusiasts — wanting to validate and iterate trading strategies at zero cost using the Shadow Account.
Full-stack developers — seeking an open-source trading system reference architecture based on FastAPI and React.

zh.tag: 网页内嵌式 AI GUI Agent，纯文本操控无需截图
zh.what: Page Agent 是一个运行在浏览器页面内的 JavaScript GUI Agent，只需嵌入一段脚本即可让任何网页拥有自然语言操控能力。它通过纯文本 DOM 解析而非截图视觉感知来理解页面结构，使用户能用对话方式完成点击、输入、导航等操作。支持接入主流大模型（包括本地部署），并可选配 Chrome 扩展实现跨页面任务。
zh.content: 仓库核心是一个可嵌入任意网页的 JavaScript/TypeScript SDK，提供基于文本的 DOM 感知、LLM 调用编排和动作执行引擎；另包含可选的 Chrome 浏览器扩展、MCP 服务及官方文档站点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，以 npm 包形式分发，无 Python 或无头浏览器依赖，仅通过浏览器原生 JavaScript 运行，可对接任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的主流或本地大模型。
zh.hot: 月增 8,521 Star 冲上 Trending 月榜第 10，它用纯前端方案解决了传统 AI Agent 依赖截图/多模态/浏览器扩展的痛点，实现了“一行脚本即可 AI 化任意网页”的极低接入成本。
uses: 前端开发者——无需改动后端即可为现有 Web 应用快速添加自然语言交互能力
自动化测试/运维人员——用文本指令替代传统脚本进行网页自动化操作
AI 产品团队——快速构建浏览器内的智能助手或 Copilot 体验
隐私敏感用户——支持纯本地模型，无需上传页面截图至云端

en.tag: In-page AI GUI agent using text-based DOM manipulation without screenshots
en.what: Page Agent is a JavaScript GUI agent that lives inside the browser page, giving any website natural language control with a single script embed. It understands page structure through text-based DOM parsing rather than screenshot vision, enabling conversational interaction for clicks, inputs, and navigation. It supports mainstream LLMs including local deployments, with an optional Chrome extension for multi-page workflows.
en.content: The repository centers on an embeddable JavaScript/TypeScript SDK that provides text-based DOM perception, LLM orchestration, and action execution; plus an optional Chrome extension, MCP server, and documentation site.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript and distributed as an npm package, it runs purely in-browser via native JavaScript without Python or headless browser dependencies, connecting to any OpenAI-compatible mainstream or local LLM.
en.hot: Surging 8,521 stars this month to hit Trending #10, it solves the pain points of traditional agents that require screenshots, multimodal LLMs, or browser extensions by offering a purely frontend, “one-script” AI integration for any webpage.
uses: Frontend developers — add natural language interaction to existing web apps without backend changes
Automation/test engineers — replace traditional scripts with text commands for web automation
AI product teams — rapidly build in-browser assistants or copilot experiences
Privacy-conscious users — run local LLMs without uploading page screenshots to the cloud

zh.tag: 让Claude具备看视频能力的Agent插件，一键解析任意视频
zh.what: 它通过 /watch 命令为 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 助手赋予“观看”视频的能力。用户粘贴任意视频链接或本地路径后，它会自动下载、提取关键帧、获取时间戳字幕，并将视觉和音频信息完整交给 Claude 理解。最终让 AI 真正“看到”画面并“听到”内容，而非仅靠标题猜测。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Python 的 /watch 插件核心源码，以及面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 余种 Agent Skills 平台的安装配置与文档。整体以命令行插件形态交付，采用零配置设计，首次运行时自动引导安装 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，使用 yt-dlp 负责视频下载，ffmpeg 处理帧提取与音视频分离，优先调用免费字幕接口，无字幕时回退至 OpenAI Whisper API。通过标准化插件协议与 Claude Code 等 Agent 环境集成。
zh.hot: 在 8992 颗 Star 的基础上本周再增 1876，跻身 GitHub Python 周榜第 15 名。它精准解决了 AI Agent 无法感知视频这一痛点，以零配置、多平台兼容和“真正看懂视频”的体验迅速获得开发者青睐。
uses: 内容创作者与营销人员：快速拆解竞品视频结构、分析热门视频开场钩子与广告创意
开发者与测试工程师：通过录屏诊断 Bug，让 AI 直接定位问题帧并分析故障原因
学习者与研究者：将长视频或课程播放列表转为可搜索的带时间戳笔记，跳过无效信息
产品经理与分析师：过滤发布会和更新视频中的营销话术，直接提取实质功能更新

en.tag: Agent plugin that gives Claude eyes: downloads, frames & transcribes any video
en.what: It gives Claude and other AI agents the ability to "watch" videos via a simple /watch command. The tool downloads the video, extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped transcripts (free captions first, Whisper as fallback), and feeds everything to the AI. This lets Claude actually see what's on screen and hear the audio instead of guessing from titles or partial transcripts.
en.content: The repo contains the Python core of the /watch plugin, plus installation configs and docs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and over 50 Agent Skills hosts. It ships as a CLI plugin with zero-config setup, automatically installing yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first run.
en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.
uses: Content creators & marketers: analyze competitor video structures, viral hooks, and ad creatives
Developers & QA engineers: diagnose bugs from screen recordings by having the AI pinpoint issue frames
Learners & researchers: turn long videos or course playlists into searchable, timestamped notes
Product managers & analysts: strip hype from launch videos and extract substantive feature updates

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: 开源智能体视频制作系统，将AI编程助手升级为视频工作室
zh.what: OpenMontage 是全球首个开源的智能体驱动视频制作系统，通过 12 条流水线、52 款工具和 500 余项智能体技能，将用户的 AI 编程助手转化为完整的视频生产工作室。用户只需提供灵感或参考视频，即可由多智能体协作完成从脚本、素材到成片的自动化视频创作。
zh.content: 仓库内置了 12 条可编排的视频生产流水线、52 个专用工具模块以及超过 500 项智能体技能配置，涵盖从脚本生成、素材处理到后期合成的完整链路。项目以 Python 为主语言，提供快速启动指南、提示词模板及多模型提供商接入文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，采用智能体编排架构，支持接入 Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek 等主流大模型 API，并依赖 Bloome 等多智能体协作平台与 Atlas Cloud 等全模态推理服务完成视频生成与图像合成。
zh.hot: 项目上线短期内狂揽 39.6K Star，其中本月新增 34.7K，登顶 GitHub Trending 月榜第 1，反映出社区对「智能体驱动视频自动化」的强烈需求。其首创的「将 AI 编程助手转化为视频工作室」理念，填补了开源领域端到端智能视频生产的空白。
uses: AI 开发者与智能体研究者——希望基于开源架构快速搭建自动化视频工作流
内容创作者与自媒体团队——需要批量生成短视频、广告或解说视频
编程爱好者与 AI 辅助用户——想将已有的 AI Coding Assistant 升级为视频生产工具
开源社区与技术布道者——寻找可扩展、可定制的多智能体协作视频方案

en.tag: Open-source agentic video production: turn AI coding assistant into studio
en.what: OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system. It transforms your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio through 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and 500+ agent skills. Users can paste a reference video or provide prompts to automate end-to-end video creation via multi-agent collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains 12 orchestrated video production pipelines, 52 dedicated tool modules, and 500+ agent skill configurations covering scripting, asset processing, and post-production. Written primarily in Python, it includes quick-start guides, prompt templates, and provider integration docs for multi-model backends.
en.stack: Built on Python with an agent orchestration architecture, it supports mainstream LLM APIs such as Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek. It leverages multi-agent collaboration platforms like Bloome and full-modal inference services like Atlas Cloud for video generation and image synthesis.
en.hot: The project has skyrocketed to 39.6K stars with 34.7K added this month, claiming the #1 spot on GitHub Trending monthly rankings. This reflects massive community demand for agentic video automation, as its pioneering concept of turning AI coding assistants into video studios fills a gap in open-source end-to-end intelligent video production.
uses: AI developers and agent researchers seeking to build automated video workflows on open-source architecture.
Content creators and social media teams needing batch production of short videos, ads, or explainer clips.
Coding enthusiasts and AI-assisted users who want to upgrade their existing AI coding assistant into a video production tool.
Open-source communities and tech evangelists looking for scalable, customizable multi-agent collaborative video solutions.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 记忆平台，为 Agent 提供持久化长期记忆与自托管知识图谱
zh.what: Cognee 是专为 AI Agent 打造的开源记忆平台，解决跨会话失忆问题。它通过自托管的知识图谱引擎，让 Agent 能够保存、检索和关联长期记忆，确保每次交互都基于完整上下文。平台支持多格式数据摄入，使 Agent 可以像人类一样积累经验并持续进化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 核心 SDK、知识图谱引擎、多模态数据接入管道、记忆存储与检索模块，以及详尽的文档和示例代码。此外还设有独立的社区插件仓库 cognee-community，便于开发者扩展功能和对接外部系统。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python 构建，以知识图谱作为记忆存储与关联的核心，支持自托管部署。可灵活对接各类大语言模型（LLM）与向量数据库，形成完整的记忆基础设施。
zh.hot: 本月新增 10,292 Star，总星数突破 2.8 万并登上 GitHub Python 月榜第 5 名，反映出 AI Agent 浪潮下业界对记忆基础设施的迫切需求。其开源、自托管与知识图谱方案精准切中了开发者对数据主权和 Agent 长期记忆能力的双重痛点。
uses: AI Agent 开发者 —— 为 Chatbot 或自主 Agent 添加跨会话的长期记忆能力
企业知识管理 —— 自托管构建私有知识图谱，打造安全可控的 AI 记忆中枢
LLM 应用架构师 —— 需要可解释、可溯源的记忆层来替代简单的向量检索
隐私敏感型团队 —— 希望在本地或私有云部署，确保业务数据不出域

en.tag: Open-source AI memory platform giving agents persistent long-term memory via self-hosted knowledge graphs
en.what: Cognee is an open-source AI memory platform built for agents to solve cross-session amnesia. It enables agents to retain, retrieve, and connect long-term memories through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine, grounding every interaction in full context. The platform supports multi-format data ingestion so agents can accumulate experience and evolve continuously.
en.content: The repository houses a Python core SDK, a knowledge graph engine, multi-modal data ingestion pipelines, memory storage and retrieval modules, along with comprehensive docs and examples. It also links to a separate community plugins repo (cognee-community) for add-ons and external system integrations.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python with a knowledge graph as the core for memory storage and relationship mapping, it supports self-hosted deployment and flexibly integrates with various LLMs and vector databases to form a complete memory infrastructure.
en.hot: With 10,292 new stars this month and over 28K total to hit #5 on GitHub's Python monthly trending list, it reflects the industry's urgent demand for memory infrastructure amid the AI agent boom. zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG

Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.

en.tag: A methodology pipeline to distill books, videos and podcasts into executable AI agent skills

en.stack: Built primarily in Python, it combines Mortimer Adler's analytical reading and the RIA note-taking method, relying on LLMs for parallel extraction and verification to produce skills compatible with Claude Code and Cursor; video workflows require the companion video-downloader skill for subtitle and audio transcription.

Engineers using Claude Code or Cursor who need to build reusable skill libraries for their teams

uses: 前端开发者与设计师 —— 快速获取参考网站的现代化组件与布局实现，用于学习与二次开发。
独立开发者与创业者 —— 低成本、高效率地复刻竞品落地页或快速启动 MVP。
AI 工具链爱好者 —— 探索 Claude Code 等代理在复杂前端工程中的自动化与并行构建能力。

en.tag: AI-powered template that clones any website into a clean Next.js codebase via one command
en.what: A reusable template that leverages AI coding agents to reverse-engineer any website into a clean, modern Next.js codebase via a single command. It automatically inspects the target site, extracts design tokens and assets, writes component specs, and dispatches parallel builders to reconstruct every section.
en.content: The repo is centered around a Next.js project template, bundled with AI agent instruction files (AGENTS.md), design reference docs and comparison screenshots, plus automated workflows that power the `/clone-website` skill across Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript and Next.js within the Node.js ecosystem, managed via npm. Its core capabilities rely on external AI coding agents, with Claude Code (Opus 4.8) officially recommended, while also supporting Codex CLI and OpenCode.
en.hot: With 11,751 new stars this month and 28,591 total, landing at #7 on the GitHub Trending TypeScript monthly chart, it signals explosive demand for one-command, AI-driven website replication that produces maintainable code.
uses: Front-end developers and designers — quickly extract modern component and layout implementations from reference sites for learning and reuse.
Indie hackers and entrepreneurs — replicate competitor landing pages or bootstrap MVPs with minimal cost and effort.
AI tooling enthusiasts — explore automation and parallel builder capabilities of agents like Claude Code in complex front-end engineering.

zh.tag: 面向 SaaS 和 AI 应用的开源身份认证基础设施
zh.what: Logto 是一个现代化的开源身份认证与授权基础设施，专为 SaaS 和 AI 应用设计。它基于 OIDC 和 OAuth 2.1 协议，提供多租户、企业 SSO 和 RBAC 功能，简化了安全认证的构建过程。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Logto 核心服务、管理控制台、预构建的登录流程、可定制 UI 以及 30+ 框架的 SDK。还支持 Model Context Protocol 和基于代理的 AI 架构。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 OIDC、OAuth 2.1、SAML 等协议，支持多种部署方式（Cloud、GitPod、Render）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2122 颗星，总星数 14231，位列 TypeScript 月榜第 12。Logto 解决了 SaaS 和 AI 应用中的身份认证痛点，提供开箱即用的多租户和 SSO 功能，受到开发者社区欢迎。
uses: SaaS 应用开发者 —— 快速集成多租户认证和 RBAC 权限管理
AI 应用团队 —— 为 AI 代理和模型上下文协议提供认证支持
企业级应用 —— 实现企业 SSO 和 SAML 联合登录

en.tag: Open-source auth infrastructure for SaaS and AI apps
en.what: Logto is a modern, open-source auth infrastructure for SaaS and AI apps. Built on OIDC and OAuth 2.1, it provides multi-tenancy, enterprise SSO, and RBAC, making secure authentication easy to implement.
en.content: The repo includes Logto core services, admin console, pre-built sign-in flows, customizable UIs, and SDKs for 30+ frameworks. It also supports Model Context Protocol and agent-based AI architectures.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, relying on OIDC, OAuth 2.1, and SAML protocols. Supports deployment via Cloud, GitPod, and Render.
en.hot: Gained 2122 stars this month, total 14231, ranking 12th in TypeScript monthly. Logto addresses auth pain points for SaaS and AI apps with out-of-the-box multi-tenancy and SSO, gaining traction among developers.
uses: SaaS app developers — quickly integrate multi-tenant auth and RBAC
AI app teams — provide auth support for AI agents and Model Context Protocol
Enterprise apps — implement enterprise SSO and SAML federation

zh.tag: Google 官方 Agent Skills 库，打通 Claude/Cursor/Codex 多代理生态
zh.what: Stitch Skills 是一个面向 Google Stitch 平台的 Agent Skills 库，遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等主流编码代理。它通过 Stitch MCP 服务器为 AI 代理提供设计、构建与工具类能力，让开发者能在多代理环境中复用同一套技能。
zh.content: 仓库按插件维度组织，包含 stitch-design、stitch-build、stitch-utilities 三大插件集，以及 .agents/plugins 等配置目录，支持通过 Codex、Claude Code 或 Cursor 按需安装。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主语言，基于 MCP（Model Context Protocol）协议与 Stitch MCP 服务器通信，并遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准接入各编码代理。
zh.hot: 仓库已获 7.6k Star，本周新增 1,076 颗跃居 GitHub Trending 周榜第 3，背后是 Google 官方背书与「一套技能多代理复用」的开放标准吸引力。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 的开发者，想要扩展 AI 代理的设计与构建能力
需要在 Google Stitch 平台内管理设计系统、组件库的工程团队
希望基于 Agent Skills 开放标准构建跨代理兼容插件的 AI 基础设施开发者
追求「安装即用」插件化工作流，减少多代理环境配置成本的技术团队

en.tag: Google's official Agent Skills library bridging Claude, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI
en.what: Stitch Skills is an Agent Skills library for the Google Stitch platform that follows the open Agent Skills standard, compatible with leading coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It exposes design, build, and utility capabilities to AI agents via the Stitch MCP server, enabling reusable skills across multi-agent workflows.
en.content: The repository is organized into plugin suites including stitch-design, stitch-build, and stitch-utilities, alongside .agents/plugins configurations, supporting selective installation via Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it communicates via the MCP (Model Context Protocol) with the Stitch MCP server and conforms to the open Agent Skills standard for agent integration.
en.hot: With 7,637 stars and 1,076 new ones this week to rank #3 on GitHub Trending, it draws attention from Google's official backing and the promise of one skill set reusable across multiple agents.
uses: Developers using Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex looking to extend agents with design and build capabilities
Engineering teams managing design systems and component libraries within the Google Stitch platform
AI infrastructure developers building cross-agent compatible plugins based on the open Agent Skills standard
Technical teams seeking plug-and-play workflows to reduce setup overhead across multi-agent environments

zh.tag: 面向面试与审查的自主编码代理运行器
zh.what: Gajae-Code 是一个实验性的自主编码代理运行器，专为面试场景、审查计划和持久化验证而设计。它通过 tmux 原生执行，支持移动端通知（Telegram/Discord/Slack）和远程控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理运行器、CLI 工具、SDK、Telegram 守护进程以及研究/REPL 模式（rlm）。提供配置通知、会话管理和 WebSocket 发现文件等组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 tmux、Node.js、npm 包（gajae-code），并集成 Telegram/Discord/Slack API。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1059 星（总计 2234），位列 GitHub TypeScript 趋势榜第 14 名。其独特的面试导向和移动端通知功能吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 技术面试准备 —— 模拟编码代理面试场景
代码审查与验证 —— 审查代理生成的计划并持久化验证
远程开发控制 —— 通过 Telegram/Discord 管理编码会话
研究与实验 —— 使用 rlm 模式进行交互式代理循环实验

en.tag: A focused coding-agent runner for interviews, reviewed plans, and durable verification
en.what: Gajae-Code is an experimental autonomous coding-agent runner tailored for interviews, reviewed plans, and durable verification. It features tmux-native execution, mobile notifications (Telegram/Discord/Slack), and remote control.
en.content: The repo includes the core agent runner, CLI tools, SDK, Telegram daemon, and a research/REPL mode (rlm). It provides components for notification configuration, session management, and WebSocket discovery files.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, depends on tmux, Node.js, npm package (gajae-code), and integrates with Telegram/Discord/Slack APIs.
en.hot: Gained 1059 stars this month (total 2234), ranking 14th on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its unique interview focus and mobile notification capabilities have drawn developer interest.
uses: Technical interview preparation — simulate coding agent interview scenarios
Code review and verification — review agent-generated plans and perform durable verification
Remote development control — manage coding sessions via Telegram/Discord
Research and experimentation — use rlm mode for interactive agent loop experiments

zh.tag: 夜间自主运行 AI 编码代理的 CLI 编排器
zh.what: gnhf 是一个自主代理编排器，让你在睡眠期间保持 AI 编码代理持续运行。它会自动执行迭代任务，每次只做一个小的、已提交的、有文档记录的变更，朝目标推进。
zh.content: 提供单一 CLI 入口，支持自动循环迭代、Git 提交与回滚、失败重试、worktree 多代理并发，以及运行摘要和日志记录。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，兼容主流编码 Agent CLI 及 ACP 目标，通过 npm 分发。
zh.hot: 以「晚安，玩得开心」的趣味概念精准击中开发者痛点——让 AI 在夜间自动打工；本月新增 1,152 Star，冲至 TypeScript 月榜第 10，反映了社区对「无人值守式」Agent 工作流的高度需求。
uses: 需要夜间或后台自动完成编码任务的开发者
希望同时运行多个 AI Agent 处理不同模块的工程师
追求干净 Git 历史与自动提交/回滚机制的自动化爱好者

en.tag: CLI orchestrator for running AI coding agents autonomously overnight
en.what: gnhf is an autonomous agent orchestrator that keeps AI coding agents running while you sleep. It automates iterative tasks, making one small, committed, documented change at a time toward an objective.
en.content: A single CLI entrypoint featuring an autonomous loop, Git commit/rollback, failure retries, worktree-based multi-agent concurrency, and run summaries with logging.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting macOS/Linux/Windows, compatible with popular coding agent CLIs and ACP targets, distributed via npm.
en.hot: Its playful 'good night, have fun' concept perfectly addresses the developer pain point of letting AI work overnight autonomously; gaining 1,152 stars this month and hitting #10 on the TypeScript monthly trending list reflects strong community demand for unattended agent workflows.
uses: Developers who need coding tasks completed automatically overnight or in the background
Engineers wanting to run multiple AI agents on different modules simultaneously
Automation enthusiasts who value clean Git history with auto-commit and rollback

zh.tag: 美观可定制的 UI 组件库与代码分发平台
zh.what: shadcn/ui 是一套设计精美的组件集合，支持自定义、扩展和构建。它同时也是一个代码分发平台，让你可以直接将组件代码复制到项目中，而不是作为依赖安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、文档站点、示例应用和 CLI 工具。组件以源码形式提供，你可以自由修改。
zh.stack: 基于 React（或 Vue/Svelte 等适配版本）、Tailwind CSS、Radix UI 原语。使用 TypeScript 编写。
zh.hot: 因其“复制而非安装”的创新理念和高质量设计而爆火，本月新增近 3000 star，总星数近 12 万。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 快速构建美观且可访问的 UI
设计系统团队 —— 作为组件库的基础，轻松定制品牌样式
全栈开发者 —— 在 Next.js、Vite 等框架中集成使用

en.tag: Beautifully-designed, customizable UI components and a code distribution platform
en.what: shadcn/ui is a collection of beautifully designed components that you can customize, extend, and build upon. It also serves as a code distribution platform, allowing you to copy component code directly into your project instead of installing it as a dependency.
en.content: The repository includes component source code, documentation site, example apps, and a CLI tool. Components are provided as source code, allowing full customization.
en.stack: Built on React (with adapters for Vue, Svelte, etc.), Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI primitives. Written in TypeScript.
en.hot: It gained massive popularity due to its innovative 'copy instead of install' approach and high-quality design, with nearly 3,000 new stars this month and a total of almost 120,000 stars.
uses: Frontend developers — quickly build beautiful and accessible UIs
Design system teams — use as a foundation for a custom component library with easy branding
Full-stack developers — integrate with frameworks like Next.js, Vite, etc.

zh.tag: 为 Claude 等 AI 提供终端控制、文件搜索与 diff 编辑的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: DesktopCommanderMCP 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的服务器，它让 Claude 等 AI 客户端能够直接控制用户终端、搜索文件系统并执行基于 diff 的代码编辑。它超越了传统 AI 编辑器的局限，允许 AI 在获得授权后运行长时间命令、管理进程和自动化本地开发任务，且无需额外 API Token 成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器源码、基于 TypeScript 的终端与文件系统工具集，以及一个独立的 Desktop Commander App（Beta），后者提供可视化文件预览、Markdown 编辑器和对多模型（Claude/GPT-4.5/Gemini 等）的支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 MCP Filesystem Server 构建，通过 Model Context Protocol 与 Claude Desktop 等客户端通信，并支持 npm 分发安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程助手爆发式增长的背景下，该仓库凭借 8,467 Star（本周新增 1,657，冲至周榜第 5）的势头，精准解决了 AI 无法直接操作本地终端和文件系统的痛点，让开发者能用自然语言驱动完整的本地开发工作流。
uses: 开发者 —— 想通过自然语言让 AI 直接执行终端命令、批量修改代码文件
AI 工具链集成者 —— 需要在 Claude Desktop 或其他 MCP 客户端中扩展本地文件与命令行能力
追求效率的自动化用户 —— 希望在一个聊天界面中完成代码检索、编辑和进程管理的全流程

en.tag: MCP server granting Claude terminal control, file search & diff editing
en.what: DesktopCommanderMCP is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that grants Claude and other AI clients terminal control, filesystem search, and diff-based file editing capabilities. It goes beyond conventional AI editors by letting AI execute long-running commands, manage processes, and automate local development tasks using the host client's subscription instead of extra API tokens.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server source code, a TypeScript-based toolkit for terminal and filesystem operations, and a standalone Desktop Commander App (Beta) with visual file previews, a Markdown editor, and support for multiple AI models.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript on top of the MCP Filesystem Server, it communicates with clients like Claude Desktop via the Model Context Protocol and is distributed via npm.
en.hot: Amid the AI coding assistant boom, it has surged to 8,467 stars with 1,657 added this week (ranking 5th on GitHub Trending), precisely solving the pain point of AI being unable to directly operate local terminals and filesystems, enabling developers to drive entire local workflows via natural language.
uses: Developers who want to execute terminal commands and batch-edit code via natural language instructions
AI toolchain integrators looking to extend Claude Desktop or other MCP clients with local filesystem and shell capabilities
Automation-minded users seeking a unified chat interface for code search, editing, and process management

zh.tag: 面向AI/ML研究员的数学、计算机与AI开放通识教程
zh.what: 这是一本强调直觉优先的开放教科书，系统覆盖数学、计算机科学与人工智能核心概念，帮助读者深入理解而非应试。作者整理了个人在AI/ML领域工作多年的笔记，并已被成功用于DeepMind、OpenAI等顶尖公司面试准备。仓库还内置MCP服务器，允许Claude、Cursor等AI助手将全书作为知识库调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含按章节组织的Markdown教材，涵盖向量、矩阵、微积分、统计、概率、机器学习、计算语言学和计算机视觉八大主题。此外还提供了一个基于TypeScript的MCP服务器实现，附带教育工具和示例代码，支持本地部署为AI助手知识库。
zh.stack: 主要采用TypeScript构建MCP服务器及配套工具，核心内容以Markdown格式编写，便于在线阅读和版本控制。用户需本地克隆仓库并配合支持MCP协议的AI客户端（如Claude Code、Cursor）使用知识库功能。
zh.hot: 仓库凭借“直觉优先、拒绝死记硬背”的实用定位，在AI人才竞争加剧的背景下精准击中从业者痛点，Star数已达6,763且单日新增200，冲上Trending日榜第3名。多名读者凭借此笔记成功入职DeepMind、OpenAI等顶级机构，进一步放大了口碑效应。
uses: AI/ML从业者 —— 希望夯实数学与算法基础、深入理解模型原理的工程师与研究员
面试候选人 —— 准备DeepMind、OpenAI等顶尖实验室研究岗面试的求职者
AI辅助学习者 —— 想通过Claude、Cursor等AI助手交互式查询知识库的自学者
技术写作者 —— 寻求高质量开源教材作为参考或补充材料的课程设计者

en.tag: Open compendium on maths, CS and AI for aspiring research engineers
en.what: This is an open, intuition-first textbook covering core concepts in mathematics, computer science, and artificial intelligence from the ground up. It compiles the author's years of AI/ML notes and has been used to prepare for interviews at top labs like DeepMind and OpenAI. The repository also ships an MCP server that turns the compendium into a queryable knowledge base for AI assistants such as Claude and Cursor.
en.content: The repository houses chapter-based Markdown textbooks spanning vectors, matrices, calculus, statistics, probability, machine learning, computational linguistics, and computer vision. It also includes a TypeScript-based MCP server with educational tooling and example implementations, enabling local deployment as a knowledge base for AI assistants.
en.stack: The MCP server and tooling are built primarily in TypeScript, while the core curriculum is authored in Markdown for web readability and version control. Users need to clone the repo locally and pair it with an MCP-compatible AI client—such as Claude Code or Cursor—to leverage the knowledge-base features.
en.hot: Its 'intuition-first, no hand-waving' approach resonates deeply with practitioners amid intensifying AI talent competition, driving the repo to 6,763 stars and a single-day gain of 200 that landed it at #3 on GitHub Trending. The author's credentials—Y Combinator alumnus and successful interview prep for DeepMind and OpenAI—have further amplified its credibility and word-of-mouth appeal.
uses: AI/ML practitioners — engineers and researchers looking to solidify mathematical foundations and deeply understand model mechanics
Interview candidates — job seekers preparing for research roles at top labs like DeepMind, OpenAI, and Nvidia
AI-assisted learners — self-learners who want to interactively query the compendium via Claude, Cursor, or other MCP-compatible assistants
Technical educators — course designers and writers seeking high-quality open-source textbooks as teaching references

zh.tag: 去中心化联邦制视频平台，浏览器内 P2P 流媒体
zh.what: PeerTube 是一个免费、去中心化且联邦制的视频平台，旨在替代 YouTube 等中心化服务。它通过 ActivityPub 协议实现实例间联邦互操作，并利用 P2P 技术直接在浏览器中分发视频流，从而降低服务器带宽压力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端与前端代码，提供视频上传、转码、播放、联邦关注及实例管理等功能，支持多实例部署与 Docker 容器化运行。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主，后端基于 Node.js，前端采用 Angular，数据库使用 PostgreSQL 与 Redis，并集成 WebTorrent / HLS 实现浏览器 P2P 流媒体。
zh.hot: 在中心化平台监管与数据主权争议加剧的背景下，PeerTube 凭借 15.2k Star 和月增 509 Star 的热度，成为开源社区构建自主视频生态的首选方案。
uses: 希望摆脱 YouTube 等平台绑定的内容创作者与媒体机构
需要搭建私有/社区视频站点的运维人员与开发者
关注数据隐私与去中心化网络的技术倡导者
教育、非营利组织等寻求无广告视频托管的团体

en.tag: Decentralized federated video platform with in-browser P2P streaming
en.what: PeerTube is a free, decentralized, and federated video platform designed as an alternative to centralized services like YouTube. It enables interoperability between instances via ActivityPub and uses P2P technology to distribute video streams directly in the browser, reducing server bandwidth costs.
en.content: The repository contains full server and client-side code for video upload, transcoding, playback, federation, and instance management, supporting multi-instance deployment and Docker containerization.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with a Node.js backend, Angular frontend, PostgreSQL and Redis for data storage, and WebTorrent/HLS integration for browser-based P2P streaming.
en.hot: Amid growing concerns over centralized platform control and data sovereignty, PeerTube has become a leading choice for building autonomous video ecosystems, reflected in its 15.2k stars and 509 new stars this month.
uses: Content creators and media organizations seeking independence from YouTube
DevOps and developers building private or community-driven video instances
Privacy and decentralization advocates exploring federated networks
Educational and non-profit groups looking for ad-free video hosting

zh.tag: 面向AI创作的开源无限画布工作台
zh.what: 无限画布是一款集成AI生图、参考图编辑、视频生成、Agent智能助手、画布编排、对话创作、提示词库与素材管理等能力的开源工作台。它支持可视化创作流程与多Agent协同工作，兼容OpenAI接口生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（基于Vite+React Router）、本地Canvas Agent（连接Codex/Claude Code）、Codex App插件、以及TypeScript SDK用于开发画布节点插件。提供Docker和Render部署方式。
zh.stack: 前端使用TypeScript、Vite、React Router；后端Agent基于Node.js；插件系统支持动态加载远程节点插件。
zh.hot: 本月新增1701星，总星数3553，位列GitHub Trending月榜TypeScript第14名。因其将无限画布与AI创作深度结合，提供一站式视觉方案探索工具，受到AI创作者和开发者追捧。
uses: AI创作者：在无限画布中迭代图片、视频等视觉方案
开发者：集成OpenAI兼容接口，开发自定义节点插件
团队协作：通过多Agent协同工作，提升创作效率

en.tag: Open-source infinite canvas workbench for AI creation
en.what: Infinite Canvas is an open-source workbench integrating AI image generation, reference image editing, video generation, Agent assistant, canvas orchestration, conversational creation, prompt library, and asset management. It supports visual creative workflows and multi-Agent collaboration, compatible with the OpenAI API ecosystem.
en.content: The repo includes a frontend app (Vite+React Router), a local Canvas Agent (connecting Codex/Claude Code), a Codex App plugin, and a TypeScript SDK for developing canvas node plugins. Deployment via Docker and Render is supported.
en.stack: Frontend: TypeScript, Vite, React Router; Backend Agent: Node.js; Plugin system supports dynamic loading of remote node plugins.
en.hot: Gained 1701 stars this month, total 3553, ranking #14 in GitHub Trending monthly (TypeScript). Its deep integration of infinite canvas with AI creation as a one-stop visual exploration tool has attracted AI creators and developers.
uses: AI creators: iterate images, videos, and visual concepts on an infinite canvas
Developers: integrate OpenAI-compatible APIs and develop custom node plugins
Teams: collaborate via multi-Agent workflows to boost creative efficiency

zh.tag: Claude Code 的 OpenAI Codex 插件，实现代码审查与任务委托
zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方为 Claude Code 开发的插件，让开发者无需离开终端环境即可调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委托。用户可通过斜杠命令执行只读评审、对抗性压力测试，或将编码任务后台交给 Codex 代理处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、Claude Code 市场清单配置，以及内置的 /codex:* 斜杠命令和 codex-rescue 子代理。同时提供完整安装文档与演示视频，支持通过 npm 安装 Codex CLI 并自动处理登录与会话交接。

uses: Claude Code 忠实用户 —— 希望在熟悉的终端工作流中直接复用 Codex 的审查与代理能力。
追求代码质量的团队 —— 需要对多文件变更进行常规审查或对抗性压力测试，发现潜在设计缺陷。
高频使用 AI 辅助编程的开发者 —— 想将耗时任务后台委托给 Codex，通过异步状态查询和结果拉取保持专注。
多 AI 工具链整合者 —— 试图打通 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 生态，构建统一的命令行 AI 开发环境。

en.tag: Claude Code plugin integrating OpenAI Codex for code review and task delegation
en.what: An official OpenAI plugin that embeds Codex capabilities directly into Claude Code, letting developers review and delegate coding tasks without leaving their terminal. It exposes slash commands for read-only reviews, adversarial pressure-testing, and background task delegation to Codex agents.

en.hot: Backed by OpenAI and Claude Code's large user base, the plugin gained 1,801 stars this week and reached #12 on GitHub Trending with nearly 29k total stars. It directly addresses developer demand for seamlessly switching between Claude and Codex within a single terminal workflow.
uses: Claude Code power users who want to leverage Codex review and agent capabilities inside their existing terminal workflow.
Teams focused on code quality looking to run standard or adversarial reviews on multi-file changes to uncover design flaws.
Developers heavily using AI-assisted coding who want to delegate long-running tasks to Codex in the background and check results asynchronously.
Multi-AI toolchain integrators aiming to bridge Anthropic and OpenAI ecosystems within a unified CLI environment.

zh.tag: 面向AI代理的HTML交互式编辑器，支持本地人机协作反馈
zh.what: Lavish 是一款本地优先的 HTML 制品编辑器，专为 AI 代理生成的富交互内容设计。它让开发者直接在浏览器中审阅、标注和修改 HTML 文件，并通过 AXI 协议将反馈无缝回传给 Agent，替代低效的截图与长文本沟通。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lavish Editor 的核心 CLI、AXI 接口实现、本地浏览器渲染引擎，以及面向 Agent Skills 的 npx skills 安装钩子。README 还提供了面向产品计划、技术方案等场景的内置可视化模板。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，以 CLI 形式分发，通过 npm 发布；支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1,445 星，以 1,967 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 月榜第 5。它精准切中了 AI Agent 时代“生成 HTML 容易、协作修改难”的痛点，用本地优先和 AXI 协议重新定义了人机协作的编辑体验。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手并需要可视化审阅 Agent 生成 HTML 报告/原型的开发者
需要与 Agent 进行精细化交互反馈而非截图和文字的产品经理与技术负责人
希望本地安全运行、不愿将 HTML 制品上传云端的企业与隐私敏感用户

en.tag: Local-first interactive HTML editor for human-AI collaboration on agent artifacts.
en.what: Lavish is a local-first HTML editor designed for AI agent-generated rich artifacts. It lets users review, annotate, and edit rendered HTML directly in the browser, then sends structured feedback back to agents via the AXI protocol—replacing inefficient screenshots and long text messages.
en.content: The repo contains the core CLI, AXI interface, local browser rendering engine, and npx skills install hooks for agent integration. It also ships with built-in visualization templates for product planning and technical design scenarios.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/Node.js and distributed as a cross-platform CLI via npm, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: It gained 1,445 stars this month, hitting 1,967 total and ranking 5th on GitHub's monthly JavaScript Trending. It nails the pain point that HTML is easy for agents to generate but hard for humans to collaboratively refine, redefining the human-AI editing loop with local-first principles and the AXI protocol.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who need to visually review agent-generated HTML reports or prototypes
Product managers and tech leads seeking precise interactive feedback loops with agents instead of screenshots
Privacy-conscious users and enterprises wanting local-first execution without uploading artifacts to the cloud

zh.tag: 让AI代理用原始人语回复，节省65%输出token
zh.what: Caveman 是一个技能/插件，适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等30+ AI编码代理。安装后，代理会以原始人式的简短语言回答问题，同时保持代码、命令和错误信息的准确性，从而大幅减少输出token消耗。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、配置文件（支持30+代理）、不同原始人等级（如caveman、grunt）以及基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 基于JavaScript，依赖各AI代理的配置系统（如Claude Code的CLI配置、Cursor的rules等）。
zh.hot: 凭借幽默的原始人概念和惊人的65% token节省效果，迅速获得9万+星标，开发者纷纷尝试降低AI使用成本。
uses: AI编码代理用户 —— 希望减少token消耗、降低API费用的开发者
Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf 等代理的重度使用者 —— 通过简短回复提升效率
对AI输出风格有幽默需求的极客 —— 享受原始人式对话

en.tag: Make AI coding agents reply like cavemen, slashing 65% output tokens
en.what: Caveman is a skill/plugin for 30+ AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Once installed, agents reply in terse caveman-speak, preserving code, commands, and errors verbatim while drastically cutting output token usage.
en.content: The repo includes installation scripts, configuration files for 30+ agents, multiple caveman levels (e.g., caveman, grunt), and benchmark data.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, relies on configuration systems of various AI agents (e.g., Claude Code CLI config, Cursor rules).
en.hot: With its humorous caveman concept and impressive 65% token savings, it quickly garnered 90K+ stars as developers seek to reduce AI usage costs.
uses: AI coding agent users — developers looking to cut token usage and API costs
Heavy users of Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc. — boost efficiency with terse replies
Geeks with a sense of humor — enjoy caveman-style conversations

zh.tag: 非官方 ChatGPT Linux 桌面端，从 macOS 官方包提取并本地构建
zh.what: 该项目将 OpenAI 官方仅提供 macOS 版本的 ChatGPT 桌面应用（含 Chat、Work、Codex）转换为可在 Linux 运行的 Electron 应用。它通过提取上游 DMG 文件、应用 Linux 兼容性补丁并重建原生模块，最终打包成多种 Linux 发行版支持的安装格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含从 macOS DMG 提取、打补丁、构建原生模块的完整脚本，以及用于 Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch 和 Nix 的安装包配置；可选的 Linux 专属功能存放在 `linux-features/` 目录，同时提供 AppImage 自构建和本地更新管理器支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 与 JavaScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时；构建系统使用 Makefile 驱动，通过 CI 工作流自动化打包 .deb、.rpm、pacman 及 AppImage，并支持 Wayland 与 X11 显示协议。
zh.hot: OpenAI 迟迟未推出官方 Linux 客户端，该项目填补了空白；本周新增 395 Star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 5，反映出 Linux 开发者对原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验的强烈需求。
uses: Linux 开发者/用户 —— 想在 Debian、Fedora、Arch 等发行版上获得原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验
AI 重度使用者 —— 需要本地安装 Chat、Work 和 Codex 功能，而非仅使用网页版
偏好桌面端工作流的用户 —— 希望利用系统级快捷键、本地集成和离线更新管理
开源社区贡献者 —— 参与非官方 Linux 适配、Electron 跨平台补丁与打包流程改进

en.tag: Unofficial ChatGPT Desktop for Linux, extracted & rebuilt from official macOS DMG
en.what: This project converts OpenAI's official macOS-only ChatGPT Desktop app (including Chat, Work, and Codex) into a runnable Linux Electron application. It extracts the upstream DMG, applies Linux compatibility patches, rebuilds native modules, and packages the result for various Linux distributions.
en.content: The repository contains complete scripts for extracting the macOS DMG, applying patches, and rebuilding native modules, alongside packaging configs for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, and Nix. Optional Linux-only integrations live in `linux-features/`, with support for AppImage self-builds and a local update manager.
en.stack: Built with Electron and JavaScript, requiring Node.js; the build system is driven by Makefiles and CI workflows that automate packaging into .deb, .rpm, pacman, and AppImage formats, with support for both Wayland and X11.
en.hot: With no official Linux client from OpenAI, this project fills a critical gap; it gained 395 stars this week and hit #5 on the JavaScript Trending list, reflecting strong demand from Linux users for a native ChatGPT desktop experience.
uses: Linux developers/users seeking a native ChatGPT desktop experience on Debian, Fedora, Arch, and other distros.
Power users who need local access to Chat, Work, and Codex features instead of relying solely on the web app.
Desktop-centric workflow users wanting system-level shortcuts, local integrations, and an offline update manager.
Open-source contributors interested in unofficial Linux ports, Electron cross-platform patching, and packaging improvements.

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: DrawDB 是一款在浏览器中运行的免费、简单直观的数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器。它支持通过点击快速构建图表、导出和导入 SQL 脚本、生成迁移，无需注册账户即可使用。

zh.hot: 因其免费、无需注册、功能完整的在线数据库设计工具而广受欢迎，GitHub 上已获得 38k+ Stars，本月新增 773 Stars，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 15 名。
uses: 数据库设计师和架构师 —— 快速绘制 ER 图并生成 SQL
开发者 —— 在浏览器中可视化数据库结构，无需安装软件
教育场景 —— 教学数据库设计，直观展示关系模型

en.tag: Free online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: DrawDB is a free, simple, and intuitive database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that runs in your browser. It allows you to build diagrams with a few clicks, export and import SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize your editor without creating an account.
en.content: The repository contains the full web application source code built with JavaScript and React, supporting local development, production build, and Docker deployment. An optional backend server enables diagram sharing.
en.stack: Frontend uses JavaScript and React with Vite as build tool, supports npm and Docker deployment. Optional backend is Node.js-based.
en.hot: It has gained popularity for being a free, account-free, and feature-rich online database design tool, with over 38k stars on GitHub and 773 new stars this month, ranking 15th in the JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Database designers and architects — quickly draw ER diagrams and generate SQL
Developers — visualize database structures in the browser without installing software
Educational scenarios — teach database design with intuitive relationship models

zh.tag: 网文作者的全流程 AI 写作助手
zh.what: 这是一个为网文作者设计的 AI 技能包，覆盖长篇和短篇网络小说的扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图生成全流程。它内置了多款 AI 编码助手的适配，让作者能通过自然语言指令完成从市场分析到成品输出的完整创作。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 skill 文件，按流程分为环境部署、扫榜选材、拆文学习、落笔创作、精修定稿等模块，并配有流程图和详细的版本更新日志。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript，适配 Claude Code、OpenCode、ZCode、OpenClaw、Codex CLI、Reasonix、workbuddy 等多种 AI 编码环境，通过 skills 机制加载。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1623 星，总星数 4383，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 第 14 名。它精准解决了网文作者在 AI 辅助写作中的痛点，尤其是去AI味和商业化写作方法论，受到创作者社区热捧。
uses: 网文作者——从扫榜到完稿的全流程 AI 辅助
AI 写作工具开发者——学习如何构建垂直领域的 skill 包
内容创业者——快速量产符合市场口味的网文

en.tag: All-in-one AI skill pack for web fiction writing
en.what: A comprehensive AI skill pack for web fiction authors, covering trend scouting, story analysis, writing, AI-slop cleanup, and cover generation for both long-form and short-form web novels. It integrates with multiple AI coding assistants, enabling authors to complete the entire creative workflow from market analysis to final output via natural language commands.

AI writing tool developers — learn how to build domain-specific skill packs
Content entrepreneurs — quickly produce market-oriented web novels

zh.tag: JavaScript 版《代码整洁之道》实践指南
zh.what: 将 Robert C. Martin 的《Clean Code》中的软件工程原则适配到 JavaScript，提供可读、可复用、可重构的代码编写指南。它不是一份风格指南，而是关于如何产出高质量 JavaScript 代码的准则集合。
zh.content: 仓库包含按主题组织的章节，如变量、函数、对象、类、SOLID 原则、测试、并发、错误处理和注释，每个章节都有坏/好代码示例。

zh.hot: 作为 JavaScript 开发者必读的经典资源，累计 94,729 星，本月新增 475 星，长期占据 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: JavaScript 初学者 —— 学习编写整洁、可维护的代码
团队代码审查 —— 作为代码质量标准的参考
资深开发者 —— 重温并巩固代码整洁原则
技术培训 —— 用于内部培训或工作坊教材

en.tag: Clean Code principles adapted for JavaScript
en.what: Adapts software engineering principles from Robert C. Martin's 'Clean Code' for JavaScript, offering guidelines to produce readable, reusable, and refactorable code. It's not a style guide but a collection of principles for writing high-quality JavaScript.
en.content: The repo contains chapters organized by topic such as Variables, Functions, Objects, Classes, SOLID, Testing, Concurrency, Error Handling, and Comments, each with bad/good code examples.

en.hot: A classic resource for JavaScript developers, with 94,729 stars and 475 new stars this month, consistently trending on GitHub.
